a)rtemh/s.head: ἀρτεμής
a)rtemh/s.html: ἀρτεμής Dat. pl. ἀρτεμέεσσι Od. 13.43. Safe and sound: ζωόν τε καὶ ἀρτεμέα Il. 5.515 = Il. 7.308: φίλοισιν Od. 13.43.

a)/qurma.head: ἄθυρμα
a)/qurma.html: ἄθυρμα -ατος, τό [ἀθύρω.] A plaything Il. 15.363: Od. 18.323. In pl., gewgaws Od. 15.416.

a)/rabos.head: ἄραβος
a)/rabos.html: ἄραβος ὁ. A chattering (of the teeth) Il. 10.375.

ai)gane/h.head: αἰγανέη
ai)gane/h.html: αἰγανέη -ης, ἡ [app. fr. αἰγ-, αἴξ. Goat-spear. Used against goats in Od. 9.156.] A hunting-spear, a spear Il. 16.589, Il. 2.774: = Od. 4.626 = Od. 17.168, Od. 9.156.

a)lfa/nw.head: †ἀλφάνω
a)lfa/nw.html: †ἀλφάνω Aor. ἦλθον Il. 21.79. 3 sing. opt. ἄλθοι Od. 15.453, Od. 17.250, Od. 20.383. To bring in, yield (a price) (always of a human chattel): ἑκατόμβοιον Il. 21.79. Cf. Od. 15.453, Od. 17.250, Od. 20.383.

a)reth/.head: ἀρετή
a)reth/.html: ἀρετή -ῆς, ἡ. 1 Manliness, valour, prowess: ἣν ἀρετὴν διαείσεται Il. 8.535, συμφερτὴ ἀ. πέλει Il. 13.237 (brought together it becomes prowess, i.e. union makes prowess (συμφερτή assimilated in gender to ἀ. the predicate; cf. Il. 11.801 under ἀνάπνευσις)). Cf. Il. 11.90, 763, Il. 13.275, 277, Il. 14.118, Il. 20.242, Il. 22.268: Od. 12.211, Od. 24.515. In pl., manly or warlike qualities: ἀμείνων παντοίας ἀρετάς (in all . . .) Il. 15.642. 2 Of horses, excellence in the race Il. 23.276, 374. 3 Good, creditable, serviceable qualities or character: ἠγαγόμην γυναῖκα εἵνεκʼ ἐμῆς ἀρετῆς Od. 14.212. Cf. Od. 2.206, Od. 4.629 = Od. 21.187, Od. 17.322, Od. 18.205, Od. 22.244, Od. 24.193, 197. Sim. in pl.: παντοίῃς ἀρετῇσι κεκασμένον Od. 4.725 = 815. Reputation for such qualities or character: ἐϋκλείη τʼ ἀ. τε Od. 14.402. 4 Skill in manly exercises or pursuits Il. 23.571: Od. 8.237, 239, 244. So ποδῶν ἀρετήν (speed) Il. 20.411. 5 Majesty, dignity, rank Il. 9.498, Il. 23.578. 6 Good, welfare, prosperity: θεοὶ ἀρετὴν ὀπάσειαν Od. 13.45. Cf. Od. 18.133, 251, Od. 19.124.

a)sfalh/s.head: ἀσφαλής
a)sfalh/s.html: ἀσφαλής -ές [ἀ-1 + σφάλλω.] 1 Fixed, immovable: θεῶν ἕδος Od. 6.42. 2 In neut. ἀσφαλές as adv., without stumbling or falling Il. 15.683.

a)lu/bh.head: Ἀλύβη
a)lu/bh.html: Ἀλύβη A town of the Halizonians Il. 2.857.

a)lwh/.head: ἀλωή
a)lwh/.html: ἀλωή -ῆς, ἡ. 1 A threshing-floor Il. 5.499, Il. 13.588, Il. 20.496. 2 A piece of levelled or prepared ground, a garden, orchard, vineyard Il. 5.90, Il. 9.534, 540, Il. 18.57 = 438, Il. 21.36, 77, 346: Od. 6.293. Distinguished as an orchard Od. 24.221, 224, 226, 336. As a vineyard Il. 18.561, 566 (in both cases referring to a representation in metal): Od. 1.193, Od. 7.122, Od. 11.193.

a)loge/w.head: ἀλογέω
a)loge/w.html: ἀλογέω [ἀ-1 + λογ-, λέγω2.] To pay no heed or regard Il. 15.162, 178.

a)lge/w.head: ἀλγέω
a)lge/w.html: ἀλγέω [ἄλγος.] To suffer (bodily) pain or discomfort Il. 2.269, Il. 8.85, Il. 12.206: Od. 12.27.

a)floismo/s.head: ἀφλοισμός
a)floismo/s.html: ἀφλοισμός ὁ [said to = ἀφρός.] Foam Il. 15.607.

a)/gamos.head: ἄγαμος
a)/gamos.html: ἄγαμος [ἀ-1 + γάμος] Unmarried Il. 3.40.

a)roth/r.head: ἀροτήρ
a)roth/r.html: ἀροτήρ -ῆρος, ὁ [ἀρόω.] A ploughman Il. 18.542, Il. 23.835.

ai)w/n.head: αἰών
ai)w/n.html: αἰών -ῶνος, ὁ. Fem. Il. 22.58. 1 One's lifetime, one's life: μινυνθάδιος αἰ. ἔπλετο Il. 4.478 = Il. 17.302. Cf. Il. 9.415: Od. 5.152. 2 Life, the state of being in life: ἀπʼ αἰῶνος ὤλεο Il. 24.725. 3 The animating principle, the vital spirit, the soul, the life, life, one's life (cf. θυμός I.1.b): λίποι μʼ αἰ. Il. 5.685. Cf. Il. 16.453, Il. 19.27, Il. 22.58: αἰῶνος εὖνιν Od. 9.523. Cf. Od. 5.160, Od. 7.224, Od. 18.204.

a)/lkandros.head: Ἄλκανδρος
a)/lkandros.html: Ἄλκανδρος Trojan. killed by Odysseus Il. 5.678.

a)fu/ssw.head: ἀφύσσω
a)fu/ssw.html: ἀφύσσω Fut. infin. ἀφύξειν Il. 1.171. 3 sing. aor. ἤφυσε Il. 13.508, Il. 17.315. ἄφυσσε Il. 14.517: Od. 2.379. 1 pl. ἠφύσαμεν Od. 9.165. Imp. ἄφυσσον Od. 2.349. Pple. ἀφύσσας Od. 9.204. Aor. mid. ἠφυσάμην Od. 7.286. 3 sing. ἀφύσσατο Il. 16.230. 1 pl. -άμεθα Od. 9.85, Od. 10.56. Masc. pl. pple. ἀφυσσάμενοι Od. 4.359. (δι-, ἐξαφύω, ἐπ-.) 1 To draw (water). In mid. Od. 4.359, Od. 9.85 = Od. 10.56. 2 To draw off (wine etc.): νέκταρ ἀπὸ κρητῆρος Il. 1.598. Cf. Od. 2.349, 379, Od. 9.9, 165, 204. In mid.: ἐκ κρητῆρος ἀφυσσόμενοι δεπάεσσιν (in cups) Il. 3.295. Cf. Il. 10.579, Il. 16.230, Il. 23.220. In pass.: πολλὸς ἠφύσσετο οἶνος Od. 23.305. 3 To get together, heap up (wealth) Il. 1.171. In mid., to bring or gather together (about one): ἀμφὶ φύλλα ἠφυσάμην Od. 7.286. 4 Of a weapon, to let out (the entrails) like water: διὰ δʼ ἔντερα χαλκὸς ἤφυσεν Il. 13.508 = Il. 17.315. Cf. Il. 14.517.

a)rifradh/s.head: ἀριφραδής
a)rifradh/s.html: ἀριφραδής -ές [ἀρι- + φραδ-, φράζω.] 1 Easy to be distinguished, clear, manifest: σῆμα Il. 23.326: = Od. 11.126, Od. 21.217, Od. 23.73, 273, Od. 24.329, σήματα Od. 23.225. 2 Easy to be separated or picked out from others: ὀστέα Il. 23.240.

ai)gu/ptios.head: Αἰγύπτιος-1
ai)gu/ptios.html:
Αἰγύπτιος-1 Father of Antiphus-4 and Eurynomus Od. 2.15.
Αἰγύπτιος-2 (1) Adj. from Αἴγυπτος 1. Of Proteus Od. 4.385 . Adj. from Αἴγυπτος 2, Egyptian Od. 4.229. Of Thebes-2 Od. 4.127. In pl., the Egyptians Od. 4.83. So Αἰγύπτιοι ἄνδρες 263, 286, Od. 17.432.

a)ro/w.head: †ἀρόω
a)ro/w.html: †ἀρόω 3 pl. ἀρόωσι Od. 9.108. Dat. fem. pf. pple. pass. ἀρηρομένῃ Il. 18.548. 1 To plough (a field) Il. 18.548. 2 To use the plough, plough Od. 9.108.

a)la/stwr.head: Ἀλάστωρ-1
a)la/stwr.html:
Ἀλάστωρ-1 Greek. (δῖος) Il. 4.295; assists Mecisteus-2 in carrying off the wounded Teucrus Il. 8.333, and Hypsenor-2 Il. 13.422.
Ἀλάστωρ-2 Trojan. killed by Odysseus Il. 5.677.

a)/ntomai.head: †ἄντομαι
a)/ntomai.html: †ἄντομαι [ἀντί.] 3 sing. aor. ἤντετο Il. 4.133, Il. 16.788, Il. 20.415, Il. 22.203. Fem. pple. ἀντομένη Il. 8.412, Il. 11.237. Pl. ἀντόμεναι Il. 2.595. Infin. ἄντεσθαι Il. 15.698. (συν-.,) 1 To meet, encounter. With dat.: ἀλλήλοισιν Il. 15.698. Cf. Il. 16.788, Il. 22.203. Absol. Il. 2.595, Il. 8.412. Of a weapon. With dat.: ἀργύρῳ Il. 11.237. 2 Of the front and back plates of the θώρηξ, to meet and overlap Il. 4.133 = Il. 20.415.

a)/xqomai.head: ἄχθομαι
a)/xqomai.html: ἄχθομαι [ἄχθος.] 1 Of a ship, to be laden, have her cargo on board Od. 15.457. 2 To be weighed down, be in pain or grief: ὀδύνῃσιν Il. 5.354, ἕλκος (app. acc. of part affected, in the wound) 361, κῆρ (in his heart) Il. 11.274 = 400. With pple. in acc. expressing the cause of grief: ἤχθετο Ἀργείους] δαμναμένους Il. 13.352.

au)ti/ka.head: αὐτίκα
au)ti/ka.html: αὐτίκα Forthwith, straightway, at once: αὐ. ἆλτο χαμᾶζε Il. 3.29. Cf. Il. 1.118, 199, 539, Il. 2.322, etc.: αὐ. μνηστῆρας ἐπῴχετο Od. 1.324. Cf. Od. 2.367, 379, Od. 3.54, 448, etc.

ai)olomi/trhs.head: αἰολομίτρης
ai)olomi/trhs.html: αἰολομίτρης [αἰόλος + μίτρη.] With glancing μίτρη Il. 5.707.

a)podu/w.head: ἀποδύω
a)podu/w.html: ἀποδύω ἀποδύνω [ἀπο- 1.] 3 sing. aor. ἀπέδυσε Il. 4.532, Il. 18.83. Aor. pple. ἀποδύς Od. 5.343. 1 In sigmatic aor., to strip off: τεύχεα Il. 4.532, Il. 18.83. 2 In impf. and non-sigmatic aor., to divest oneself of Od. 5.343, Od. 22.364.

a)mallodeth/r.head: ἀμαλλοδετήρ
a)mallodeth/r.html: ἀμαλλοδετήρ -ῆρος [ἄμαλλα, sheaf + δέω.] A binder of sheaves Il. 18.553, 554.

ai)gai/wn.head: Αἰγαίων
ai)gai/wn.html: Αἰγαίων A hundred-handed being called by the gods Βριάρεως. Saved Zeus from bonds Il. 1.403, 404.

a)popau/w.head: ἀποπαύω
a)popau/w.html: ἀποπαύω [ἀπο- 7.] 1 a To stop (a person) in his course Il. 18.267. To stop the operation of, curb: μένος Il. 21.340. To delay: τόκον Il. 19.119. b To cause to cease (from something). With genit.: πολέμου Il. 11.323. With infin.: ἀλητεύειν Od. 18.114. c To restrain from doing something. With infin.: ὁρμηθῆναι Od. 12.126. 2 In mid., to desist, give over Il. 5.288, Il. 21.372. With genit.: πολέμου Il. 1.422. Cf. Il. 8.473, Il. 16.721: Od. 1.340.

a)/mhtos.head: ἄμητος
a)/mhtos.html: ἄμητος ὁ [as ἀμητήρ.] A harvest Il. 19.223.

a)gxi/alos.head: ἀγχίαλος
a)gxi/alos.html:
ἀγχίαλος -ον [ἄγχι + ἅλς1.] By the sea Il. 2.640, 697.
Ἀγχίαλος-1 Greek. (εἰδὼς χάρμης). With his brother Menesthes killed by Hector Il. 5.609.
Ἀγχίαλος-2 (δαΐφρων). Father of Mentes-2 Od. 1.180, 418.
Ἀγχίαλος-3. A Phaeacian Od. 8.112 .

a)rgike/raunos.head: ἀργικέραυνος
a)rgike/raunos.html: ἀργικέραυνος [ἀργός + κεραυνός.] (Wielder, the wielder) of the bright thunderbolt. Epithet or a name of Zeus Il. 19.121, Il. 20.16, Il. 22.178.

a)mfi/falos.head: ἀμφίφαλος
a)mfi/falos.html: ἀμφίφαλος -ον [ἀμφι- 2 + θάλος.] With two θάλοι: κυνέην Il. 5.743 = Il. 11.41.

a)/graulos.head: ἄγραυλος
a)/graulos.html: ἄγραυλος -ον [ἀγρός + αὐλή.] Dwelling in the fields: βοός Il. 10.155, Il. 17.521, Il. 23.684, 780, Il. 24.81, ποιμένες Il. 18.162: πόιες Od. 10.410, βοός Od. 12.253, Od. 22.403.

a)pathlo/s.head: ἀπατηλός
a)pathlo/s.html: ἀπατηλός [as ἀπατήλιος.] = ἀπατήλιος.: οὐκ ἐμὸν ἀπατηλόν (nothing that comes from me bears deceit) Il. 1.526.

a)/gonos.head: ἄγονος
a)/gonos.html: ἄγονος [ἀ-1 + γόνος.] App., unborn Il. 3.40.

a)mfige/neia.head: Ἀμφιγένεια
a)mfige/neia.html: Ἀμφιγένεια A town of Pylus Il. 2.593 .

a)nh/kestos.head: ἀνήκεστος
a)nh/kestos.html: ἀνήκεστος [ἀ-1 + ἀκεσ-, ἀκέομαι.] Not to be cured or soothed Il. 5.394. Not to be appeased Il. 15.217.

a)mitroxi/twnes.head: ἀμιτροχίτωνες
a)mitroxi/twnes.html: ἀμιτροχίτωνες [ἀ-1 + μίτρη + χιτών.] Wearing no μίτρη with the χιτών, not wearing theμίτρη Il. 16.419.

a)groiw/ths.head: ἀγροιώτης
a)groiw/ths.html: ἀγροιώτης -ου [ἀγρός. Cf. ἀγρότης.] Of the country, rustic: ἀνέρες Il. 11.549 = Il. 15.272, λαοί Il. 11.676: βουκόλοι Od. 11.293. Absol., a rustic or boor: νήπιοι ἀγροιῶται Od. 21.85.

a(losu/dnh.head: ἁλοσύδνη
a(losu/dnh.html: ἁλοσύδνη -ης [sense unknown. Traditionally explained as 'daughter of the sea' (ἅλς1).] Of Thetis Il. 20.207. Of Amphitrite Od. 4.404.

a)nemw/reia.head: Ἀνεμώρεια
a)nemw/reia.html: Ἀνεμώρεια A town of Phocis Il. 2.521.

a)nti/maxos.head: Ἀντίμαχος
a)nti/maxos.html: Ἀντίμαχος (δαΐφρων). Father of Hippolochus-2, Peisandrus-1 and Hippomachus. Corrupted by Paris opposed the restoration of Helen Il. 11.123, 132, 138; Il. 12.188.

a)mfistrata/omai.head: †ἀμφιστρατάομαι
a)mfistrata/omai.html: †ἀμφιστρατάομαι [ἀμφι- 3.] 3 pl. impf. ἀμφεστρατόωντο. To be established round, besiege. With acc.: θρυόεσσαν Il. 11.713.

a)e/khti.head: ἀέκητι
a)e/khti.html: ἀέκητι [ἀέκων.] With genit. 1 Against the will of, without the good will of: θεῶν ἀ. Il. 12.8. Cf. Il. 15.720: Od. 3.28, Od. 4.504, 665, Od. 5.177, Od. 6.240, 287, Od. 12.290, Od. 17.43, Od. 24.444. Joined with ἀντία: ἀντίʼ ἀθανάτων ἀ. θεῶν Od. 1.79. 2 Doing violence to the will of, doing despite to: ἀ. σέθεν Od. 3.213, Od. 16.94, σεῦ ἀ. Od. 15.19. In spite of the resistance of: Ἀργείων ἀ. Il. 11.667.

a)spi/s.head: ἀσπίς
a)spi/s.html: ἀσπίς -ίδος, ἡ. A shield Il. 2.382, Il. 3.347, Il. 4.448, Il. 5.437, Il. 13.131, etc.: Od. 1.256, Od. 19.32, Od. 22.25.

a)fauro/s.head: ἀφαυρός
a)fauro/s.html: ἀφαυρός 1 Powerless, feeble: παιδός Il. 7.235. In comp.: σέο ἀφαυρότερος Il. 7.457. In superl.: ἀφαυρότατος Ἀχαιῶν Il. 15.11. Cf. Od. 20.110. 2 Of a missile, ineffective. In comp.: ἵνα μή οἱ ἀφαυρότερον βέλος εἴη Il. 12.458 (μὴ ἀ. = the more effective, being comp. in dependent form of οὐκ ἀφαυρός, which by litotes = effective).

a)pto/lemos.head: ἀπτόλεμος
a)pto/lemos.html: ἀπτόλεμος [ἀ-1.] Unwarlike Il. 2.201, Il. 9.35, 41.

a)pole/pw.head: †ἀπολέπω
a)pole/pw.html: †ἀπολέπω [ἀπο- 1.] Fut. infin. ἀπολεψέμεν. To slice off: οὔατα Il. 21.455.

ai)po/los.head: αἰπόλος
ai)po/los.html: αἰπόλος -ου, ὁ [app. for αἰγιπόλος, fr. αἰγ-, αἴξ + -πολος, conn. with πολεύω.] A goatherd Il. 2.474, Il. 4.275: Od. 17.247 = Od. 22.135, Od. 17.369, Od. 20.173, Od. 21.175, 265, Od. 22.142, 161, 182.

a(limurh/eis.head: ἁλιμυρήεις
a(limurh/eis.html: ἁλιμυρήεις -εντος [ἅλς1 + μύρω.] Seaward flowing Il. 21.190. Of a river at its meeting with the sea Od. 5.460.

ai)/.head: αἴ
ai)/.html: αἴ [cf. εἰ.] 1 αἲ γάρ with opt. expressing a wish = εἰ 2..b: αἲ γάρ μή τις φύγοι Il. 16.97. Cf. Il. 4.288, Il. 10.536, Il. 18.272, 464, Il. 22.346, 454: αἲ γὰρ δύναμιν περιθεῖεν Od. 3.205. Cf. Od. 4.341, Od. 6.244, Od. 8.339, Od. 9.523, Od. 15.156, 536, Od. 17.132, 163, 251, Od. 18.235, Od. 19.22, 309, Od. 20.169, 236, Od. 21.200, 402. Of the present: αἲ γὰρ ἡβῷμι Il. 7.132. Cf. Il. 2.371, Il. 4.189: Od. 4.697, Od. 16.99, Od. 21.372. See also αἴθε 1. With infin.: αἲ γὰρ παῖδʼ ἐμὴν ἐχέμεν Od. 7.311. Cf. Od. 24.376. 2 With fut. indic. and κεν, subj. and κεν, and opt. and κεν in the protasis of conditional sentences = εἰ 5. For the examples and constructions see Table at end (III). 3 In final clauses, if haply, in the hope that. With subj. and κεν = εἰ 9.b.β: σπεύδειν αἴ κʼ ὄφελος γενώμεθα Il. 13.236. Cf. Il. 1.66 (reading βούλητʼ (the indic. cannot be explained)), 207, 408, 420, Il. 2.72, 83, Il. 6.94, 275, 277, 281, 309, Il. 7.243, Il. 8.282, Il. 9.172, Il. 10.55, Il. 11.797, 799, Il. 12.275, Il. 13.743, Il. 16.41, 725, Il. 17.121, Il. 18.143, 199, 213, 457, Il. 21.293, Il. 23.82, Il. 24.116, 301, 357: Od. 1.279, 379, Od. 2.144, Od. 3.92, Od. 4.34, 322, Od. 12.215, Od. 13.182, Od. 15.312, Od. 17.51, 60, Od. 22.7, 252. 4 In object clauses, whether. a With subj. and κεν = εἰ 10 b.β: πειρήσομαι αἴ κε τύχωμι (and see whether . . .) Il. 5.279, εἰπέμεναι ἔπος αἴ κʼ ἐθέλωσιν (i.e. ask if they will agree) Il. 7.375, πειρήσεται αἴ κε θέῃσιν (to see whether . . .) Il. 18.601. Cf. Il. 4.249, Il. 7.394, Il. 11.791, Il. 17.652, 692, Il. 19.71, Il. 20.436: εἰπέ μοι, αἴ κε γνώω (that I may see whether . . .) Od. 14.118. Cf. Od. 2.186, Od. 24.217. b With opt. and κεν = εἰ 10 c.β: εἰπεῖν αἴ κέ περ ὔμμι φίλον γένοιτο (and see whether . . .) Il. 7.387.

a)leei/nw.head: ἀλεείνω
a)leei/nw.html: ἀλεείνω [cf. ἀλέομαι.] 1 To escape, evade, avoid, keep out of the way, reach or influence of, avoid incurring (something coming upon or threatening one): κῆρα Il. 3.32 = Il. 11.585 = Il. 13.566 = 596 = 648 = Il. 14.408, Il. 16.817. Cf. Il. 11.794, Il. 13.669, Il. 16.36, 213 = Il. 23.713, Il. 17.374: χόλον γυναικός Od. 1.433. Cf. Od. 5.326, Od. 6.273, Od. 13.148, Od. 19.373, Od. 24.229. 2 To elude the notice of Od. 16.477. Absol., to evade questioning Od. 4.251. 3 To shun, avoid, keep clear of or away from: πάτον ἀνθρώπων Il. 6.202. Cf. Il. 11.542, Il. 23.422. 4 With infin., to shrink from doing, hesitate to do: κτεῖναι Il. 6.167, ἀλεξέμεναι Il. 13.356.

au)to/qen.head: αὐτόθεν
au)to/qen.html: αὐτόθεν [αὐτός + -θενn(1).] 1 From the place in which one is. With complementary words: αὐ. ἐξ ἕδρης Il. 19.77. Cf. Od. 13.56, Od. 21.420. 2 On the spot, at once Il. 20.120.

ai)gupio/s.head: αἰγυπιός
ai)gupio/s.html: αἰγυπιός -οῦ, ὁ. App. a general name for eagles and vultures. (The αἰ. preys on live birds (Il. 17.460: Od. 22.302), but is not represented as preying on carrion. Cf. γύψ.) Il. 7.59, Il. 13.531, Il. 16.428, Il. 17.460: Od. 16.217, Od. 22.302.

a)naple/w.head: ἀναπλέω
a)naple/w.html: ἀναπλέω [ἀνα- 1, ἀνα- 5.] Fut. infin. in mid. form ἀναπλεύσεσθαι Il. 11.22. 1 To sail upwards. Of a voyage from Greece to Troy Il. 11.22. 2 To sail through, traverse. With acc.: στεινωπόν Od. 12.234.

a(/ptw.head: ἅπτω
a(/ptw.html: ἅπτω Aor. pple. ἅψας Od. 21.408. 3 sing. fut. mid. ἅψεται Od. 19.344. Infin. ἅψεσθαι Od. 9.379. 3 sing. aor. ἥψατο Il. 1.512, Il. 5.799, Il. 15.76, 704. ἅψατο Il. 23.666. 3 dual ἁψάσθην Il. 10.377. Pple. ἁψάμενος, -ου Il. 10.455, Il. 23.584, Il. 24.357, 508: Od. 9.386. Fem. -η Od. 11.278, Od. 19.473. Infin. ἅψασθαι Il. 21.65: Od. 6.169, Od. 19.348, Od. 22.339. (ἀν-, ἐξ-, ἐφ-, καθ-, προτι-.) 1 To fasten Od. 21.408. In mid. Od. 11.278. 2 In mid. a To fasten oneself to; hence, to lay hold of, seize, clasp, touch. With genit.: ἥψατο γούνων Il. 1.512. Cf. Il. 2.152, 171, 358, Il. 5.799, Il. 8.339, Il. 10.377, 455, Il. 15.76, 704, Il. 16.9, 577, Il. 20.468, Il. 21.65, Il. 23.584, 666, Il. 24.357, 508, 712: σίτου Od. 4.60. Cf. Od. 2.423, Od. 6.169, Od. 10.379, Od. 15.288, Od. 19.28, 344, 348, 473, Od. 22.339. Without construction: κύνει ἁπτόμενος ἥν πατρίδα Od. 4.522. Cf. Od. 9.386. b Of missile weapons (as if personified), to seize their object, work mischief: βέλεʼ ἥπτετο Il. 8.67 = Il. 11.85 = Il. 15.319 = Il. 16.778. Cf. Il. 17.631. c To catch fire Od. 9.379.

a)ra/omai.head: ἀράομαι
a)ra/omai.html: ἀράομαι [ἀρή1.] 2 sing. aor. subj. αἀρήσῃ Il. 13.818. Non-thematic pres. infin. in act. form αἀρήμεναι Od. 22.322. (κατ-.) 1 To pray. With dat.: μητρὶ ἠρήσατο Il. 1.351. Cf. Il. 1.35, Il. 6.115, Il. 9.172, Il. 17.568, etc.: Od. 4.761, Od. 6.323, Od. 12.337, Od. 13.355. Absol. Il. 3.318, Il. 5.114, etc.: Od. 3.62, 64, Od. 7.1. With complementary infin.: φανήμεναι Ἠῶ Il. 9.240. Cf. Il. 4.143, Il. 13.286, Il. 23.209: Od. 1.164, 366 = Od. 18.213, Od. 4.827, Od. 19.533, Od. 22.322. With dat. and infin. Il. 13.818: Od. 18.176. With dependent clause: ἧος ἵκοιο γῆρας Od. 19.367. 2 To invoke: ἐρινῦς Od. 2.135. 3 To vow. With infin.: κόμην σοι κερέειν Il. 23.144. Absol. Il. 23.149.

a)maxhti/.head: ἀμαχητί
a)maxhti/.html: ἀμαχητί [ἀ-1 + μάχη.] Without a fight Il. 21.437.

a)nemotrefh/s.head: ἀνεμοτρεφής
a)nemotrefh/s.html: ἀνεμοτρεφής -ές [ἄνεμος + τρέφω.] Of a wave, fed (i. e. raised) by the wind Il. 15.625. Of a spear, (made of wood) toughened by (the buffeting of) the wind Il. 11.256.

a)napi/mplhmi.head: †ἀναπίμπλημι
a)napi/mplhmi.html: †ἀναπίμπλημι [ἀνα- 6.] Fut. infin. ἀναπλήσειν Od. 5.302. 2 sing. aor. subj. ἀναπλήσῃς Il. 4.170. Pple. ἀναπλήσας, -αντος Il. 8.34, 354, 465, Il. 11.263, Il. 15.132. Infin. ἀναπλῆσαι Od. 5.207. To fulfil (one's destiny), have full measure of (misery etc.): πότμον Il. 4.170, Il. 11.263. Cf. Il. 8.34 = 354 = 465, Il. 15.132: κήδεα Od. 5.207. Cf. Od. 5.302.

a)pth/n.head: ἀπτήν
a)pth/n.html: ἀπτήν -ῆνος [ἀ-1 + πτη-, πέτομαι.] Unfledged: ἀπτῆσι νεοσσοῖσιν Il. 9.323.

a)famarta/nw.head: †ἀφαμαρτάνω
a)famarta/nw.html: †ἀφαμαρτάνω [ἀφ-, ἀπο- 7.] 3 sing. aor. ἀφάμαρτε Il. 8.119, 302, Il. 11.350, Il. 13.160, Il. 14.403, Il. 16.322, Il. 21.171, 591, Il. 22.290. 3 sing. aor. ἀπήμβροτε Il. 15.521, Il. 16.466, 477. Dat. sing. fem. pple. ἀφαμαρτούσῃ Il. 6.411. 1 To discharge a missile vainly, miss one's aim: οὐδʼ ἀφάμαρτε Il. 11.350, Il. 13.160, Il. 14.403, Il. 16.322, Il. 21.591, Il. 22.290, ἀπήμβροτε δουρί Il. 16.477. 2 To fail to hit, miss. With genit.: τοῦ Il. 8.119, 302, Il. 15.521, Il. 21.171, αὐτοῦ Il. 16.466. 3 To lose, be deprived of. With genit.: σεῦ Il. 6.411.

ai)qh/r.head: αἰθήρ
ai)qh/r.html: αἰθήρ -έρος, ἡ. 1 The upper air, in which the clouds float and the meteorological phenomena take place: ἐν αἰθέρι καὶ νεφέλῃσιν Il. 15.20. Cf. Il. 8.556, 558 = Il. 16.300, Il. 11.54, Il. 15.686, Il. 16.365, Il. 18.207, 214, Il. 19.379: οὖρον ἐπαιγίζοντα διʼ αἰθέρος Od. 15.293. Cf. Od. 19.540. Regarded as the home and realm of Zeus: αἰθέρι ναίων Il. 2.412. Cf. Il. 4.166, Il. 13.837, Il. 14.258, Il. 15.192, 610: Od. 15.523. As the way to or from heaven: αἴγλη διʼ αἰθέρος οὐρανὸν ἷκεν Il. 2.458. Cf. Il. 17.425, Il. 19.351 : ἐξ αἰθέρος ἔμπεσε πόντῳ Od. 5.50 (on the way from Olympus). 2 Clear air as opposed to mist (ἀήρ) : ἐλάτη διʼ ἠέρος αἰθέρʼ ἵκανεν Il. 14.288, πολέμιζον ὑπʼ αἰθέρι Il. 17.371 (cf. 368).

a(/lis.head: ἅλις
a(/lis.html: ἅλις (ϝάλις) [ἀλ-, (ϝ)είλω.] 1 In a throng, in swarms: μέλισσαι ἁ. πεποτήαται Il. 2.90. Cf. Il. 3.384, Il. 22.473. 2 In abundance, in plenty, in great numbers: ἁ. οἱ ἦσαν ἄρουραι Il. 14.122. Cf. Il. 9.137, 279, Il. 17.54, Il. 21.236, 319, 344, 352, Il. 22.340: χαλκὸν ἁ. δόντες Od. 5.38 = Od. 23.341. Cf. Od. 2.339, Od. 7.295, Od. 13.136 = Od. 16.231, Od. 15.77 = 94, Od. 16.389 (with notion of excess), Od. 17.298, 376, Od. 24.486. 3 With copula to be supplied, (it is) enough: ἦ οὐχ ἁ. ὅττι . . .; Il. 5.349, Il. 23.670. Cf. Il. 9.376, Il. 17.450: Od. 2.312.

a)kri/s.head: ἀκρίς
a)kri/s.html: ἀκρίς -ίδος, ἡ. A locust Il. 21.12.

a)nqe/ric.head: ἀνθέριξ
a)nqe/ric.html: ἀνθέριξ -ικος. App., the stalk of corn: ἐπʼ ἀνθερίκων καρπὸν θέον (the ears of the corn) Il. 20.227.

a)xe/w.head: ἀχέω
a)xe/w.html: ἀχέω [ἄχος.] 3 sing. aor. ἤκαχε Il. 16.822: Od. 15.357, Od. 16.427. 3 pl. aor. mid. ἀκάχοντο Od. 16.342. Opt. ἀκαχοίμην Od. 1.236. 3 sing. -οιτο Il. 8.207, Il. 13.344. 1 pl. -οίμεθα Il. 16.16. 1 In aor. act., to cause to grieve, grieve, trouble Il. 16.822: Od. 15.357. To molest, harry: Θεσπρωτούς Od. 16.427. 2 In pres. pple. act. and aor. mid., to be grieved or troubled, be in grief or trouble, grieve, sorrow: κῆρ ἀχέων (in his heart) Il. 5.399. Cf. Il. 2.724, Il. 8.207, Il. 13.344: μνηστῆρες ἀκάχοντο Od. 16.342. Cf. Od. 11.195, Od. 15.361. With genit. of what is grieved for: Βρισηΐδος Il. 2.694. Cf. Il. 9.567, Il. 16.16, Il. 18.446. With dat.: θανόντι Od. 1.236.

a(martoeph/s.head: ἁμαρτοεπής
a(martoeph/s.html: ἁμαρτοεπής [ἁμαρτάνω + ἔπος. Cf. ἁμαρτοεπής.] Stumbling in speech. In voc. ἁμαρτοεπές Il. 13.824.

a(palotrefh/s.head: ἁπαλοτρεφής
a(palotrefh/s.html: ἁπαλοτρεφής [ἁπαλός + τρέφω.] So fed as to be ἁπαλός, well-fed, plump: σιάλοιο Il. 21.363.

a)oidh/.head: ἀοιδή
a)oidh/.html: ἀοιδή -ῆς, ἡ [ἀείδω.] 1 A song or lay Od. 1.328, 340, 351, Od. 8.499, Od. 12.44, 183, 198, Od. 24.197. A dirge or lament: στονόεσσαν Il. 24.721. 2 A subject of song: ἐσσομένοισι ἀοιδήν Od. 3.204. Cf. Od. 8.580, Od. 24.200. 3 Singing: ταῦσαν ἀοιδῆς Il. 2.595: κίθαρις καὶ ἀ. Od. 1.159. Cf. Od. 1.421 = Od. 18.304, Od. 8.429, Od. 17.605. 4 The art of song: μοῦσαι ἀοιδὴν ἀφέλοντο Il. 2.599. Cf. Il. 13.731: Od. 8.44, 64, 253, 498, Od. 21.406.

a)ntifa/ths.head: Ἀντιφάτης-1
a)ntifa/ths.html:
Ἀντιφάτης-1 Trojan. killed by Leonteus Il. 12.191.
Ἀντιφάτης-2 (κλυτός), also called Λάμος (Od. 10.81). The king of the Laestrygonians Od. 10.81, 106, 114, 199.
Ἀντιφάτης-3 (κραταιός). Son of Melampus and father of Oicles Od. 15.242, 243.

a)nti/fonos.head: Ἀντίφονος
a)nti/fonos.html: Ἀντίφονος A son of Priam (his mother not named) Il. 24.250.

a)nagkai=os.head: ἀναγκαῖος
a)nagkai=os.html: ἀναγκαῖος -η, -ον [ἀνάγκη.] 1 Compelled, acting under compulsion: πολεμισταί Od. 24.499. Sim. of slaves Od. 24.210. 2 Imposing compulsion: ἦμαρ ἀναγκαῖον (see ἦμαρ 4.b) Il. 16.836, μύθῳ Od. 17.399 = Od. 20.344.–χρειοῖ ἀναγκαίῃ, by compelling necessity, under the compulsion of necessityIl. 8.57.

a)po/llumi.head: ἀπόλλυμι
a)po/llumi.html: ἀπόλλυμι [ἀπ-, ἀπο- 7.] A Aor. ἀπώλεσα Il. 18.82: Od. 2.46, Od. 4.95, 724, 814. 3 sing. -ε Il. 5.648, 758, Il. 18.460, Il. 24.44, 260: Od. 1.354, Od. 9.265. 3 pl. -αν Il. 23.280. ἀπόλεσσαν Il. 1.268. B 3 sing. pf. ἀπόλωλε Il. 15.129: Od. 1.166, Od. 4.62, 511, Od. 14.137, Od. 19.85. Mid. 3 sing. pa. iterative ἀπολέσκετο Od. 11.586. 2 sing. aor. ἀπώλεο Od. 11.556. 3 sing. -ετο Il. 6.223: Od. 1.413, Od. 3.87, Od. 17.253. 1 pl. -όμεθα Od. 9.303, Od. 10.27, Od. 11.438, Od. 24.186. 3 pl. ἀπόλοντο Il. 2.162, 178: Od. 3.185, Od. 4.497, Od. 11.384. 3 sing. subj. ἀπόληται Od. 2.333. 3 pl. -ωνται Il. 21.459. Opt. ἀπολοίμην Il. 22.304: Od. 17.426. 3 sing. -οιτο Il. 5.311, 388, Il. 6.170, Il. 14.142, Il. 18.107: Od. 1.47. 3 pl. -οίατο Od. 9.554. 3 sing. imp. ἀπολέσθω Il. 17.227. Infin. ἀπολέσθαι Il. 1.117, Il. 3.40, Il. 7.390, Il. 8.246, etc.: Od. 3.234, Od. 5.347, Od. 8.511, 563. I In aor. act. 1 a To destroy, kill, slay Il. 1.268, Il. 5.758, Il. 24.260. b To destroy, lay waste (a city) Il. 5.648. 2 a To lose, be deprived of : Πάτροκλον Il. 18.82. Cf. Il. 23.280: νόστιμον ἦμαρ Od. 1.354. Cf. Od. 2.46, Od. 4.724 = 814. b To incur the loss of under one's leadership, lose, throw away: λαοὺς πολλούς Od. 9.265. To lose to the foe: θώρηκα Il. 18.460. c To incur the laying waste of: οἷκον Od. 4.95. d To lose sense of, put out of one's heart: ἔλεον Il. 24.44. II In pf. act. and in mid. and pas. 1 To be destroyed, perish, die: πολλοὶ ἀπόλοντο Il. 2.162 = 178. Cf. Il. 1.117, Il. 3.40, Il. 5.311, 388, Il. 6.170, 223, Il. 7.27, 390, Il. 8.246, Il. 12.70 = Il. 13.227 = Il. 14.70, Il. 12.246, Il. 14.142, Il. 15.502, 511, Il. 17.227, Il. 21.459, Il. 22.304, 474, Il. 23.81: οὐ γένος ἀπόλωλεν Od. 4.62. Cf. Od. 1.47, Od. 2.333, Od. 3.185, 234, Od. 4.497, 511, Od. 5.347, Od. 8.511, 563, Od. 9.554, Od. 11.384, 438, 556, Od. 14.137, Od. 19.85, Od. 24.186. With cognate acc.: ἀπόλωλε κακὸν μόρον Od. 1.166. Cf. Od. 3.87, Od. 9.303. To be undone Od. 10.27, Od. 17.426. 2 Of inanimate objects, to be destroyed: ἀπολέσθαι νῆας Il. 9.230. Cf. Od. 9.554. Of water, to vanish away, elude one Od. 11.586. 3 Of mental faculties, to perish, disappear: νόος ἀπόλωλε καὶ αἰδώς Il. 15.129. So of abstractions: ὡς ἔρις ἀπόλοιτο Il. 18.107. Cf. Od. 1.413, Od. 17.253. 4 Of fruit, to perish (untimely): οὔ ποτε καρπὸς ἀπόλλυται Od. 7.117.

a)mbola/dhn.head: ἀμβολάδην
a)mbola/dhn.html: ἀμβολάδην [ἀμβολ-, ἀμβάλλω. See ἀμβλήδην.] Spirting up: λέβης ζεῖ ἀ. Il. 21.364.

ai)/glh.head: αἴγλη
ai)/glh.html: αἴγλη -ης, ἡ. 1 The light of the sun or moon Od. 4.45 = Od. 7.84. 2 Radiance, brightness Od. 6.45. The gleam of polished metal Il. 2.458, Il. 19.362.

ai)/qe.head: αἴθε
ai)/qe.html: αἴθε [cf. εἴθε.] Expressing a wish. 1 With opt. : αἰ. θεοῖσι φίλος γένοιτο Il. 22.41. Cf. Il. 4.178 : αἰ. τελευτήσειεν Od. 7.331. Cf. Od. 14.440 = Od. 15.341, Od. 17.494, Od. 18.202, Od. 20.61. Of the present: αἰ. τόσον σέο φέρτερος εἴην (would that I were . . .) Il. 16.722. 2 With ὤφελλον, ὤφελον, ὄφελον. See ὀφέλλω1 4.

a)/narxos.head: ἄναρχος
a)/narxos.html: ἄναρχος [ἀν- 1 + ἀρχός.] Leaderless Il. 2.703 = 726.

au)th=mar.head: αὐτῆμαρ
au)th=mar.html: αὐτῆμαρ [αὐτός + ἦμαρ.] 1 On the same day, on that day Il. 18.454: Od. 3.311. 2 For that day Il. 1.81.

ai)gi/s.head: αἰγίς
ai)gi/s.html: αἰγίς -ίδος, ἡ [perh. the orig. idea was that of a storm-cloud, whence the sense hurricane-wind. Cf. ἐπαιγίζω.] The terror-striking shield of Zeus Il. 4.167, Il. 17.593. Wielded by Athene Il. 2.447, Il. 5.738, Il. 21.400: Od. 22.297. By Apollo Il. 15.229, 308, 318, 361. Lent by Athene to Achilles Il. 18.204. Used to cover Hector's corpse Il. 24.20.

ai)pu/tios.head: Αἰπύτιος
ai)pu/tios.html: Αἰπύτιος Adj. from Αἴπυτος, son of Elatus, an Arcadian Il. 2.604 (Αἰπύτιον παρὰ τύμβον).

a)gorh/.head: ἀγορή
a)gorh/.html: ἀγορή -ῆς, ἡ [ἀγείρω.] 1 A general assembly (cf. βουλή 1) Il. 2.95, 808, Il. 4.400, Il. 8.2, Il. 9.33, Il. 15.283, Il. 18.106, Il. 19.34, etc.: Od. 1.90, Od. 2.26, 257, Od. 3.127, 137, Od. 4.818, Od. 9.112, etc. In pl., of a single assembly: ἀγορὰς ἀγόρευον Il. 2.788. 2 In pl., speaking in the assembly: ἔσχʼ ἀγοράων Il. 2.275. 3 The place of assembly (app. used also as a place of judgment (cf. ἀγορῆθεν) and no doubt for other public purposes) Il. 1.490, Il. 2.93, Il. 7.382, 414, Il. 9.13, Il. 11.139, 807, Il. 16.387, Il. 18.245, 274, 497, Il. 19.45, 88, 173, 249: Od. 2.10, 37, 150, Od. 6.266, Od. 8.12, 109, 503, Od. 10.114, Od. 16.361, 377, Od. 17.52, Od. 20.146, 362, Od. 24.420. In pl., app. of a single place: ἔμπληντʼ ἀγοραί Od. 8.16. Cf. Od. 7.44.

a)mfi/s.head: ἀμφίς
a)mfi/s.html: ἀμφίς [ἀμφί.] I Adv. 1 On both sides: ᾧ ῥόπαλʼ ἀ. ἐάγῃ (i.e. across his back) Il. 11.559, δούρασιν ἀ. [βάλεν] (with spears from both hands, with both spears at once) Il. 21.162. 2 A part, asunder: ἀ. φράζονται (have different views) Il. 2.13 = 30 = 67, ἔχουσα ἀ. (one in each scale) Il. 12.434, τόξων ἀϊκὰς ἀ. μένον (at a safe distance) Il. 15.709, ἀ. ἀρωγοί (partisans, some of one, some of the other) Il. 18.502, ἀ. ἀριζήλω (standing out from the others) 519, ἀ. ἄλλʼ ἀποδάσσεσθαι (in addition) Il. 22.117, ἀ. ὁδοῦ Il. 23.393 (see ὁδός 1). Cf. Il. 13.345, 706: ζυγὸν ἀ. ἔχοντες (supporting it at either end) Od. 3.486 = Od. 15.184, τιμὴν ἀ. ἄγοντες (in addition) Od. 22.57. Cf. Od. 1.54. 3 Absent: ἀ. ἐόντα Od. 24.218. Sim. of separation from a person Od. 19.221. 4 Between: ὀλίγη ἦν ἀ. ἄρουρα (between the heaps or rows) Il. 3.115. 5 Round, about: τάθρος ἀ. ἐοῦσα (surrounding) Il. 7.342, τάρταρος ἀ. [ἐστιν] Il. 8.481. Cf. Il. 9.464, Il. 14.123, Il. 23.330, Il. 24.488: Od. 8.340, 476. II Prep. 1 With genit. a Apart from, at a distance from: διός Il. 8.444. Cf. Od. 14.352, Od. 16.267. b About, concerning: ἅρματος ἀ. ἰδών (seeing to it) Il. 2.384. 2 With dat., round, about: ἄξονι Il. 5.723. 3 With acc. a On each side of: δύο δʼ ἀ. ἕκαστον [δίθρον] (one on each side of each) Il. 11.748. b Round, about: ἕκαστον Il. 11.634. Cf. Il. 14.274, Il. 15.225: Od. 6.266, Od. 7.4, Od. 9.399.

a)gaphto/s.head: ἀγαπητός
a)gaphto/s.html: ἀγαπητός [ἀγαπάω.] Beloved, darling Il. 6.401: Od. 2.365, Od. 4.727, 817, Od. 5.18.

a)/cios.head: ἄξιος
a)/cios.html: ἄξιος 1 Worth, the equal or equivalent of. With genit.: οὐδʼ ἑνός Il. 8.234, πολέος οἱ ἄξιος ἔσται (he will find it a thing of price) Il. 23.562. Cf. Il. 15.719, Il. 23.885: ἄξιον ἔσται ἀμοιβῆς (will bring a (full) return) Od. 1.318. Cf. Od. 8.405. 2 Forming a suitable equivalent, suitable, sufficient, calculated to satisfy: ἄποινα Il. 6.46 = Il. 11.131. Cf. Il. 9.261: Od. 15.388 = 429. With infin.: προθοήνορος ἀντὶ πεφάσθαι Il. 14.472. 3 Absol. in neut. ἄξιον. a An equivalent or recompense: ἦ τι ἐΐσκομεν ἀ. εἶναι τρεῖς ἑνὸς ἀντὶ πεφάσθαι; Il. 13.446. b A suitable return: ἄξιόν κʼ ἄλφοι Od. 20.383.

a)a/zw.head: †*ἀάζω
a)a/zw.html: †*ἀάζω (ἀϝάζω) [ἀϝάτη, ἄτη.] 2 sing. aor. ἄ̆ᾰσας (ἄϝασας) Il. 21.237. 3 sing. ἄᾰσε Od. 21.296, 297. 3 pl. ἄᾱσαν Od. 10.68. Contr. 3 sing. ἆσε Od. 11.61. Mid. Aor. ἀ̄ᾰσάμην Il. 9.116, 119, Il. 19.137. 3 sing. ἀ̆ά̄σατο Il. 9.537. ἀ̄ά̄σατο Il. 11.340. Contr. ἄσατο Il. 19.95. Pass. Aor. ἆάσθην Il. 19.136. 3 sing. ἀ̆άσθη Il. 16.685, Il. 19.113: Od. 4.503, 509. Pple. ἀ̆ασθείς Od. 21.301. From ἀ(ϝ)άω 3 sing. pres. mid. ἀ̆ᾶται Il. 19.91, 129. 1 To smite with blindness of the mind, infatuate, make reckless Il. 21.237: Od. 10.68, Od. 11.61, Od. 21.296, 297. So in mid.: Ἄτη (Ἄτην) ἣ πάντας ἀᾶται Il. 19.91, 129. 2 In mid., to be so smitten, be made infatuated or reckless: ἀασάμην Il. 9.116, 119, Il. 19.137. Cf. Il. 9.537, Il. 11.340, Il. 19.95. So in pass.: μέγʼ ἀάσθη Il. 16.685. Cf. Il. 19.113, 136: Od. 4.503, 509, Od. 21.301.

a)/gkos.head: ἄγκος
a)/gkos.html: ἄγκος τό. A bend; hence, a glen or valley Il. 18.321, Il. 20.490, Il. 22.190: Od. 4.337 = Od. 17.128.

a)stra/galos.head: ἀστράγαλος
a)stra/galos.html: ἀστράγαλος -ου, ὁ. 1 One of the vertebrae of the neck Il. 14.466: Od. 10.560 = Od. 11.65. 2 In pl., a game played with the prepared bones, prob. similar to knuckle-bones Il. 23.88.

a)leci/kakos.head: ἀλεξίκακος
a)leci/kakos.html: ἀλεξίκακος -ον [ἀλέξω + κακόν. See κακός 11.] Tending to avert evil: μῆτις Il. 10.20.

au)da/w.head: αὐδάω
au)da/w.html: αὐδάω [αὐδή.] 3 sing. pa. iterative αὐδήσασκε Il. 5.786, Il. 17.420. (ἐξ-, μετ-, παρ-, προσ-.) 1 To speak: ηὔδα μάντις Il. 1.92, οὐδʼ ἔκλυον αὐδήσασντος (by word of mouth) Il. 10.47. Cf. Il. 16.76, Il. 17.420: Od. 3.337, Od. 4.505, Od. 9.497. Of shouting Il. 5.786. 2 To say, speak, utter: ἔπος Il. 6.54, Il. 10.377, Il. 11.379, Il. 12.163, etc., αὔδα ὅ τι φρονέεις Il. 14.195 = Il. 18.426: = Od. 5.89, ἔπος Od. 13.199. 3 To address (a person): τὸν (etc.) ἀντίον ηὔδα Il. 3.203, Il. 4.265, Il. 5.217, Il. 11.822, etc.: Od. 1.213, Od. 2.242, Od. 4.155, Od. 5.28, etc. 4 With double construction of (2) and (3): ἔπος μιν ἀντίον ηὔδα Il. 5.170.

a)/pastos.head: ἄπαστος
a)/pastos.html: ἄπαστος -ον [ἀ-1 + πασ-, πατέομαι.] Not partaking of food or drink Il. 19.346. With genit.: ἐδητύος ἀ. Od. 6.250. Cf. Od. 4.788.

a)/stude.head: ἄστυδε
a)/stude.html: ἄστυδε [ἄστυ + -δε 1.] To or towards the town or city Il. 18.255, Il. 24.778: Od. 6.296, Od. 10.104, Od. 15.503, Od. 16.331, Od. 17.5, Od. 19.190.

a)naqrw/|skw.head: ἀναθρῴσκω
a)naqrw/|skw.html: ἀναθρῴσκω [ἀνα- 1.] To leap or bound up. Of a stone: ἀναθρῴσκων πέτεται Il. 13.140.

ai)gai/.head: Αἰγαί
ai)gai/.html: Αἰγαί A seat of the worship of Poseidon of disputed site Od. 8.203, Il. 13.21: Od. 5.381.

a)/lgos.head: ἄλγος
a)/lgos.html: ἄλγος τό. 1 Pain, distress: ἀ. ἱκάνει θυμόν Il. 3.97. Cf. Il. 6.450, 462, Il. 18.395, Il. 22.53, 54: ὅπως μοι ἀ. ἀλάλκοις Od. 13.319. Cf. Od. 2.41, 193, Od. 15.345, Od. 19.471. 2 Definitely distinguished as bodily pain or suffering Il. 5.394: Od. 14.32. 3 In pl., distresses, woes, cares, hardships: Ἀχαιοῖς ἄλγεʼ ἔθηκεν Il. 1.2. Cf. Il. 2.667, Il. 9.321, Il. 13.346, Il. 18.224, Il. 24.568, etc.: πάθεν ἄλγεα Od. 1.4, ἄλγεσι θυμὸν ἐρέχθων Od. 5.83 (i.e. expressions of grief). Cf. Od. 2.343, Od. 3.220, Od. 8.182, Od. 20.339, etc.

a)gauo/s.head: ἀγαυός
a)gauo/s.html: ἀγαυός -ή [γαϝ-, γαίω.] Of persons, an epithet of general commendation, noble, illustrious, or the like: κήρυκες Il. 3.268. Cf. Il. 5.277, Il. 7.386, Il. 11.1, Il. 17.284, Il. 19.281, Il. 24.251, etc.: μνηστῆρες Od. 2.209. Cf. Od. 2.308, Od. 6.55, Od. 11.213, Od. 13.272, etc. In superl.: ἀγαυότατον ζωόντων Od. 15.229.

a)rabe/w.head: ἀραβέω
a)rabe/w.html: ἀραβέω [ἄραβος.] (ἀμφ-) To rattle, ring: τεύχεα Il. 4.504 = Il. 5.42 = 540 = Il. 13.187 = Il. 17.50 = 311, Il. 5.58, 294 = Il. 8.260: Od. 24.525.

a)kaxi/zw.head: ἀκαχίζω
a)kaxi/zw.html: ἀκαχίζω [cf. ἀκαχέω.] Imp. pass. ἀκαχίζευ Od. 11.486 1 To cause grief to, grieve, trouble, vex Od. 16.432. 2 In pass., to be grieved or troubled, grieve, sorrow: μὴ λίην ἀκαχίζεο Il. 6.486. Cf. Od. 11.486.

a)mfh/khs.head: ἀμφήκης
a)mfh/khs.html: ἀμφήκης Neut. ἄμφηκες. [ἀμφ-, ἀμφι- 2 + ἀκή, point, edge.] Two-edged Il. 10.256, Il. 21.118: Od. 16.80, Od. 8.341.

a)/kos.head: ἄκος
a)/kos.html: ἄκος τό. A cure or remedy Il. 9.250: Od. 22.481.

ai)su/mh.head: Αἰσύμη
ai)su/mh.html: Αἰσύμη A Paeonian town, or perhaps rather an unknown town of the Troad. The home of Castianeira. ὲξ Αἰσύμηθεν [-θεν], from Aesyme Il. 8.304 .

a)lqai/h.head: Ἀλθαίη
a)lqai/h.html: Ἀλθαίη Wife of Oeneus and mother of Tydeus and Meleagrus Il. 9.555. A brother of Althaea slain by Meleager and her curses thereupon Il. 9.565.

a)/aptos.head: ἄαπτος
a)/aptos.html: ἄαπτος -ον [app., with ἀ- for ἀ-1, fr. ἅπτω.] Thus, not to be touched, irresistible: χεῖρες (χεῖρας) Il. 1.567, Il. 21.450, Il. 11.169, Il. 13.49, Il. 20.503, etc.: Od. 11.502, Od. 22.70, 248.

a)rqme/w.head: ἀρθμέω
a)rqme/w.html: ἀρθμέω [ἀρθμός, friendship, alliance.] To form friendship or alliance Il. 7.302.

a)nqi/sthmi.head: †ἀνθίστημι
a)nqi/sthmi.html: †ἀνθίστημι [ἀνθ-, ἀντι- 2.] 3 sing. aor. ἀντέστη Il. 20.70, 72. 3 pl. impf. mid. ἀνθίσταντο Il. 16.305. In aor. and mid., to face in fight. With dat.: Ἥρῃ Il. 20.70, Λητοῖ 72. Absol., to make a stand Il. 16.305.

a)ktai/h.head: Ἀκταίη
a)ktai/h.html: Ἀκταίη A Nereid Il. 18.41 .

a)litai/nw.head: †ἀλιταίνω
a)litai/nw.html: †ἀλιταίνω 3 sing. aor. ἤλιτε Il. 9.375. Non-thematic pres. pple. mid. ἀλιτήμενος Od. 4.807. 3 pl. aor. ἀλίτοντο Od. 5.108. Subj. ἀλίτωμαι Il. 24.570. 3 sing. ἀλίτηται Il. 19.265, Il. 24.586. Infin. ἀλιτέσθαι Od. 4.378. 1 In both voices, to sin or trespass against, fail in duty to: ἤλιτέ με Il. 9.375. Cf. Il. 19.265: ἀθανάτους ἀλιτέσθαι Od. 4.378. Cf. Od. 5.108. 2 In mid., to transgress, infringe: Διὸς ἐφετμάς Il. 24.570, 586. 3 In pres. pple. mid. ἀλιτμενος in adjectival sense, sinning, sinful: θεοῖς (in the eyes of the gods) Od. 4.807.

a)/kris.head: ἄκρις
a)/kris.html: ἄκρις -ιος, ἡ [ἄκρος.] A hill-top: ἠνεμοέσσας Od. 9.400, Od. 16.365, διʼ ἄκριας Od. 10.281, Od. 14.2.

a)ti/zw.head: ἀτίζω
a)ti/zw.html: ἀτίζω [ἀ-1 + *τίζω = τίω.] To pay no heed Il. 20.166.

a)elpte/w.head: ἀελπτέω
a)elpte/w.html: ἀελπτέω (ἀϝελπτέω) [ἀ-1 + (ϝ)έλπω.] To despair: ἀελπτέοντες σόον εἶναι (pple. of the impf.: they had been in despair of his safety) Il. 7.310.

a)misw/daros.head: Ἀμισώδαρος
a)misw/daros.html: Ἀμισώδαρος Father of Atymnius and Maris. Reared the Chimaera Il. 16.328.

a)sklhpia/dhs.head: Ἀσκληπιάδης
a)sklhpia/dhs.html: Ἀσκληπιάδης Patronymic from next. Of Machaon Il. 4.204 , Il. 11.614, Il. 14.2.

a)/w.head: †ἄω
a)/w.html: †ἄω [ἀ-, ἁ-, (σ)α-. Cf. ἄδην, ἅδην and L. satis.] Infin. ἄμεναι Il. 21.70. Fut. infin. ἄσειν Il. 11.818. 3 sing. aor. subj. ἄσῃ Il. 18.281. Opt. ἄσαιμι Il. 9.489. Infin. ἆσαι Il. 5.289, Il. 11.574, Il. 15.317, Il. 20.78, Il. 21.168, Il. 22.267, Il. 23.157, Il. 24.211. 2 pl. fut. mid. ἄσεσθε Il. 24.717. Aor. infin. ἄσασθαι Il. 19.307. Also 1 pl. subj. ἕωμεν (disyllable) Il. 19.402, formed by metathesis of quantity fr. ἥομεν fr. ἡ- = (σ)α-. 1 To sate, satiate: κύνας Il. 11.818, Il. 24.211. To sate with, give a fill of. With genit.: αἵματος Il. 5.289 = Il. 20.78 = Il. 22.267. Cf. Il. 9.489, Il. 18.281. In mid. Il. 19.307. 2 To sate oneself with, take or have one's fill of. With genit.: χροός (of spears personified) Il. 11.574 = Il. 15.317, Il. 21.70, 168, πολέμοιο Il. 19.402, γόοιο Il. 23.157. In mid.: κλαυθμοῖο Il. 24.717.

a)kmo/qeton.head: ἀκμόθετον
a)kmo/qeton.html: ἀκμόθετον -ου, τό [ἄκμων + θε-, τίθημι.] An anvil-block Il. 18.410, 476: Od. 8.274.

a)/ge.head: ἄγε
a)/ge.html: ἄγε ἄγετε [imp. sing. and pl. of ἄγω used interjectionally.] Come! 1 ἄγε. a With imp. sing. or pl. Il. 3.192, Il. 9.673 = Il. 10.544: Od. 3.475, Od. 15.347, Od. 23.261. So ἄγε δή (cf. δή 1.a.β) Il. 8.139, Il. 24.407: Od. 2.349, Od. 19.16.–ἀλλʼ ἄγε (cf. ἀλλά 3) Il. 1.210, Il. 2.331, Il. 4.100, Il. 5.174, Il. 6.340, etc.: Od. 1.169, Od. 2.212, Od. 3.17, Od. 4.587, Od. 5.162, etc.– ἀλλʼ ἄγε δή Il. 21.221, Il. 23.313, Il. 24.137, etc.: Od. 7.162, Od. 8.492, Od. 10.333, Od. 12.298.–εἰ δ(ὴ) ἄγε (cf. εἰ1) Il. 1.302, Il. 6.376, Il. 9.167, Il. 16.667, etc.: Od. 1.271, Od. 2.178, Od. 4.832, Od. 12.112, Od. 22.391, Od. 23.35. Elliptically: δεῦρʼ ἄγε Od. 8.145, 205, Od. 12.184.– δεῦτʼ ἄγε Od. 8.11.– ἀλλʼ ἄγε δεῦρο Il. 11.314, Il. 17.179: Od. 9.517, Od. 11.561, Od. 22.233.– εἰ δʼ ἢ ἄγε δεῦρο Il. 17.685, Il. 23.581. b With 1 sing. subj., come, I will . . . : ἀλλʼ ἄγʼ ἐξείπω Il. 9.60. Cf. Od. 20.296, etc.– ἀλλʼ ἄγε δή Od. 13.215.– εἰ δʼ ἢ ἄγε Od. 9.37, Od. 24.336. c With 1 pl, come, let us . . .: ἄγε νῆʼ ἐρύσσομεν Il. 1.141. Cf. Il. 7.299, Il. 14.314, Il. 22.391.– ἀλλʼ ἄγε Il. 20.257, etc.: Od. 4.776, Od. 8.34, 389, Od. 10.44, Od. 13.13, 296, Od. 14.393, Od. 16.348, Od. 17.190.– ἀλλʼ ἄγε δή Il. 1.62, Il. 3.441, Il. 4.418, Il. 5.249, Il. 11.348, Il. 23.537, Il. 24.356, etc.: Od. 17.274. Elliptically: ἀλλʼ ἄγε δεῦρο θεοὺς ἐπιδώμεθα Il. 22.254. d With fut.: ἀλλʼ ἄγε πειρήσομαι Od. 6.126. Cf. Od. 13.344, 397.– ἀλλʼ ἄγε δή Il. 20.351, Il. 21.60: Od. 10.286, Od. 13.215.– εἰ δ(ὴ) ἄγε Il. 1.524, Il. 23.579: Od. 21.217. e Introducing a question: ἀλλʼ ἄγε Il. 7.36: Od. 19.24. 2 ἄγετε. a Absol.: ἀλλʼ ἄγετε Il. 2.72 = 83: Od. 21.73 = 106. b With imp. pl.: ἀλλʼ ἄγετε Il. 7.193, etc.: Od. 4.294, Od. 10.460 = Od. 12.23, Od. 21.134, Od. 22.252. With sing.: ἀλλʼ ἄγετʼ ἐπαρξάσθω Od. 21.263. c With 1 pl. subj. Od. 12.213.– ἀλλʼ ἄγετε Il. 2.139 = Il. 9.26 = 704 = Il. 12.75 = Il. 14.74 = 370 = Il. 15.294 = Il. 18.297, Il. 5.469, Il. 9.165, Il. 17.634, etc.: Od. 1.76, Od. 10.176, Od. 12.343, Od. 13.179, Od. 16.376, Od. 24.430.– εἰ δ(ὴ) ἄγετε Il. 22.381. Elliptically: δεῦτʼ ἄγετε δώομεν Il. 7.350. d With 1 sing.: ἀλλʼ ἄγετʼ ἐνείκω Od. 22.139.

a)/zw.head: ἄζω
a)/zw.html: ἄζω (καταζαίνω.) To dry up, parch Il. 4.487.

a)ndrofo/nos.head: ἀνδροφόνος
a)ndrofo/nos.html: ἀνδροφόνος -ον [ἀνδρ-, ἀνήρ + φον-, *φένω.] 1 Slayer of men. Epithet of Hector Il. 1.242, Il. 6.498, Il. 9.351, Il. 16.77, 840, Il. 17.428, 616, 638, Il. 18.149, Il. 24.509, 724. Of Ares Il. 4.441. Of Lycurgus Il. 6.134. 2 Manslaying, fatal: χεῖρας Il. 18.317 = Il. 23.18, Il. 24.479. Of a poisonous application, deadly Od. 1.261.

a)mfino/mh.head: Ἀμφινόμη
a)mfino/mh.html: Ἀμφινόμη A Nereid Il. 18.44 .

a)pu/rwtos.head: ἀπύρωτος
a)pu/rwtos.html: ἀπύρωτος -ον [ἀ-1 + πυρόω, to expose to fire, fr. πῦρ.] = ἄπυρος.: φιάλην Il. 23.270.

a)/blhtos.head: ἄβλητος
a)/blhtos.html: ἄβλητος [as ἀβλής.] Unstruck (by a missile) Il. 4.540.

a)loifh/.head: ἀλοιφή
a)loifh/.html: ἀλοιφή -ῆς, ἡ [ἀλείφω.] 1 Unguent, oil Od. 6.220, Od. 18.179. Tallow applied to a bow Od. 8.179. 2 Oil or grease used for dressing a hide Il. 17.390, 392. 3 Hog's lard or grease: συὸς ῥάχιν τεθαλυῖαν ἀλοιθῇ Il. 9.208. Cf. Il. 9.467, 32: Od. 8.476, Od. 13.410.

a)frodi/th.head: Ἀφροδίτη
a)frodi/th.html:
Ἀφροδίτη [use of the proper name.] Sexual love: εἰς ὅ κʼ ἐκλελάθωντʼ Ἀφροδίτης Od. 22.444.
Ἀφροδίτη (ᾰ, ῑ) (δῖα, Διὸς θυγάτηρ (κούρη), ἐϋστέφανος, φιλομμειδής, χρυσέη, χρυσείη). Called also Κύπρις Il. 5.330 , 422, 458, 760, 883; and Κυθέρεια Od. 8.288 , Od. 18.193. Daughter of Zeus and Dione and by Anchises mother of Aeneas (Il. 2.820). In Od. (Od. 8.266) the wife of Hephaestus. Her seat Paphos Od. 8.363. Saves Paris from Menelaus Il. 3.374; summons Helen to Paris Il. 3.389; carries off Aeneas from Diomedes Il. 5.311, Diomedes attacks and wounds her 330, her complaint to Dione 370; gives Hera her κεστὸς ιμάς 188; in the Battle of the Gods leads off the wounded Ares Il. 21.416, is smitten by Athene 423; etc.: Od. 4.14, 261; Demodocus's tale of Ares and Aphrodite Od. 8.266, 308 , 337, 342, 362; Od. 17.37, Od. 19.54, Od. 20.68, 73. See also Ἀφροδίτη in Lexicon.

a(/pas.head: ἅπας
a(/pas.html: ἅπας -ασα, -αν [(σ)α- as in ἅμα + πᾶς.] Genit. ἅπαντος, -άσης, -αντος. Genit. pl. fem. ἁπασέων Od. 8.284. Strengthened form of, but hardly to be distinguished from, πᾶς. 1 In sing. a All the, the whole, the whole of the: ἠϊόνος Il. 14.35. Cf. Il. 15.506, Il. 20.156, Il. 21.244, 451, etc.: οἶκον Od. 2.48. Cf. Od. 7.129, Od. 9.6, Od. 11.442, Od. 13.72, etc. Predicatively: ἐγκέφαλος ἅπας πεπάλακτο (were all spattered) Il. 11.98, κάρη ἅπαν ἐν κονίῃσι κεῖτο (i.e. was wholly defiled with dust) Il. 22.402, etc. Cf. Od. 4.616, etc. b All, the whole of : διέχευάν μιν ἅπαντα Il. 7.316, Ἴλιος Il. 22.410. Cf. Od. 19.421. A whole: ἐνιαυτόν Od. 14.196, Od. 15.455. All needful: σῖτον Od. 16.83. All possible, perfect: φιλότητος Od. 15.158. 2 In pl. a All the : φάλαγγας Il. 6.83. Cf. Il. 8.17, Il. 9.159, 591, Il. 11.847, Il. 14.79, 273, 278, Il. 21.260, 266, Il. 24.98, 237: θεοί Od. 1.19. Cf. Od. 9.432, Od. 14.19, Od. 15.17, Od. 17.244, Od. 18.6, Od. 21.260, Od. 22.446. b All: βροτῶν Il. 13.374. Cf. Il. 3.78, Il. 14.332, Il. 17.583: κακῶν Od. 4.221. Cf. Od. 6.207, Od. 8.284, 487, Od. 13.157, 297, Od. 14.57, Od. 17.12, Od. 19.372, Od. 24.78. c Absol., the whole number of specified or indicated persons or things: ἀντίοι ἔσταν ἅπαντες Il. 1.535. Cf. Il. 2.14, Il. 7.153, Il. 12.344, Il. 16.291, Il. 22.241, etc.: τελευτηθῆναι ἅπαντα Od. 2.171. Cf. Od. 2.239, Od. 3.34, Od. 5.262, Od. 13.281, Od. 17.70 (all they had in their minds), etc.

a)/pistos.head: ἄπιστος
a)/pistos.html: ἄπιστος [ἀ-1 + πιστός.] 1 Not to be trusted, faithless Il. 3.106, Il. 24.63, 207. 2 Not believing, incredulous Od. 14.150, 391, Od. 23.72.

a)mfagapa/zw.head: ἀμφαγαπάζω
a)mfagapa/zw.html: ἀμφαγαπάζω [ἀμφ-, ἀμφι- 3.] 1 To welcome (with suppressed notion of embracing) Od. 14.381. 2 To show love to, treat with affection. In mid. Il. 16.192.

a)/poina.head: ἄποινα
a)/poina.html: ἄποινα τά [app. ἀ-2 (not appreciably affecting the sense) + ποινή.] A ransom. 1 As the price of freedom Il. 1.13, Il. 2.230, Il. 6.49, Il. 10.380, Il. 11.106 (genit. of price), etc. 2 As the price of life Il. 6.46 = Il. 11.131, Il. 21.99. 3 Paid to recover a corpse Il. 22.349, Il. 24.137, 139, 276, 502, 555, 579, 594. 4 Applied to gifts offered to effect a reconciliation Il. 9.120 = Il. 19.138.

a)sklhpio/s.head: Ἀσκληπιός
a)sklhpio/s.html: Ἀσκληπιός (ἀμύμων ἰητήρ). Father of Podaleirius and Machaon Il. 2.731, Il. 4.194, Il. 11.518.

a(lio/w.head: ἁλιόω
a(lio/w.html: ἁλιόω [ἅλιος 2.] 1 To make of no effect, frustrate: Διὸς νόον Od. 5.104 = 138. 2 To use to no effect: βέλος (did not hurl it in vain) Il. 16.737.

a)nayu/xw.head: ἀναψύχω
a)nayu/xw.html: ἀναψύχω [ἀνα- 6.] 3 pl. aor. pass. ἀνέψυχθεν Il. 10.575. To cool, refresh Od. 4.568. Fig.: ἐπεὶ ἀνέψυχθεν ἦτορ Il. 10.575. Cf. Il. 13.84. To cool or soothe (a wound) Il. 5.795.

au)geiai/.head: Αὐγειαί-1
au)geiai/.html:
Αὐγειαί-1 (ἐρατειναί). A Locrian town Il. 2.532.
Αὐγειαί-2 (ἐρατειναί). A town in the realm of Menelaus Il. 2.583.

a)pei/rwn.head: ἀπείρων
a)pei/rwn.html: ἀπείρων -ονος [as ἀπείριτος.] 1 Boundless Il. 1.350, Il. 7.446, Il. 24.342, 545: Od. 1.98 = Od. 5.46, Od. 4.510, Od. 15.79, Od. 17.386, 418, Od. 19.107. Of sleep, from which it might seem that one would never awake Od. 7.286. 2 App., without an end by which to be unloosed, inextricable: δεσμοί Od. 8.340. 3 Numberless, countless: δῆμος Il. 24.776.

ai)po/s.head: αἰπός
ai)po/s.html: αἰπός -ή, -όν [cf. αἰπύς.] 1 Falling steeply down, flowing fast Il. 8.369, Il. 21.9. 2 Of cities, set on a steep Il. 13.625: Od. 3.130= Od. 13.316, Od. 8.516, Od. 11.533.

a)ktori/dhs.head: Ἀκτορίδης
a)ktori/dhs.html: Ἀκτορίδης Patronymic of Echeclees Il. 16.189.

au)eru/w.head: αὐερύω
au)eru/w.html: αὐερύω (ἀϝϝερύω) [ἀϝ-, ἀνα- 1, ἀνα- 3 + ϝερύῶ, ἐρύω1.] 3 pl. aor. αὐέρυσαν Il. 1.459, Il. 2.422. 1 To pull up, pull out of the ground: στήλας Il. 12.261. 2 To draw back. a To draw one's bow Il. 8.325. b Of drawing back the head of a sacrificial victim Il. 1.459 = Il. 2.422.

a)nqerew/n.head: ἀνθερεών
a)nqerew/n.html: ἀνθερεών -ῶνος, ὁ [ἀνθέω. The part on which the beard grows.] The chin Il. 1.501, Il. 3.372, Il. 5.293, Il. 13.388.

a)/xos.head: ἄχος
a)/xos.html: ἄχος -εος, τό. 1 Pain of the mind, grief, sorrow, trouble, distress: Πηλεΐωνι ἀ. γένετο Il. 1.188, σέθεν (for thee) Il. 4.169. Cf. Il. 2.171, Il. 6.336, Il. 8.124, Il. 10.145, Il. 13.581, etc.: Od. 4.108, 716, Od. 8.541, Od. 15.358, Od. 18.274, etc. In pl., sorrows, troubles: ἄχεʼ ἄκριτα Il. 3.412, Il. 24.91. Cf. Il. 6.413: Od. 19.167. 2 A subject of grief: ἀ. μοί ἐστιν Il. 16.55. Cf. Il. 5.759, Il. 9.249: Od. 22.345.– A subject or cause of resentment: ἕνεκʼ ἀλλοτρίων ἀχέων (in a quarrel not his own) Il. 20.298.

a)/sxetos.head: ἄσχετος
a)/sxetos.html: ἄσχετος [ἀ-1 + σ(ε)χ-, ἔχω.] Not to be restrained, ungovernable: μένος ἄσχετε (in . . .) Od. 2.85 = Od. 17.406, Od. 2.303. Cf. Od. 3.104, Od. 20.19. Of grief, uncontrollable Il. 16.549.

a)mfh/ristos.head: ἀμφήριστος
a)mfh/ristos.html: ἀμφήριστος [ἀμφ-, ἀμφι- 1 + ἐρίζω.] Disputed on both sides. In neut. qualifying a vague notion the state of things; hence, a dead heat: ἀμφήριστόν κʼ ἔθηκεν Il. 23.382, 527.

a)/neu.head: ἄνευ
a)/neu.html: ἄνευ With genit. 1 Away from, aloof from: δηΐων Il. 13.556. 2 Lacking: κέντροιο Il. 23.387. Cf. Od. 24.247. Without need of: δεσμοῖο Od. 13.100. 3 Without the help of: ἕθεν Il. 17.407. Without the good will or permission of: ἐμέθεν Il. 15.213. Cf. Od. 2.372, Od. 15.531.

a)poqrw/|skw.head: ἀποθρῴσκω
a)poqrw/|skw.html: ἀποθρῴσκω [ἀπο- 1.] With genit., to leap from: νηός Il. 2.702, Il. 16.748. Of smoke, to rise up from: ἧς γαίης Od. 1.58.

a)/krh.head: ἄκρη
a)/krh.html: ἄκρη -ης, ἡ [fem. of ἄκρος as sb..] 1 The highest point of a city Od. 8.508. 2 κατʼ ἄκρης, down from the top. Of a breaking wave, with full forceOd. 5.313. Fig., utterly, to total destruction: ὤλετο Il. 13.772. Cf. Il. 15.557, Il. 22.411, Il. 24.728. 3 A cape or headland Il. 4.425, Il. 14.36: Od. 9.285.

a)rwgh/.head: ἀρωγή
a)rwgh/.html: ἀρωγή -ῆς, ἡ [ἀρήγω.] Help, aid, succour: Ζηνός Il. 4.408, τίμοι ἀρωγῆς; (quasi-partitive genit.; what have I to do with . . . ?) Il. 21.360, ἐπʼ ἀρωγῇ (showing partisanship) Il. 23.574.

a)rgei=os.head: Ἀργεῖος
a)rgei=os.html: Ἀργεῖος 1 Of Argos-1 (apparently in sense (4)), Argive. Of Helen Il. 2.161 , 177, Il. 3.458, Il. 4.19, 174, Il. 6.323, Il. 7.350, Il. 9.140, 282: Od. 4.184, 296, Od. 17.118, Od. 23.218. Of Hera Il. 4.8, Il. 5.908. 2 In pl., the Argives a The people of Argos-1 (1) Il. 19.122, 124: Od. 3.309, Od. 15.240. b The people of Proetus (his seat being Tiryns in Argos-1 (1)) Il. 6.159. c The Greeks on their way to Troy Od. 1.211, Od. 2.173, Od. 18.253, Od. 19.126. d The Greeks in the field at Troy (= Ἀχαιός 2.b.γ, Δαναοί 2) (αἰχμηταί, θωρηκταί , ἰόμωροι, φιλοπτόλεμοι , χαλκοχίτωνες) Il. 1.79 , Il. 3.19, Il. 5.3, Il. 7.18, Il. 8.36, Il. 11.16, Il. 12.3, Il. 15.8, Il. 19.84, Il. 21.429, Il. 24.168, etc.: Od. 1.61, Od. 3.129 , 379, Od. 4.172, 200, 258, 273, 279, Od. 8.513, 578, Od. 10.15, Od. 11.369, 485, 500, 518, 524, 555, Od. 12.190, Od. 17.119, Od. 24.54, 62, 81. e The Greeks preparing for or on their return (Ἀχαιός 2.b (d)) Od. 3.133, Od. 8.502.

a)rxh/.head: ἀρχή
a)rxh/.html: ἀρχή -ῆς, ἡ [ἄρχω.] 1 A beginning, a first phase: πήματος Od. 8.81. 2 A beginning, origin, first cause: κακοῦ Il. 11.604. Cf. Il. 22.116: Od. 21.4, Od. 24.169.– ἐξ ἀρχῆς, from of oldOd. 1.188, Od. 2.254, Od. 11.438, Od. 17.69. 3 Something to serve as a basis or foundation: ξεινοσύνης Od. 21.35. 4 An unprovoked aggression Il. 3.100.

a)/guia.head: ἄγυια
a)/guia.html: ἄγυια ἡ. Acc. ἄγυιαν. Dat. ἀγυιῇ. Nom. pl. ἀγυιαί. Acc. ἀγυιάς. A street Il. 5.642, Il. 6.391, Il. 20.254: Od. 2.388 = Od. 3.487 = 497 = Od. 11.12 = Od. 15.185 = 296 = 471, Od. 15.441.

a)/mbrotos.head: ἄμβροτος1
a)/mbrotos.html:
ἄμβροτος1 -ον. = ἀμβρόσιος.: εἵματα Il. 16.670, 680: Od. 7.260, 265, Od. 24.59, ἐλαίῳ Od. 8.365, νύξ Od. 11.330.
ἄμβροτος2 [ἀ-1 + (μ)βροτός.] 1 Immortal Il. 20.358, Il. 22.9, Il. 24.460: Od. 24.445. Of horses Il. 16.381 = 867. 2 Of or belonging to a god, divine Il. 5.339, 870: Od. 5.347. 3 Befitting a god Il. 17.194, 202: Od. 10.222. 4 App., conferring divine qualities: δῶρα Od. 18.191.

a)na.head: ἀνα-
a)na.html: ἀνα- Before a vowel ἀν-. Also in assimilated forms ἀγ-, ἀϝ-, ἀλ-, ἀμ-. 1 Up, upwards; also of putting to sea. 2 On, upon. 3 Back; in a reverse direction. 4 Again; return to a state; repetition. 5 Through, over, among; diffusion. 6 Intensive, sometimes translatable by up, on, out (in some cases not appreciably affecting the sense).

ai)/tios.head: αἴτιος
ai)/tios.html: αἴτιος -η. Blameworthy, to blame: οὔ τί μοι αἴτιοί εἰσιν Il. 1.153. Cf. Il. 3.164, Il. 13.111, 222, Il. 15.137, Il. 19.86, 410, Il. 21.275, 370: οὐκ ἀοιδοὶ αἴτιοι, ἀλλὰ Ζεὺς αἴτιος Od. 1.348. Cf. Od. 2.87, Od. 8.311, Od. 11.559, Od. 22.155. With genit.: αἰ. πάντων (for everything) Od. 22.48.

a)ndraimoni/dhs.head: Ἀνδραιμονίδης
a)ndraimoni/dhs.html: Ἀνδραιμονίδης Patronymic from next. Of Thoas-1 Il. 7.168 .

a)gro/s.head: ἀγρός
a)gro/s.html: ἀγρός -οῦ, ὁ. 1 In pl., fields, lands: πίονες ἀγροί Il. 23.832. Cf. Od. 4.757, Od. 6.259, Od. 8.560, Od. 14.263 = Od. 17.432, Od. 15.504, Od. 16.150, Od. 17.18, 171. 2 In sing., a farm: ἐπʼ ἀγροῦ Od. 1.190. Cf. Od. 11.188 (at the farm), Od. 16.27, 330, 383, Od. 17.182, Od. 23.139, 359, Od. 24.205, 212. So in pl.: ἀγρῶν (at the farm) Od. 4.640. 3 In sing., the country: ἀγρῷ (in the country) Il. 5.137: ἐπʼ ἀγροῦ ((drawn up on the shore) in the country) Od. 1.185 = Od. 24.308. Cf. Od. 4.517, Od. 5.489, Od. 18.358, Od. 22.47, Od. 24.150.

a)ko/rhtos.head: ἀκόρητος
a)ko/rhtos.html: ἀκόρητος [ἀ-1 + κόρος.] Insatiable in, never having his or their fill of. With genit.: μόθου Il. 7.117. Cf. Il. 12.335, Il. 13.621, 639, Il. 14.479, Il. 20.2.

a(yi/s.head: ἁψίς
a(yi/s.html: ἁψίς -ῖδος, ἡ [ἅπτω.] A mesh of a net Il. 5.487.

a)ta/lantos.head: ἀτάλαντος
a)ta/lantos.html: ἀτάλαντος [ἀ-2 + τάλαντον.] 1 Equal to, a match for. With dat.: ἀ. Ἄρηϊ Il. 2.627. Cf. Il. 2.169, 407, 636, 651, Il. 5.576, Il. 7.47 = Il. 11.200, Il. 7.166 = Il. 8.264 = Il. 17.259, Il. 8.215, Il. 10.137, Il. 13.295 = 328, 500, 528, Il. 15.302, Il. 16.784, Il. 17.72, 536. With a form in -φιν: θεόφιν Il. 7.366, Il. 14.318, Il. 17.477: Od. 3.110, 409.– 2 Like, resembling. With dat.: νυκτί Il. 12.463. Cf. Il. 13.795.

au)=te.head: αὖτε
au)=te.html: αὖτε 1 In the reverse direction, back: ὅτʼ ἂν αὐ. νεώμεθα Il. 7.335. Cf. Il. 4.384, Il. 8.139, etc. 2 Of resumption of a state or condition, again. With ἐξαῦτις: αὐ. ἐξαῦτις ἀνέστη Il. 15.287. 3 Again, once more: ἀγορῇ νικᾷς Il. 2.370, ὅτε δὴ αὐ. Ἕκτωρ Ἀργείους ὀλέκεσκεν (i.e. in this second instance) Il. 19.134. Cf. Il. 2.221 (as usual), Il. 3.191, Il. 8.373, Il. 9.702, Il. 14.454 (meaning that his aim is always good), Il. 21.421, etc.: αὐ. δύω μάρψας Od. 9.311. Cf. Od. 5.356, Od. 22.165, 281, etc. 4 In impatient or remonstrative questions, again, now, this time: τίπτʼ αὐ. εἰλήλουθας; Il. 1.202. Cf. Il. 2.225, Il. 7.448, Il. 14.364, Il. 20.16, Il. 21.394: Od. 6.119 = Od. 13.200, Od. 10.281, Od. 11.93, Od. 20.33. 5 In one's turn: ὁ αὐ. δῶκʼ Ἀτρέϊ Il. 2.105. Cf. Il. 1.404, Il. 5.541, Il. 10.283, Il. 13.414, Il. 23.278, etc.: ἔνθʼ αὐ. εὐρυδάμαντα βάλεν (i.e. his turn had come) Od. 22.283. Cf. Od. 8.127. 6 In reply: τὸν αὐ. προσέειπεν Il. 1.206. Cf. Il. 3.58, 203, Il. 4.265, Il. 6.144, etc.: Od. 1.178, 221, 383, 399, etc. 7 Adversative: νῦν μὲν . . . ὕστερον αὐ. μαχήσονται Il. 7.30. Cf. Il. 3.67, etc.: νῦν αὐ. πανύστατος Od. 9.452, etc. On the other hand, again: Τρώων αὐ. ἀγορὴ γένετο Il. 7.345. Cf. Il. 5.279, Il. 7.248, Il. 8.55, Il. 11.56, etc.: ἄλλοτε δʼ αὐ. παύομαι Od. 4.102. Cf. Od. 1.111, Od. 5.29 (for your part), Od. 12.282 (as we cannot do here), Od. 16.463, etc. 8 Particle of transition or continuation: Ἕκτωρ δʼ αὐ. χάρη Il. 3.76. Cf. Il. 1.237, Il. 2.407, Il. 6.73, Il. 8.26, etc.: ἡμῖν δʼ αὐ. ἐπεπείθετο θυμός Od. 2.103. Cf. Od. 2.335, 386, Od. 9.256, Od. 11.21, etc. 9 Hereafter, in the future, yet: εἴ ποτε δὴ αὐ. χρειὼ ἐμεῖο γένηται Il. 1.340. Cf. Il. 1.578, Il. 5.232, Il. 9.135, Il. 15.16, Il. 23.605, etc.: ἡμεῖς δʼ αὐ. τισόμεθα Od. 13.14. Cf. Od. 8.444, Od. 18.48.

a)forma/w.head: ἀφορμάω
a)forma/w.html: ἀφορμάω [ἀφ-, ἀπο- 1.] In pass. 1 To set forth, depart: ἀφορμηθέντος ἀκοῦσαι Od. 2.375, Od. 4.748. 2 To sally forth from. With ablative: ναῦφιν Il. 2.794.

a)=sqma.head: ἆσθμα
a)=sqma.html: ἆσθμα -ατος, τό [cf. ἄημι.] Difficulty in breathing, panting: ἀργαλὲῳ Il. 15.10, Il. 16.109, ἀ. παύετο Il. 15.241.

a)gxi/shs.head: Ἀγχίσης
a)gxi/shs.html: Ἀγχίσης (ἀμύμων, ἄναξ ἀνδρῶν , μεγαλήτωρ). Son of Capys and father of Aeneas by Aphrodite; father also of Hippodameia-2 Il. 2.819, 820, Il. 5.247, 268, 313, 468, Il. 12.98, Il. 13.428, Il. 17.491, Il. 20.112, 208, 239, 240.

a)mfistrefh/s.head: ἀμφιστρεφής
a)mfistrefh/s.html: ἀμφιστρεφής [app. ἀμφι- 3 + στρέφω.] Thus, twisted about: κεφαλαὶ τρεῖς δράκοντος ἀμφιστρεφέες Il. 11.40 (i.e. two twisted about the third).

a(rpali/wn.head: Ἁρπαλίων
a(rpali/wn.html: Ἁρπαλίων Trojan. Son of Pylaemenes. Killed by Meriones Il. 13.644.

a)pamu/nw.head: ἀπαμύνω
a)pamu/nw.html: ἀπαμύνω [ἀπ-, ἀπο- 2.] 3 sing. aor. ἀπήμυνε Il. 9.597. 1 pl. aor. opt. mid. ἀπαμυναίμεσθα Il. 15.738. Infin. ἀπαμύνασθαι Il. 24.369: Od. 16.72, Od. 21.133. 1 To ward off, keep off. With dat. of person protected: αἰτωλοῖσι κακὸν ἦμαρ Il. 9.597. 2 In mid. a To ward or keep off from oneself: ἄνδρʼ ἀπαμύνασθαι Il. 24.369: = Od. 16.72 = Od. 21.133. b Absol., to defend oneself Il. 15.738: Od. 11.579.

a)mfasi/h.head: ἀμφασίη
a)mfasi/h.html: ἀμφασίη ἡ [ἀμ- (= ἀ-1) + φα-, φημί.] Speechlessness: ἀ. μιν λάβεν Il. 17.695: = Od. 4.704.

a)/kron.head: ἄκρον
a)/kron.html: ἄκρον -ου, τό [neut. of ἄκρος as sb..] 1 The summit or crest of a hill Od. 11.597. 2 A cape or headland. Of Sunium Od. 3.278. 3 An end or extremity: ἐπʼ ἄκρῳ δῆσε ζυγόν Il. 5.729. Cf. Od. 9.328, 382. 4 The extreme surface: [νύσσης] Il. 23.339.

a)/rnh.head: Ἄρνη
a)/rnh.html: Ἄρνη (πολυστάφυλος). A Boeotian town Il. 2.507; the home of Menesthius-1 Il. 7.9.

a)/kesma.head: ἄκεσμα
a)/kesma.html: ἄκεσμα -ατος, τό [ἀκεσ-, ἀκέομαι.] A means of cure, a remedy: ἀκέσματʼ ὀδυνάων Il. 15.394.

a)ga/qwn.head: Ἀγάθων
a)ga/qwn.html: Ἀγάθων (δῖος). A son of Priam (his mother not named) Il. 24.249.

a)spidiw/ths.head: ἀσπιδιώτης
a)spidiw/ths.html: ἀσπιδιώτης [ἀσπιδ-, ἀσπίς.] Shield-bearing, warlike: ἀνέρας Il. 2.554, Il. 16.167.

a)/peimi.head: †ἄπειμι1
a)/peimi.html:
†ἄπειμι1 [ἀπ-, ἀπο- 2 + εἰμί.] 3 sing. subj. ἀπέῃσι Od. 19.169. Pple. ἀπεών, -όντος Il. 6.362, Il. 8.522: Od. 13.189, Od. 14.330, Od. 19.299. 3 sing. impf. ἀπέην Il. 10.351, Il. 20.7. Contr. ἀπῆν Od. 5.400, Od. 9.473, Od. 12.181. 1 pl. ἀπῆμεν Od. 9.491. 3 pl. ἄπεσαν Il. 10.357. Fut. ἀπέσσομαι Od. 15.515. 3 sing ἀπέσσεται Od. 2.285, Od. 8.150. ἀπεσσεῖται Od. 19.302. 3 pl. ἀπέσσονται Od. 20.155. Infin. ἀπέσσεσθαι Il. 17.278: Od. 18.146. 1 To be away, absent or distant: ἐμεῖο ἀπεόντος Il. 6.362. Cf. Il. 8.522, Il. 10.351, 357, Il. 20.7: ὅτε τόσσον ἀπῆν ὅσσον . . . Od. 5.400 = Od. 9.473 = Od. 12.181. Cf. Od. 9.491, Od. 13.189, Od. 14.330 = Od. 19.299 (in these three lines pple. of the impf.), Od. 15.515. With genit.: τοῦ (from it) Il. 17.278. Cf. Od. 18.146, Od. 19.169, 302, Od. 20.155. 2 To be unaccomplished or not brought about: ὁδὸς οὐκέτι δηρὸν ἀπέσσεται Od. 2.285, Od. 8.150.
†ἄπειμι2 [ἀπ-, ἀπο- 1, ἀπο- 4 + εἶμι.] Pres. ἄπειμι Od. 17.593. Pple. ἀπιών, -όντος Il. 10.289, Il. 12.392, Il. 13.72, 516, 567, 650, Il. 14.409, 461: Od. 9.413. Imp. ἄπιθι Od. 17.478. 1 To go away, go off, depart: γλαύκου ἀπιόντος Il. 12.392. Cf. Il. 13.72, 516, 567, 650, Il. 14.409, 461: ἄπιθʼ ἄλλῃ Od. 17.478. Cf. Od. 9.413. 2 With fut. sense: ἄπειμι σύας φυλάξων Od. 17.593. 3 To go back, return Il. 10.289.

ai)=sa.head: αἶσα
ai)=sa.html: αἶσα -ης, ἡ. Orig. sense measure. 1 αἴσῃ, in the measure of, at the value of: ἐν καρὸς αἴσῃ Il. 9.378. 2 (Due) measure. a κατʼ αἶσαν, duly, fitly, properlyIl. 3.59 = Il. 6.333, Il. 10.445, Il. 17.716. b ὑπὲρ αἶσαν, unduly, unfitly, improperlyIl. 3.59 = Il. 6.333. Beyond measure; hence, preponderatingly: φέρτεροι ἦσαν Il. 16.780. 3 A share or portion: ληΐδος αἶσαν Il. 18.327. Cf. Od. 5.40 = Od. 13.138. 4 One's portion or lot in life, one's fate or destiny: αἷσα τοι μίνυνθά περ (thy lot in life is but for a little time) Il. 1.416, κακῇ σʼ αἴσῃ τέκον (with an evil fate before thee) 418, κακῇ αἴσῃ τόξʼ ἑλόμην (in an evil hour) Il. 5.209, ὁμῇ πεπρωμένον αἴσῃ (having his fate fixed with a like portion before him, appointed to a like portion) Il. 15.209, πεπρωμένον αἴσῃ (with a fate, i.e. death, before him, appointed to death) Il. 16.441 = Il. 22.179, οὔ τοι αἶσα πόλιν πέρθαι Il. 16.707, ἰῇ γιγνόμεθʼ αἴσῃ (under a like fate) Il. 22.477, εἴ μοι αἶσα τεθνάμεναι Il. 24.224, ἐν θανάτοιο αἴσῃ (a lot consisting in death, i.e. death) Il. 24.428, 750: κακῇ αἴσῃ οἴχετο (in an evil hour) Od. 19.259. Cf. Od. 5.113, 206, 288, Od. 8.511, Od. 13.306, Od. 14.359, Od. 15.276, Od. 23.315. Sim. ἔτι ἐλπίδος αἶσα ((there is) yet a portion for hope, room for hope) Od. 16.101, Od. 19.84. 5 Fate that comes upon or overtakes one, evil fate, doom, death: αἴσῃ ἐν ἀργαλέῃ φθίσει Il. 22.61. Cf. Od. 9.52, Od. 11.61. 6 Fate or destiny as decreed by a god: ὑπὲρ Διὸς αἶσαν Il. 17.321. So αἶσα alone, the decrees of fate (cf. μοῖρα 7): ὑπὲρ αἶσαν Il. 6.487. This and (2) ((due) measure or estimation, (fitting) place in a scale of honour) app. blended: τετιμῆσθαι Διὸς αἴσῃ Il. 9.608. 7 Fate personified Il. 20.127: Od. 7.197.

a)pomo/rgnumi.head: ἀπομόργνυμι
a)pomo/rgnumi.html: ἀπομόργνυμι [ἀπ-, ἀπο-n(1).] 3 sing. aor. mid. ἀπομόρξατο Il. 2.269: Od. 17.304, Od. 18.200. Nom. dual masc. pple. ἀπομορξαμένω Il. 23.739. 1 To wipe off or away. With double acc.: τελαμῶνα αἱμα Il. 5.798. 2 In mid., to wipe away from one's face or person: δάκρυ Il. 2.269. Cf. Il. 23.739: Od. 17.304. 3 To wipe, cleanse Il. 18.414. In mid. Od. 18.200.

a)po/blhtos.head: ἀπόβλητος
a)po/blhtos.html: ἀπόβλητος [ἀπο- 1 + βλη-, βάλλω.] To be thrown away or despised: ἔπος Il. 2.361, θεῶν δῶρα Il. 3.65.

ai(mato/eis.head: αἱματόεις
ai(mato/eis.html: αἱματόεις -όεσσα, -όεν [αἱματ-, αἷμα.] 1 a Covered or mingled with blood, blood-stained, bloody Il. 5.82, Il. 13.393 = Il. 16.486, Il. 13.617, 640, Il. 16.841, Il. 17.298, 542, Il. 22.369: Od. 22.405. b As epithet of βρότος Il. 7.425, Il. 14.7, Il. 18.345, Il. 23.41. c Fig.: ἤματα Il. 9.326, πολέμοιο 650, πολέμου Il. 19.313. 2 Of the colour of blood Il. 2.267, Il. 16.459.

a)sterophth/s.head: ἀστεροπητής
a)sterophth/s.html: ἀστεροπητής [ἀστεροπή.] The lightener. Epithet of Zeus Il. 1.580, 609, Il. 7.443, Il. 12.275.

a)mfia/xw.head: †ἀμφιάχω
a)mfia/xw.html: †ἀμφιάχω [ἀμφ-, ἀμφι- 3 + ϝιϝάχω.] Acc. fem. pf. pple. without redup. ἀμφιαχυῖαν (ἀμφι-ϝακυῖαν). Of a bird, to cry (flying) about: τὴν λάβεν ἀμφιαχυῖαν Il. 2.316.

a(mo/s.head: ἁμός
a(mo/s.html: ἁμός -ή, -όν. Our ( = ἡμέτερος) Il. 6.414, Il. 8.178, Il. 10.448, Il. 13.96, Il. 16.830: Od. 11.166 = 481. (But the sense my (cf. ἡμέτερος 2) is always admissible, and in Il. 6.414, and perh. in Il. 8.178, is preferable.)

a)marugkei/dhs.head: Ἀμαρυγκεΐδης
a)marugkei/dhs.html: Ἀμαρυγκεΐδης Patronymic from next. Of Diores-1 Il. 2.622 , Il. 4.517.

ai)sumnhth/r.head: αἰσυμνητήρ
ai)sumnhth/r.html: αἰσυμνητήρ -ῆρος, ὁ [app. αἶσα + μνη-, μνάομαι. One who is mindful of justice.] A prince Il. 24.347.

a)/rkios.head: ἄρκιος
a)/rkios.html: ἄρκιος [ἀρκέω in sense (3).] 1 Sufficient, ample; or perh., on which one may rely, certain, sure: μισθός Il. 10.304: Od. 18.358. 2 In neut. ἄρκιον with infin., expressing certainty that something must happen: ἀ. ἢ ἀπολέσθαι ἠὲ . . . (it must now be settled whether we are to . . . or to . . . ) Il. 15.502. So οὔ οἱ ἀ. ἐσσεῖται φυγέειν (he will not be able to rely on escaping, i.e. he certainly will not escape) Il. 2.393.

a)nqemi/dhs.head: Ἀνθεμίδης
a)nqemi/dhs.html: Ἀνθεμίδης Patronymic from next. Of Simoeisius Il. 4.488.

a)da/mas.head: Ἀδάμας
a)da/mas.html: Ἀδάμας Trojan. Patronymic Ἀσιάδης. Apparently son of Asius-2 Il. 12.140; wounds Antilochus and is killed by Meriones Il. 13.560 , 759, 771.

a)teirh/s.head: ἀτειρής
a)teirh/s.html: ἀτειρής [ἀ-1 + τείρω.] 1 Not to be worn away, hard: χαλκός Il. 5.292. Cf. Il. 7.247, Il. 14.25, Il. 18.474, Il. 19.233, Il. 20.108: Od. 13.368. Fig., of the heart Il. 3.60. 2 Not liable to fatigue Il. 15.697. Of the voice (cf. ἄρρηκτος 4) Il. 13.45, Il. 17.555, Il. 22.227. Sim. of character: μένος αἰὶν ἀ. (sturdy, unwearying) Od. 11.270.

a)mfo/teros.head: ἀμφότερος
a)mfo/teros.html: ἀμφότερος -η, -ον [ἄμφω.] 1 Both. a Of two persons, etc. In dual or (more freq.) in pl. α Absol.: ἐξαίνυτο θυμὸν ἀμφοτέρω Il. 5.156. Cf. Il. 3.208, Il. 4.38, Il. 5.261, Il. 7.3, etc.: ἀμφοτέρους ἱέρευσεν Od. 14.74. Cf. Od. 3.37, Od. 11.212, Od. 18.17, Od. 8.214, etc. β With sb. or pron.: ἀμφοτέρω σθῶϊ Il. 7.280, ἐπʼ ἀμφοτέρους πόδας (one after the other) Il. 13.281. Cf. Il. 4.521, Il. 5.163, Il. 8.115, Il. 12.382, etc.: ἀμφοτέρῃσιν χερσίν Od. 4.116. Cf. Od. 3.136, Od. 4.282, Od. 5.414, Od. 12.239, etc. With sb. to be supplied: ἀμφοτέρῃσι [χερσίν], with both hands Il. 5.416: Od. 10.264, Od. 11.594, Od. 17.356, Od. 18.28. b In pl. of two groups of persons. α Absol.: ἀμφοτέρων βέλεα Il. 8.67. Cf. Il. 3.416, Il. 4.16, Il. 6.120, Il. 13.303, etc.: φιλότητα μετʼ ἀμφοτέροισιν Od. 24.476. Cf. Od. 10.204, Od. 24.546. β With pron.: τοὺς ἀμφοτέρους Il. 20.54. 2 In neut. ἀμφότερον as adv., both. Followed by . . . τε . . . τε Il. 3.179, Il. 4.145. By . . . τε καὶ . . . Il. 4.60 = Il. 18.365, Il. 13.166. By . . . τε . . . δὲ . . . Il. 7.418. By καὶ Od. 14.505. By . . . τε καὶ . . . καὶ . . . Od. 15.78.

a)gximaxhth/s.head: ἀγχιμαχητής
a)gximaxhth/s.html: ἀγχιμαχητής [ἄγχι + μαχητής] = ἀγχέμαχος Il. 2.604, Il. 8.173 = Il. 11.286 = Il. 13.150 = Il. 15.425 = 486 = Il. 17.184.

a)i/w.head: ἀΐω1.
a)i/w.html:
ἀΐω1. 3 sing. impf. ἄϊε Il. 10.532, Il. 21.388. ἄ̆ϊε Il. 11.463. 3 pl. ἄ̆ϊον Il. 18.222. 1 To perceive, feel. With genit.: πληγῆς Il. 11.532. 2 To perceive, see: οὐκ ἀΐεις ὅτι . . .; Od. 18.11. 3 a To hear: ἄϊε Ζεύς Il. 21.388. Cf. Il. 23.430: Od. 10.118, Od. 24.415. b With acc. of what is heard: κτύπον Il. 10.532. Cf. Il. 15.130, Il. 18.222. c With genit.: φθογγῆς Il. 16.508. Cf. Il. 10.189, Il. 15.378, Il. 23.199: βοῆς Od. 9.401. Cf. Od. 14.266 = Od. 17.435, Od. 24.48. d With genit. of person heard: ἰάχοντος Il. 11.463. 4 To have seen or heard, have learned, know (cf. ἀκούω 5): οὐκ ἀΐεις ὡς . . .; Il. 10.160. Cf. Il. 15.248: Od. 1.298.
†ἀΐω2 [cf. ἄημι.] Impf. ἄϊον. To breathe out Il. 15.252.

a)narpa/zw.head: †ἀναρπάζω
a)narpa/zw.html: †ἀναρπάζω [ἀν-, ἀνα- 1.] 3 sing. aor. ἀνήρπασε Il. 9.564. 3 pl. ἀνήρπαξαν Od. 15.427. Pple. ἀναρπάξας Il. 16.437. Fem. -ασα Od. 4.515, Od. 5.419, Od. 20.63, Od. 23.316. Pl. -ασαι Od. 8.409. 1 To snatch up and carry off Il. 9.564, Il. 16.437. Of winds Od. 4.515, Od. 5.419, Od. 8.409, Od. 20.63, Od. 23.316. 2 To carry off as a slave Od. 15.427.

a)mu/klai.head: Ἀμύκλαι
a)mu/klai.html: Ἀμύκλαι A town in the realm of Menelaus Il. 2.584.

a)pokei/rw.head: †ἀποκείρω
a)pokei/rw.html: †ἀποκείρω [ἀπο- 1.] 3 sing. aor. mid. ἀπεκείρατο. In mid., to cut off from oneself: χαίτην Il. 23.141.

a)rwgo/s.head: ἀρωγός
a)rwgo/s.html: ἀρωγός -οῦ, ὁ, ἡ [as ἀρωγή.] A helper, aider Il. 4.235, Il. 8.205, Il. 18.502 (partisans), Il. 21.371, 428: Od. 18.232.

a)/staxus.head: ἄσταχυς
a)/staxus.html: ἄσταχυς = στάχυς Il. 2.148.

a)na/pneusis.head: ἀνάπνευσις
a)na/pneusis.html: ἀνάπνευσις ἡ [ἀναπνέω.] A breathing-space, a respite: ὀλίγη δέ τʼ ἀ. πολέμοιο (a little (space of time) serves as a respite from . . .) Il. 11.801 = Il. 16.43 = Il. 18.201 (ὀλίγη assimilated in gender to the predicate; cf. Il. 13.237 under ἀρετή 1).

a)/nqeia.head: Ἄνθεια
a)/nqeia.html: Ἄνθεια (βαθύλειμος). A town of Pylus Il. 9.151 , 293.

a)/lkar.head: ἄλκαρ
a)/lkar.html: ἄλκαρ τό [ἀλκή.] A means of defence, a safeguard. With dat. of person defended: Τρώεσσιν Il. 5.644. With genit.: Ἀχαιῶν Il. 11.823.

a)spa/sios.head: ἀσπάσιος
a)spa/sios.html: ἀσπάσιος -ον and -η, -ον [ἀσπάζομαι.] 1 Welcomed, welcome, giving gladness: ἀ. γένετʼ ἐλθών Il. 10.35. Cf. Il. 8.488: Od. 5.394, 397, Od. 9.466, Od. 11.431, Od. 23.233. 2 Glad, well pleased: ἦλθον προτὶ ἄστυ Il. 21.607. Cf. Od. 23.238, 296.

a)lfesi/boios.head: ἀλφεσίβοιος
a)lfesi/boios.html: ἀλφεσίβοιος -η [ἀλθε-, ἀλθάνω + -σι- + βοῦς.] Bringing (her parents many) oxen (as bride-price) Il. 18.593.

a)ripreph/s.head: ἀριπρεπής
a)ripreph/s.html: ἀριπρεπής -ές [ἀρι- + πρέπω.] 1 Very bright, conspicuous: ἄστρα Il. 8.556. Cf. Il. 15.309: Od. 9.22. Standing out clearly, easy to be distinguished Il. 23.453. Bright, ornamented: χηλόν Od. 8.424. 2 Striking, distinguished: εἶδος Od. 8.176. Of persons, distinguished, conspicuous, renowned: Τρώεσσιν (among the . . .) Il. 6.477. Cf. Il. 9.441: Od. 8.390.

a)nti/bios.head: ἀντίβιος
a)nti/bios.html: ἀντίβιος -η, -ον [ἀντι- 2 + βίη.] 1 Of words, wrangling, jangling Il. 1.304, Il. 2.378: Od. 18.415 = Od. 20.323. 2 In neut. ἀντίβιον as adv., face to face, man to man: ἀ. μαχέσασθαι Il. 3.20 = Il. 7.40 = 51. Cf. Il. 3.435, Il. 11.386. 3 Adv. of acc. fem. form ἀντιβίην. a Face to face, man to man Il. 5.220. With dat.: Ἕκτορι Il. 21.226. b To one's face: ἐριζέμεναι βασιλῆϊ ἀ. Il. 1.278.

a)poqnh/|skw.head: ἀποθνῄσκω
a)poqnh/|skw.html: ἀποθνῄσκω [ἀπο- 7.] Genit. sing. masc. pf. pple. ἀποτεθνηῶτος Il. 22.432. 3 pl. plupf. ἀποτέθνασαν Od. 12.393. To die Od. 11.424, Od. 8.33. In pf., to be dead Il. 22.432: Od. 12.393.

a)mfiqalh/s.head: ἀμφιθαλής
a)mfiqalh/s.html: ἀμφιθαλής [ἀμφι- 2 + θάλλω.] Absol., one who has both parents alive Il. 22.496.

a)yo/rroos.head: ἀψόρροος
a)yo/rroos.html: ἀψόρροος [ἄψ + (σ)ρέω.] Of Ocean, flowing back on himself as encircling the earth Il. 18.399: Od. 20.65.

a)rhi/qoos.head: ἀρηΐθοος
a)rhi/qoos.html:
ἀρηΐθοος [Ἄρηϊ, dat. of Ἄρης + θοός.] Swift in the fight: αἰζηῶν Il. 8.298, Il. 15.315, Il. 20.167.
Ἀρηΐθοος-1 (ἄναξ, δῖος). Named the clubbearer. Father by Phylomedousa of Menesthius-1 Il. 7.8 , 10; was slain by Lycourgus-2 Il. 7.137, 138.
Ἀρηΐθοος-2. Chariot-driver to Rhigmus. Killed by Achilles Il. 20.487.

a)ne/xw.head: ἀνέχω
a)ne/xw.html: ἀνέχω [ἀν-, ἀνα- 1, ἀνα- 3.] 3 sing. aor. ἀνέσχε Il. 17.310, Il. 20.278, Il. 22.80: Od. 22.297. 3 pl. -ον Il. 3.318, Il. 6.301, Il. 7.177: Od. 18.89. Pple. ἀνασχών Il. 1.450, Il. 3.275, Il. 5.174, etc. : Od. 4.115, 154, Od. 13.355, Od. 17.239, Od. 20.97. Infin. ἀνασχέμεν Il. 24.301. ἀνασχεῖν Il. 6.257. 3 sing. aor. ἀνασχέμεν Il. 24.301. ἀνασχεῖν Il. 6.257. 3 sing. aor. ἀνέσχεθε Il. 7.412, Il. 10.461. 1 pl. -ομεν Od. 9.294. Contr. infin. ἀνσχεθέειν Od. 5.320. Mid. Fut. ἀνέξομαι Il. 5.895: Od. 19.27. Contr. infin. ἀνσχήσεσθαι Il. 5.104, 285. 3 sing. aor. ἀνέσχετο Il. 5.655, Il. 18.430, Il. 21.67, 161: Od. 23.302. Contr. 2 sing. ἄνσχεο Il. 24.518. Opt. ἀνασχοίμην Od. 11.375. Imp. ἀνάσχεο Il. 1.586, Il. 5.382, Il. 10.321. Contr. ἄνσχεο Il. 23.587, Il. 24.549. Pple. ἀνασχόμενος, -ου Il. 3.362, Il. 11.594, Il. 12.138, etc.: Od. 14.425, Od. 18.95, 100, Od. 19.448. Infin. ἀνασχέσθαι Il. 4.511: Od. 13.307. I In act. 1 To hold up, lift up: σκῆπτρον (to the gods in testimony) Il. 7.412, ὑψόσε (as an offering) Il. 10.461. Cf. Il. 14.499, Il. 20.278, Il. 22.80: χεῖρας Od. 18.89. Cf. Od. 4.115 = 154, Od. 22.297. To lift up (the hands) in prayer Il. 1.450, Il. 11.275, 318 = Il. 7.177, Il. 5.174, Il. 6.257, 301, Il. 18.75, Il. 19.254, Il. 24.301: Od. 9.294, Od. 13.355, Od. 17.239, Od. 20.97. 2 To maintain, uphold: εὐδικίας Od. 19.111. 3 To restrain, check: ἵππους Il. 23.426. 4 To project, appear: αἰχμὴ παρʼ ὦμον Il. 17.310. To come to the surface, emerge Od. 5.320. II In mid. 1 To hold up, lift up: σκῆπτρον ἀνάσχεο (in testimony) Il. 10.321. Cf. Il. 12.138: Od. 18.100. To raise (a spear) for action Il. 5.655, Il. 11.594, Il. 15.298, Il. 17.234, Il. 21.67, 161: Od. 19.448. 2 To lift the hand Il. 3.362, Il. 22.34: Od. 14.425. Of boxers, to square up Il. 23.660, 686: Od. 18.95. 3 To endure, have laid upon one, suffer: κήδεα Il. 18.430. Cf. Il. 24.518: Od. 13.307, Od. 23.302. 4 To endure, stand, withstand the action of: χαλκόν Il. 4.511. Cf. Il. 5.104, Il. 15.470. 5 To endure, submit to: δουλοσύνην Od. 22.423. To suffer the presence or company of, bear with: ξείνους Od. 7.32. Cf. Od. 17.13. 6 To endure, suffer, permit. With acc. in complementary ppl. clause: οὔ σʼ ἀνέξομαι ἄλγεʼ ἔχοντα Il. 5.895. Cf. Od. 19.27. 7 To endure, hold up, hold out: δηρόν Il. 5.285. Cf. Od. 11.375. With complementary ppl. clause: καί κʼ εἰς ἐνιαυτὸν παρὰ σοί γʼ ἀνεχοίμην ἥμενος Od. 4.595. 8 To accept what happens, submit with patience: ἀνάσχεο Il. 1.586. Cf. Il. 5.382, Il. 24.549. With complementary pple.: εἰσορόων ἀνέχεσθαι Od. 16.277. To restrain oneself, be placated: ἄνσχεο Il. 23.587.

a)mfiqo/h.head: Ἀμφιθόη
a)mfiqo/h.html: Ἀμφιθόη A Nereid Il. 18.42 .

a)nemoskeph/s.head: ἀνεμοσκεπής
a)nemoskeph/s.html: ἀνεμοσκεπής [ἄνεμος + σκέπας.] Protecting from the wind: χλαινάων Il. 16.224.

a)qu/rw.head: ἀθύρω
a)qu/rw.html: ἀθύρω To play, sport Il. 15.364.

ai)/geiros.head: αἴγειρος
ai)/geiros.html: αἴγειρος -ου, ἡ. The poplar Il. 4.482: Od. 5.64, 239, Od. 6.292, Od. 7.106, Od. 9.141, Od. 10.510, Od. 17.208.

a)mfi/wn.head: Ἀμφίων-1
a)mfi/wn.html:
Ἀμφίων-1 A leader of the Epeians Il. 13.692.
Ἀμφίων-2 Son of Zeus and Antiope. With his brother Zethus represented as having founded Thebes-1 Od. 11.262.
Ἀμφίων-3 Patronymic Ἰασίδης-1 King of Orchomenus-1 and father of Chloris Od. 11.283.

a)mfotero/s.head: Ἀμφοτερός
a)mfotero/s.html: Ἀμφοτερός Trojan. killed by Patroclus Il. 16.415.

a)llodapo/s.head: ἀλλοδαπός
a)llodapo/s.html: ἀλλοδαπός -ή, -όν [ἄλλος. Second element doubtful.] 1 Foreign, alien Il. 19.324, Il. 24.382: Od. 8.211, Od. 9.36, Od. 14.231, Od. 17.485, Od. 20.220, Od. 23.219. 2 Absol., a foreigner or alien Il. 3.48, Il. 16.550: Od. 3.74 = Od. 9.255.

a)wte/w.head: ἀωτέω
a)wte/w.html: ἀωτέω To sleep, slumber Il. 10.159: Od. 10.548.

a)lkuw/n.head: ἀλκυών
a)lkuw/n.html: ἀλκυών -όνος. The halcyon or kingfisher Il. 9.563.

a)gosto/s.head: ἀγοστός
a)gosto/s.html: ἀγοστός -οῦ, ὁ. The palm of the hand; or perh., oneʼs grasp Il. 11.425, Il. 13.508 = Il. 17.315, Il. 13.520 = Il. 14.452.

a)/mfiklos.head: Ἄμφικλος
a)/mfiklos.html: Ἄμφικλος Trojan. killed by Meges Il. 16.313.

a)rgi/pous.head: ἀργίπους
a)rgi/pous.html: ἀργίπους -ποδος [ἀργός + πούς.] Swift-footed: κύνας Il. 24.211.

a)mfi/xutos.head: ἀμφίχυτος
a)mfi/xutos.html: ἀμφίχυτος [ἀμφιχέω.] Poured round or about; hence of heaped-up earth: τεῖχος Il. 20.145.

ai)/qwn.head: αἴθων
ai)/qwn.html:
αἴθων -ωνος [αἴθω.] 1 Epithet of metals and of objects made of metal, bright, shining, gleaming: σιδήρῳ Il. 4.485, Il. 7.473, Il. 20.372, λέβητας Il. 9.123 = Il. 9.265 = Il. 19.244, τρίποδας Il. 24.233: σίδηρον Od. 1.184. 2 Epithet of the lion, tawny Il. 10.24 = 178, Il. 11.548, Il. 18.161. So of oxen Il. 16.488: Od. 18.372. Of the eagle Il. 15.690. 3 Of horses, app., sorrel or brown Il. 2.839 = Il. 12.97.
Αἴθων-1 One of Hector's horses Od. 8.185.
Αἴθων-2 The name assumed by Odysseus in his tale to Penelope Od. 19.183 .

a)natre/pw.head: †ἀνατρέπω
a)natre/pw.html: †ἀνατρέπω [ἀνα- 3.] 3 sing. aor. mid. ἀνετράπετο. In mid., to fall supine Il. 6.64, Il. 14.447.

a)xilleu/s.head: Ἀχιλλεύς
a)xilleu/s.html: Ἀχιλλεύς (ἀγαυός, ἀμύμων, ἄναξ, Ἀρήϊος, δαΐφρων, διίφιλος, δῖος, θεῖος, θεοείκελος, θεοῖς ἐπιείκελος , θυμολέων, κλυτός , καρτερός, κυδάλιμος , μεγάθυμος, μέγα φέρτατος Ἀχαιῶν, ἄβριμος, ὀλοός, ὄρχαμος ἀνδρῶν, πελώριος, ποδάρκης, πόδας ταχύς (ὠκύς), ποδώκης , ποιμὴν λαῶν, πτολίπορθος , ῥηξήνωρ, ταχύς, ὑπέρθυμος, φαίδιμος, ὠκύς). Patronymic Πηλεΐδης, Πηλεΐων, Πηληϊάδης, Αἰακίδης. Son of Peleus and Thetis and father of Neoptolemus. Leader of the Myrmidons and the great bulwark of the Greeks. Calls an assembly Il. 1.54, addresses Agamemnon 59 , and Calchas 85, Achilles again 122 , abuses Agammemnon 149, questions with himself whether to slay Agammemnon 188, Athene appears 194 , and restrains him 207, he abuses Agammemnon again 225, his final speech to Agammemnon 293, retires to his ships from the fight 306; yields Briseis to the heralds of Agamemnon Il. 1.337 , calls to his mother 352, she promises her intercession with Zeus 414; he receives the embassy Il. 9.193, his speech 308, he rejects finally the proposals 644; Patroclus approaches him Il. 16.2, and asks to be sent to the fight 21, Achilles accedes 49 , and marshals the Myrmidons 155, his prayer to Zeus 233 ; he hears from Antilochus of the death of Patroclus Il. 18.18 , his mother comes to him 70, and promises armour from Hephaestus 136; Iris urges him to come to the rescue of the corpse of Patroclus Il. 18.170, Athene kindles fire from his head 203, he shouts from the ditch 215, and accompanies the rescued corpse 234, his lament 316; his mother brings the divine armour Il. 19.8, he rouses the host 40, he renounces his wrath 146; his further lament Il. 19.315; he assumes the armour Il. 19.367, and addresses his horses 400; he and Aeneas meet in fight Il. 20.158, Poseidon withdraws Aeneas 325; Achilles and Hector meet Il. 20.422 , Apollo withdraws H. Il. 20.443, Achilles does much execution Il. 20.455; he drives a part of the foe into the Xanthus-1 Il. 21.7, he encounters Lycaon-2 34, and slays him 116, after doing much execution is addressed by the river 214 , the river rises upon him 240, he is saved by the fire of Hephaestus 342; Agenor stands up to him 550, is withdrawn by Apollo 596, Apollo in his guise beguiles Achilles to a vain pursuit 599; he approaches the city Il. 22.21, Hector awaits him 35 , but flees before him and is chased thrice round the walls 136 , they fight 273, Achilles slays Η. 326, and drags the corpse to the ships 395; the shade of Patroclus appears to him Il. 23.65, he places his lock dedicated to the Spercheius in the hands of Patroclus's corpse 140, he summons the winds to fan the pyre 192; he sets the prizes for the funeral games Il. 23.262; Thetis sent by Zeus persuades him to accept ransom for Hector's corpse from Priam Il. 24.128, he hearkens to P.'s appeal 483, he gives directions for releasing the corpse 572; etc.: Od. 3.106, 109, 189, Od. 4.5; his strife with Odysseus Od. 8.75; Odysseus encounters him in the Shades Od. 11.467, 478, 482, 486, his lament to Odysseus 488; Od. 11.546, 557; in the second νέκυια 15, 36, 72, 76, 94.

a)mfiba/llw.head: †ἀμφιβάλλω
a)mfiba/llw.html: †ἀμφιβάλλω [ἀμφι- 1, ἀμφι- 3.] Aor. pple. ἀμφιβαλών, -όντος Il. 17.742, Il. 23.97: Od. 17.344, Od. 23.192. Fut. mid. ἀμφιβαλεῦμαι Od. 22.103. Aor. infin. ἀμφιβαλέσθαι Od. 6.178. 1 To put round something: [χεῖρας] Od. 17.344. To throw the arms round. With acc.: ἀλλήλους Il. 23.97. To put building materials round. With dat.: θάμνῳ Od. 23.192. 2 Fig., to throw or put (strength) on both sides of something, apply (strength) vigorously: μένοσἀμφιβαλόντες Il. 17.742. 3 In mid., to throw (a garment) round oneself Od. 6.178. To put on a piece of armour Od. 22.103.

a)raio/s.head: ἀραιός
a)raio/s.html: ἀραιός -ή, -όν (has app. lost an initial consonant). App., slender, slight, narrow: χεῖρα Il. 5.425, γλώσσῃσιν Il. 16.161, κνῆμαι Il. 18.411 = Il. 20.37: εἴσοδος Od. 10.90.

a(marta/nw.head: †ἁμαρτάνω
a(marta/nw.html: †ἁμαρτάνω 3 sing. impf. ἡμάρτανε Il. 10.372, Il. 24.68: Od. 11.511. Fut. infin. in mid. form ἁμαρτήσεσθαι Od. 9.512. 3 sing. aor. ἅμαρτε Il. 4.491, Il. 8.311, Il. 11.233, Il. 13.518, 605, Il. 15.430, Il. 17.609, Il. 23.865: Od. 6.116. 3 sing. subj. ἁμάρτῃ Il. 9.501: Od. 13.214. Pple. ἁμαρτών Il. 22.505, Il. 23.857. Infin. ἁμαρτεῖν Od. 8.155. Aor. ἤμβροτον Od. 8.425, Od. 22.154. 2 sing. -ες Il. 5.287, Il. 22.279. 3 sing. -ε Od. 7.292, Od. 8.421. 3 pl. -ον Il. 16.336. (ἀθ-.) 1 To discharge a missile vainly, miss one's aim: ἤμβροτες οὐδʼ ἔτυχες Il. 5.287. Cf. Il. 8.311, Il. 11.233 = Il. 13.605, Il. 13.518, Il. 22.279. 2 To fail to hit, miss. With genit.: θωτός Il. 10.372. Cf. Il. 4.491, Il. 15.430, Il. 16.336, Il. 17.609, Il. 23.857, 865: σκοποῦ Od. 8.425. Cf. Od. 8.421. Sim., to miss (a person) in throwing something to be caught Od. 6.116. 3 To lose, be deprived of. With genit.: ὀπωπῆς Od. 9.512. Sim., to lose (a person) by death Il. 22.505. 4 To fall short, be lacking or deficient in. With genit.: δώρων (failed to give in due measure) Il. 24.68: νοήματος ἐσθλοῦ (failed in the matter of) Od. 7.292, μύθων (failed in finding in the matter of) Od. 7.292, μύθων (failed in finding the right) Od. 11.511. 5 To commit wrong, sin: ὅτε κέν τις ἁμάρτῃ Il. 9.501. Cf. Od. 13.214, Od. 8.155. To neglect one's duty: τόδε γʼ ἤμβροτον (in this) Od. 22.154.

a)gkw/n.head: ἀγκών
a)gkw/n.html: ἀγκών -ῶνος, ὁ [ἄγκος.] 1 The bend of the arm, the elbow Il. 5.582, Il. 10.80, Il. 11.252, Il. 20.479, Il. 23.395: Od. 14.485, 494. 2 An angle (of a wall): ἀγκῶνος τείχεος Il. 16.702.

a)rguro/peza.head: ἀργυρόπεζα
a)rguro/peza.html: ἀργυρόπεζα [ἄργυρος + πέζα.] Silver - footed. Epithet of Thetis Il. 1.538 = 556, Il. 9.410, Il. 16.222, 574, Il. 18.127 = Il. 19.28, Il. 18.146, 369, 381, Il. 24.89, 120: Od. 24.92.

a)ri/sbas.head: Ἀρίσβας
a)ri/sbas.html: Ἀρίσβας Father of Leiocritus-1 Il. 17.345.

a(fa/w.head: †ἁφάω
a(fa/w.html: †ἁφάω Acc. sing. masc. pres. pple. ἁφόωντα. To handle, turn over: ἀσπίδα Il. 6.322.

a)tarthro/s.head: ἀταρτηρός
a)tarthro/s.html: ἀταρτηρός App., baneful, baleful, or the like: ἐπέεσσιν Il. 1.223: μέντορ ἀταρτηρέ Od. 2.243.

au)dh/eis.head: αὐδήεις
au)dh/eis.html: αὐδήεις -εσσα [αὐδή.] 1 Having the power of speech: αὐδήεντα ἔθηκεν Il. 19.407. 2 Using the speech of mortals (as opposed to that of the gods): θεὸς αὐδήεσσα Od. 10.136 = Od. 11.8 = Od. 12.150, Od. 12.449. 3 As a general epithet of human (as opposed to divine) beings Od. 5.334, Od. 6.125.

a)mu/ntwr.head: ἀμύντωρ
a)mu/ntwr.html:
ἀμύντωρ -ορος, ὁ [ἀμύνω.] A defender or helper Il. 14.449, Il. 15.540, 610: Od. 2.326, Od. 16.256, 261.
Ἀμύντωρ Patronymic Ὀρμενίδης. Ruler of Hellas (but in Il. 10.266 he is spoken of as living in Eleon) and father of Phoenix-1 Il. 9.448 , Il. 10.266.

a)naspa/w.head: †ἀνασπάω
a)naspa/w.html: †ἀνασπάω [ἀνα- 3.] 3 sing. aor. mid. ἀνεσπάσατο. To draw forth again: ἔγχος Il. 13.574.

a)xlu/s.head: ἀχλύς
a)xlu/s.html: ἀχλύς -ύος, ἡ. A mist: ἀχλύν οἱ κατέχευεν Od. 7.41. Cf. Od. 20.357. In reference to blinding or to the mist of death: κατʼ ὀφθαλμῶν κέχυτʼ ἀ. Il. 5.696, ἀπʼ ὀφθαλμῶν νέφος ἀχλύος ὦσεν (the cloud of mist) Il. 15.668. Cf. Il. 5.127, Il. 16.344, Il. 20.321, 341, 421: Od. 22.88.

ai)/qrh.head: αἴθρη
ai)/qrh.html:
αἴθρη -ης, ἡ [αἰθήρ.] Clear sky Il. 17.646: Od. 6.44, Od. 12.75.
Αἴθρη Daughter of Pittheus. A handmaid of Helen at Troy Il. 3.144.

a)rgu/feos.head: ἀργύφεος
a)rgu/feos.html: ἀργύφεος [ἀργός.] 1 White: φᾶρος Od. 5.230 = Od. 10.543. 2 Bright: σπέος Il. 18.50.

a)ergo/s.head: ἀεργός
a)ergo/s.html: ἀεργός (ἀϝεργός) [ἀ-1 + (ϝ)έργον.] Not working or exerting oneself, idle, lazy Il. 9.320: Od. 19.27.

a)lkh/.head: ἀλκή
a)lkh/.html: ἀλκή -ῆς, ἡ [cf. ἄλαλκον.] Dat. ἀλκί (fr. *ἄλξ) Il. 5.299, Il. 13.471, Il. 17.61, etc.: Od. 6.130. 1 Defence, help: οὔτε κλέος οὔτʼ ἀ. Il. 5.532 = Il. 15.564, οὐδέ τις ἀ. γίγνετο (γίγνεται) Il. 21.528: Od. 22.305, οὐδέ τίς ἔστʼ ἀ. Od. 12.120. 2 Prowess in defence or offence, mettle, courage, spirit: συΐ εἴκελος ἀλκήν Il. 4.253. Cf. Il. 3.45, Il. 5.299, Il. 7.164, Il. 9.706, Il. 16.157, Il. 19.36, etc.: ἀλκὶ πεποιθώς Od. 6.130. Cf. Od. 9.214, 514, Od. 17.315, Od. 22.226, 237, Od. 23.128, Od. 24.509.
