Personified Il. 5.740. 3 Showing of fight, resistance: οὐκ ἀπολήγει ἀλκῆς Il. 21.578. Prowess displayed in action, deeds of prowess, fighting: εἰδότε ἀλκῆς Il. 11.710, ἔπαυσεν ἀλκῆς Il. 15.250. Cf. Od. 13.116, 197, Il. 15.490 (from Zeus), Il. 20.256, etc.: οὐ δεδαηκότες ἀλκήν Od. 2.61. Cf. Od. 4.527. 4 The upper hand, victory: ἀπείρητος οὐδʼ ἀδήριτος ἤ τʼ ἀλκῆς ἤ τε φόβοιο (whether in the matter of . . . or . . . , whether the result be . . . or . . .) Il. 17.42.

ai)/geios.head: αἴγειος
ai)/geios.html: αἴγειος -η, -ον [αἰγ-, αἴξ]. Of a goat or goats: ἀσκῷ (of goatskin) Il. 3.247, τυρόν (of goats' milk) Il. 11.639: ἀσκῷ Od. 6.78, κυνέην Od. 24.231.

a)stra/ptw.head: ἀστράπτω
a)stra/ptw.html: ἀστράπτω [cf. ἀστεροπή.] To send forth lightning, lighten. Of Zeus Il. 2.353, Il. 9.237, Il. 10.5, Il. 17.595.

a)le/omai.head: †ἀλέομαι
a)le/omai.html: †ἀλέομαι [cf. ἀλεείνω.] 3 pl. impf. ἀλέοντο Il. 18.586. 3 sing. aor. ἠλεύατο Il. 13.184, 404, 503, Il. 16.610, Il. 17.305, 526, Il. 22.274. ἀλεύατο Il. 3.360, Il. 7.254, Il. 11.360, Il. 14.462: Od. 17.67, Od. 20.300, 305. 3 pl. ἀλεύαντο Od. 22.260. 3 sing. subj. ἀλέηται Od. 4.396. ἀλεύεται Od. 14.400, Od. 24.29. 1 pl. ἀλεώμεθα Il. 5.34, Il. 6.226. 3 sing. opt. ἀλέαιτο Il. 20.147: Od. 20.368. Imp. ἄλευαι Il. 22.285. 2 pl. ἀλέασθε Od. 4.774. Pple. ἀλευάμενος, -ου Il. 5.28, 444, Il. 15.223, Il. 16.711, Il. 20.281: Od. 9.277, Od. 12.157. Infin. ἀλέασθαι Il. 13.436, 513, Il. 20.302, Il. 23.340, 605: Od. 9.274, 411, Od. 16.447. ἀλεύασθαι Od. 12.159, 269, 274. (ὑπ-, ὑπεξ-.) 1 To escape, evade, avoid, keep out of the way, reach, or influence of (something coming upon or threatening one): ἔγχεα Il. 6.226. Cf. Il. 3.360, Il. 5.34, Il. 15.223, Il. 20.147, 281, etc.: νοῦσον Od. 9.411. Cf. Od. 9.274, 277, Od. 12.157, Od. 16.447, Od. 20.305, 368, Od. 22.260, Od. 24.29. 2 Absol., to escape Il. 20.302. To avoid a missile Od. 20.300. To flee, take to flight, take oneself off, save oneself Il. 5.28 (as it seemed to the onlookers), Il. 13.436, 513: Od. 4.396. To keep out of harm's way Il. 18.586. 3 To shun, avoid, keep clear of or away from, refrain from: μύθους ὑπερφιάλους Od. 4.774, σειρήνων φθόγγον καὶ λειμῶνα Od. 12.159, νῆσον 269 = 274, ὅμιλον Od. 17.67. 4 With infin., to shrink from doing, hesitate to do: ἠπεροπεύειν Il. 23.605: Od. 14.400. To take care not to do: λίθου ἐπαυρεῖν Il. 23.340.

a)/gw.head: ἄγω
a)/gw.html: ἄγω Fut. ἄξω, -εις Il. 1.139, Il. 3.401, Il. 4.239, Il. 8.166, Il. 9.429, 692, Il. 24.154, 183: Od. 2.326, Od. 10.268, Od. 16.272, Od. 17.22, 250. Acc. sing. masc. pple. ἄξοντα Il. 8.368: Od. 11.623. Infin. ἀξέμεναι Od. 23.221. ἀξέμεν Il. 23.668. ἄξειν Il. 16.832, Il. 19.298: Od. 13.212. Aor. ἤγαγον, -ες Il. 4.179, Il. 5.731, Il. 6.426, Il. 11.480, 663, Il. 24.547, etc.: Od. 1.172, Od. 3.383, Od. 4.258, Od. 7.9, 248, Od. 9.495, Od. 11.509, 625, Od. 13.323, Od. 17.171, 376, etc. ἄγαγον, -ες Il. 1.346, Il. 11.112, Il. 19.118, Il. 24.447, 577, etc.: Od. 14.404, Od. 16.227. Subj. ἀγάγωμι Il. 24.717. ἀγάγω Il. 2.231. 3 sing. -ῃσι Il. 24.155. -ῃ Od. 15.311. 1 pl. -ωμεν Il. 20.300. 3 sing. opt. ἀγάγοι Od. 17.243, Od. 21.201. Imp. ἄγαγε Il. 24.337. Pple. ἀγαγών, -οῦσα Il. 4.407, Il. 8.490: Od. 4.175, 407, Od. 15.428, Od. 23.295. Aor. imp. pl. ἄξετε Il. 3.105, Il. 24.778: Od. 14.414. Infin. ἀξέμεναι Il. 23.50. ἀξέμεν Il. 23.111, Il. 24.663. Mid. Fut. ἄξομαι Il. 9.367: Od. 4.601, Od. 21.214. Infin. ἄξεσθαι Od. 21.316, 322. Aor. ἠγαγόμην Od. 4.82, Od. 14.211. 3 sing. -ετο Il. 7.390, Il. 16.190, Il. 22.116, 471: Od. 15.238. 3 sing. subj. ἀγάγηται Od. 6.159. Infin. ἀγαγέσθαι Il. 18.87. 3 pl. aor. ἄξοντο (v. l. ἄξαντο) Od. 8.545. Imp. pl. ἄξεσθε (v.l. ἄξασθε) Od. 8.505. (ἀν-, ἀπ-, δι-, εἰσ-, εισαν-, ἐξ-, ἐπ-, κατ-, προσ-, συν-, ὑπ-, ὑπεξ-.) I In act. 1 To drive, lead, bring (an animal) Il. 21.368, Il. 11.480, Il. 13.572, Il. 17.134, Il. 23.596, 613, 654: Od. 3.439, Od. 4.622, Od. 11.623, 625, Od. 14.27, 414, Od. 17.171, 213= Od. 20.174, Od. 17.600, Od. 20.186, etc. To take as a prize: ἵππον Il. 23.577, ἡμίονον 662, 668. – to put (under the yoke) Il. 5.731, Il. 10.293, Il. 23.294, 300: Od. 3.383, 476, Od. 15.47. 2 In reference to persons, to cause to come or go, lead, conduct, take, bring, fetch Il. 1.346, 440, Il. 3.105, Il. 4.541, Il. 6.291, Il. 7.310, Il. 9.89, etc.: Od. 2.326, Od. 3.270, Od. 4.262, Od. 9.98, Od. 13.134, etc. In reference to corpses Il. 7.418, Il. 22.392, etc. : Od. 24.419. Of an impersonal agency: τίπτε δέσε χρειὼ δεῦρʼ ἤγαγεν; Od. 4.312. Of fate, to lead on Il. 2.834, Il. 5.614, etc. In reference to leading astray Il. 10.391. 3 To lead as a chief Il. 2.557, 580, 631, Il. 4.179, Il. 12.330, Il. 17.96, etc.: Od. 3.189, Od. 6.7, Od. 10.551, Od. 14.469, Od. 24.427. To take (companions) with one Od. 4.434. 4 To carry off (a horse) as spoil Il. 16.153. To carry off (persons) captive: υἱόν Il. 2.231. Cf. Il. 4.239, Il. 6.426, Il. 8.166, Il. 9.594, Il. 11.112, Il. 21.36, etc.: γυναῖκας Od. 14.264, etc. Sim. with φέρω (φέρω referring to things, ἄγω to men and cattle) Il. 5.484. In reference to the rape of Helen Il. 24.764. In reference to taking her back Od. 23.221. In reference to taking back her and the spoils Il. 7.351, Il. 22.117. In reference to carrying off Briseïs Il. 1.184, 323, 338, 391, Il. 19.273, etc. To seizing and taking away (a γέρας) Il. 1.139. 5 Of a chariot, horses, etc., to bear, carry, bring Il. 5.839, Il. 11.598: Od. 6.37. Of ships Il. 24.396: Od. 7.9, Od. 24.299. 6 In reference to things, to fetch, bring, carry, take Il. 1.99, Il. 7.335, Il. 11.632, Il. 15.531, Il. 23.50, Il. 24.367, etc.: Od. 1.184, Od. 3.312, Od. 13.216, Od. 14.296, Od. 15.159, etc. To bring in, import: οἶνον Il. 7.467, Il. 9.72, μέθυ Il. 7.471. To carry off as spoil Il. 1.367. In reference to levying compensation Od. 22.57. 7 To bring on, cause: πῆμα Il. 24.547: τερπωλήν Od. 18.37. In reference to atmospheric phenomena: νέφος ἄγει λαίλαπα Il. 4.278. Cf. Il. 23.188. To bring on (a period of time): ἦμαρ Od. 18.137, Ἠῶ Od. 23.246. 8 In various uses. In reference to conducting water in a channel Il. 21.262. To direct the course of (a battle) Il. 11.721. To cause (a ship) to take a certain direction Od. 9.495. To bring (to the birth) Il. 19.118. Of hunters, to draw (a cordon) Od. 4.792. To bring back (intelligence) Od. 4.258. To keep in memory Od. 5.311. 9 In pres. pple. with a finite vb., to take and . . . (cf. αἱρέω I 10, εἶμι 1.c, εἶμι 6.b, ἔρχομαι 1, 4, κίον 2, λαμβάνω 7, φέρω 6, 10): ἀνὰ δʼ εἷσεν ἄγων Il. 1.311, στῆσεν ἄγων Il. 2.558. Cf. Il. 4.392, etc.: Od. 1.130, Od. 3.416, Od. 4.525, 634, Od. 15.542, etc. 10 For imp. sing. and pl. ἄγε, ἄγετε, used interjectionally see these words. II In mid. (often hardly to be distinguished from the act.). 1 In reference to cattle, to drive, bring Il. 8.505, 545. 2 To carry or take, take with one: χρυσόν Il. 9.367. Cf. Il. 16.223: εἵματα Od. 6.58. Cf. Od. 4.82, 601, Od. 10.35, 40. In reference to corpses Il. 17.163, Il. 24.139. 3 To carry off captive or as spoil Il. 2.659, Il. 6.455, Il. 7.390, Il. 22.116, Il. 23.829. In reference to Helen and the spoils Il. 3.72 = 93. To the spoils Il. 7.363. To taking her back Il. 4.19. To take as a prize Il. 23.263. 4 To take to oneself as a wife, marry. a With οἴκαδε or the like: οἴκαδʼ ἄγεσθαι Il. 3.404, ἠγάγετο πρὸς δώματα Il. 16.190. Cf. Il. 9.146, etc.: Od. 6.159, Od. 21.316. b Without such a word Il. 18.87, Il. 22.471: Od. 14.211, Od. 21.322. 5 To get (a wife for another). a As in 4.a : κασιγνήτῳ γυναῖκα ἠγάγετο πρὸς δώματα Od. 15.238. b As in 4.b : ἄξομαι ἀμφοτέροις ἀλόχους Od. 21.214. Cf. Od. 4.10. 6 In reference to conducting a bride to her new home Od. 6.28. 7 In reference to speech, to cause to pass, utter: μῦθον ὃν οὔ κεν ἀνὴρ διὰ στόμʼ ἄγοιτο Il. 14.91.

a)nti/loxos.head: Ἀντίλοχος
a)nti/loxos.html: Ἀντίλοχος (ἀγλαός, ἀμύμων, δαΐφρων, διοτρεφής, θείειν ταχύς, θοὸς πολεμιστής , κρατερός, κυδάλιμος , μαχητής, μενεχάρμης , μήστωρ ἀϋτῆς, Νηλήϊος , πεπνυμένος). Patronymic Νεστορίδης. Son of Nestor. slays Echepolus-1 Il. 4.457; comes to the rescue of Menelaus Il. 5.565; slays Mydon-1 Il. 5.580 ; slays Ablerus Il. 6.32 ; slays the chariot-driver of Asius-2 Il. 13.396; slays Thoon-3 Il. 13.545; slays Phalces and Mermerus Il. 14.513 ; slays Melanippus-2 Il. 15.575; slays Atymnius Il. 16.318; hears from Menelaus of the death of Patroclus Il. 17.685 , announces the death to Achilles Il. 18.18; takes part in the chariot-race Il. 23.301, Nestor's advice to him 306, addresses his horses 402, gains the advantage of Menelaus and comes in second 417, objects to Achilles' proposal to give Eumelus the second prize 541, Menelaus accuses him of foul driving 566, Achilles pacifies him 586, takes part in the foot-race 756, comes in last 785; etc.: Nestor speaks of his death at Troy Od. 3.112; was slain by Memnon Od. 4.187, 202; in the Shades Od. 11.468, Od. 24.16; Od. 24.78.

a)nastre/fw.head: ἀναστρέφω
a)nastre/fw.html: ἀναστρέφω [ἀνα- 5, ἀνα- 6.] Contr. 3 pl. aor. opt. ἀνστρέψειαν Il. 23.436. 1 To upset: δίφρους Il. 23.436. 2 In mid., to go about over, find oneself in. With acc.: ἄλλην τινὰ γαῖαν ἀναστρέφομαι Od. 13.326.

a(palo/s.head: ἁπαλός
a(palo/s.html: ἁπαλός -ή, -όν. 1 Soft, tender, delicate: δειρήν Il. 3.371. Cf. Il. 13.202, Il. 17.49 = Il. 22.327, Il. 18.123, 177, Il. 19.285: χεῖρας Od. 21.151. Cf. Od. 22.16. Epithet of the life or vital principle: ἦτορ Il. 11.115. Of the feet, stepping delicately Il. 19.92. 2 In neut. ἁπαλόν as adv.: ἁ. γελάσαι (app., on small provocation, idly) Od. 14.465.

a)i/ssw.head: ἀΐσσω
a)i/ssw.html: ἀΐσσω 3 sing. aor. ἤϊξε Il. 4.78, Il. 11.118, Il. 13.65, Il. 20.277, Il. 21.247, 254, Il. 23.868: Od. 15.164. 3 pl. ἤϊξαν Il. 5.657: Od. 2.154, Od. 15.183. 3 sing. subj. ἀΐξῃ Il. 15.80, 580. 3 pl. ἀΐξωσι Il. 17.726. Pple. ἀΐξας, -ασα Il. 2.167, Il. 5.81, Il. 6.232, Il. 11.423, Il. 12.145, etc.: Od. 1.102, Od. 10.117, Od. 19.451, Od. 22.90, 98, Od. 24.488. 3 sing. pa. iterative ἀΐξασκε Il. 23.369. Aor. infin. mid. ἀΐξασθαι Il. 22.195. 3 sing. aor. pass. ἠΐχθη Il. 3.368. 3 dual ἀϊχθήτην Il. 24.97. 3 pl. ἠΐχθησαν Il. 16.404. Infin. ἀϊχθῆναι Il. 5.854. (ἀν-, ἀπ-, ἐπ-, μετ-, παρ-, προσ-, ὑπ-.) In all moods, to rush, fly, dart, of persons, animals, or things. 1 a In act.: βῆ ἀΐξασα Il. 2.167, ἄκοντες Il. 11.553. Cf. Il. 4.78, Il. 5.81, 657, Il. 6.232, Il. 11.118, Il. 17.579, Il. 24.320, etc.: αἰετώ Od. 2.154, λικριφίς Od. 19.451. Cf. Od. 1.102, Od. 10.117, Od. 22.90, etc. b In mid.: ἀμφὶ δέ τʼ ἀΐσσονται Il. 11.417, πυλάων ἀντίον ἀΐξασθαι Il. 22.195. c In pass.: ἔγχος ἠΐχθη Il. 11.368, ἐτώσιον ἀϊχθῆναι Il. 5.854, ἐς οὐρανὸν ἀϊχθήτην Il. 24.97. 2 In various shades of meaning. a In act., to rise to speak Il. 18.506 (the notion of quickness not here to be pressed). Of disembodied spirits, to flit about Od. 10.495. Of the mind, to be projected in thought Il. 15.80. Of chariots, to be tossed (into the air) Il. 23.369. Of light, to stream Il. 18.212. Of smoke, to rise into the air Od. 10.99. b In mid., of a horse's mane, to stream Il. 6.510 = Il. 15.267. c In pass., of reins, to slip (from the hands) Il. 16.404.

a)mfikalu/ptw.head: ἀμφικαλύπτω
a)mfikalu/ptw.html: ἀμφικαλύπτω [ἀμφι- 1, ἀμφι- 3.] Fut. ἀμφικαλύψω Il. 14.343. Infin. -ειν Od. 8.569, Od. 13.177. 3 sing. aor. ἀμφεκάλυψε Il. 3.442, Il. 5.68, Il. 8.331, Il. 16.350, etc.: Od. 4.180, 618, Od. 15.118. 3 sing. subj. ἀμφικαλύψῃ Od. 8.511, Od. 13.183, Od. 20.86. Pple. ἀμφικαλύψας Od. 5.493, Od. 14.349, Od. 23.17. Infin. ἀμφικαλύψαι Od. 13.152, 158. 1 To cover both of one's . . . (cf. ἀμφί I.1 b ). Of sleep: βλέθαρʼ ἀμφικαλύψας Od. 5.493. Cf. Od. 20.86, Od. 23.17. To cover completely a double (organ) (cf. ἀμφί I 1.b): ἔρως φρένας ἀμφεκάλυψεν Il. 3.442, Il. 14.294. 2 To cover up all round, enfold, conceal, contain Il. 2.262, Il. 23.91. Of a city, to receive within its walls Od. 8.511. Of a house, to receive as a guest Od. 4.618 = Od. 15.118. Fig. of death or fate Il. 5.68, Il. 12.116, Il. 16.350, Il. 20.417: Od. 4.180. 3 To put round, cover or protect with. With dat. of what is covered or protected: σἀκος οἱ Il. 8.331 = Il. 13.420. Cf. Il. 14.343: Od. 14.349. Sim., to put round (something) so as to isolate (it): ὄρος πόλει Od. 8.569, Od. 13.152, 158, 177, 183.

a)lei/fw.head: †ἀλείφω
a)lei/fw.html: †ἀλείφω Aor. ἄλειψα Od. 12.177, 200. 3 sing. ἤλειψε Od. 19.505. ἄλειψε Od. 6.227. 3 pl. ἤλειψαν Il. 18.350. Infin. ἀλεῖψαι Il. 24.582: Od. 12.47. 3 sing. aor. mid. ἀλείψατο Il. 14.171. Nom. dual masc. pple. ἀλειψαμένω Il. 10.577. Nom. fem. ἀλειψαμένη Il. 14.175. (προσ-.) 1 To oil, anoint with oil Il. 18.350, Il. 24.582: Od. 6.227, Od. 19.505. 2 To stop (the ears) with wax: ἐπʼ οὔατʼ ἀλεῖψαι (ἄλειψα) Od. 12.47, 177. To put (wax) in the ears Od. 12.200. 3 In mid., to anoint oneself: ἀλείψατο λίπʼ ἐλαίῳ Il. 14.171. Cf. Il. 10.577, Il. 14.175.

a)/mfw.head: ἄμφω
a)/mfw.html: ἄμφω Only in nom. and acc. of same form. Both. Constructed with dual or pl. 1 Of two persons, etc. a Absol.: ἀ. θιλέουσα Il. 1.196. Cf. Il. 1.259, Il. 2.767, Il. 3.148, Il. 5.153, etc.: ἀ. ἱέσθην Od. 3.344. Cf. Od. 8.316, Od. 10.138, Od. 12.424, Od. 13.296, Od. 15.366, Od. 18.65, 372. b With sb. or pron.: ἀ. χεῖρε Il. 4.523. Cf. Il. 5.258, Il. 6.19, Il. 7.255, Il. 11.782, etc.: τοὺς ἀ. Od. 11.301. Cf. Od. 5.453, Od. 8.135, Od. 16.15, Od. 18.89, etc. 2 Of two groups of persons: ἀριθμηθήμεναι ἀ. Il. 2.124.

a)koua/zomai.head: ἀκουάζομαι
a)koua/zomai.html: ἀκουάζομαι [ἀκούω.] To listen to, give ear to. With genit.: ἀοιδοῦ Od. 9.7, Od. 13.9. To hear of. With double genit. of person from whom one hears of a thing and of the thing: δαιτὸς ἐμεῖο Il. 4.343.

ai)gi/oxos.head: αἰγίοχος
ai)gi/oxos.html: αἰγίοχος [αἰγίς + ὀχ-, ἔχω.] Aegis-bearing. Epithet of Zeus Il. 1.202, Il. 2.157, Il. 3.426, etc.: Od. 3.42, Od. 4.752, Od. 5.103, etc.

a)/budos.head: Ἄβυδος
a)/budos.html: Ἄβυδος A city on the southeast of the Hellespont, a little below Sestus on the other side Il. 2.836. Ἀβυδόθεν [-θεν], from Abydus Il. 4.500 . Ἀβυδόθι [-θι], at Abydus Il. 16.584 .

a)lalu/kthmai.head: ἀλαλύκτημαι
a)lalu/kthmai.html: ἀλαλύκτημαι [pf. pass. fr. *ἀλυκτέω, conn. with ἀλύω.] To be distraught or sore distressed Il. 10.94.

a)ekh/lios.head: ἀεκήλιος
a)ekh/lios.html: ἀεκήλιος [app. = ἀεικέλιος.] Baneful, baleful Il. 18.77.

a)rgino/eis.head: ἀργινόεις
a)rgino/eis.html: ἀργινόεις -εντος [ἀργός.] White. Epithet of cities (app. from white cliffs) Il. 2.647, 656.

a)nta/cios.head: ἀντάξιος
a)nta/cios.html: ἀντάξιος [ἀντ-, ἀντι- 4 (practically as intensive) + ἄξιος.] 1 Worth, the equal or equivalent of. With genit.: πολλῶν ἀ. ἄλλων Il. 11.514. 2 Forming a suitable equivalent Il. 1.136. Absol. in neut. ἀντάξιον, an equivalentIl. 9.401.

a)gorhth/s.head: ἀγορητής
a)gorhth/s.html: ἀγορητής -οῦ, ὁ [ἀγορή.] An orator or speaker Il. 1.248, Il. 2.246, Il. 3.150, Il. 4.293, Il. 7.126, Il. 19.82: Od. 20.274.

a)ikh/.head: ἀϊκή
a)ikh/.html: ἀϊκή -ῆς, ἡ [ἀϊκ-, ἀΐσσω.] Flight, rush: τόξων Il. 15.709.

a(/zomai.head: ἅζομαι
a(/zomai.html: ἅζομαι Imp. ἅζευ Od. 17.401. To reverence, stand in awe of, respect Il. 1.21, Il. 5.434, 830: Od. 9.200, Od. 17.401 (τό γε, to that point.). With infin., to shrink from doing something: λείβειν οἶνον Il. 6.267: ξείνους ἐσθέμεναι Od. 9.478. With μή clause: μὴ νυκτὶ ἀποθύμια ἕρδοι Il. 14.261.

a)ka/matos.head: ἀκάματος
a)ka/matos.html: ἀκάματος [as ἀκάμας.] Tireless. Epithet of fire, steadily or fiercely blazing Il. 5.4, Il. 15.598, 731, Il. 16.122, Il. 18.225, Il. 21.13, 341, Il. 23.52: Od. 20.123, Od. 21.181.

a)raiqure/h.head: Ἀραιθυρέη
a)raiqure/h.html: Ἀραιθυρέη (ἐρατεινή). A town in Agamemnon's realm Il. 2.571.

a)tu/mnios.head: Ἀτύμνιος
a)tu/mnios.html: Ἀτύμνιος Trojan. (ἀκοντιστης). Son of Amisodarus and brother of Maris. Killed by Antilochus Il. 16.317.

a)/rtemis.head: Ἄρτεμις
a)/rtemis.html: Ἄρτεμις (ἁγνή, ἀγροτέρη, ἐϋπλόκαμος, ἰοχέαιρα, κελαδεινή, πότνα θεά, χρυσηλάκατος, χρυσήνιος, χρυσόθρονος). Daughter of Zeus and Leto and sister of Apollo Il. 5.51, 53, 447, Il. 6.205; her death-dealing shafts, always (except Od. 5.123) directed against women (those of Apollo against men) Il. 6.428, Il. 19.59, Il. 24.606 (cf. Od. 11.172, 324, Od. 15.410, 478, Od. 18.202, Od. 20.60, 61, 80); Il. 9.533, Il. 16.183, Il. 20.39, 71; in the Battle of the Gods reproaches Apollo Il. 21.471, Hera assaults her 489 : Od. 4.122, Od. 6.102, 151, Od. 17.37, Od. 19.54, Od. 20.71.

a)tu/zomai.head: ἀτύζομαι
a)tu/zomai.html: ἀτύζομαι Aor. pple. ἀτυχθείς Il. 6.468. 1 To be terrified or distraught, to be panic-stricken, flee scared: ἀτυζόμενοι φοβέοντο Il. 6.41, ἀτυζομένην ἀπολέσθαι (distraught to the point of death) Il. 22.474. Cf. Il. 6.38, Il. 8.183, Il. 15.90, Il. 18.7, Il. 21.4, 554: Od. 11.606, Od. 23.42. 2 To be scared or put out by: πατρὸς ὄψιν ἀτυχθείς Il. 6.468.

a)/rshn.head: ἄρσην
a)/rshn.html: ἄρσην -ενος. Male Il. 7.315, Il. 8.7, Il. 12.451, Il. 20.495, Il. 23.377: Od. 9.425, 438, Od. 13.81, Od. 19.420. Absol. Od. 9.238, Od. 14.16.

a)ta/llw.head: ἀτάλλω
a)ta/llw.html: ἀτάλλω [cf. ἀταλός.] To gambol Il. 13.27.

a)ska/nios.head: Ἀσκάνιος
a)ska/nios.html: Ἀσκάνιος (θεοειδής). Came from Ascania, son of Hippotion. A leader of the Phrygians Il. 2.862, Il. 13.792.

a)blhxro/s.head: ἀβληχρός
a)blhxro/s.html: ἀβληχρός -ή, -όν. App., feeble, weak, gentle: χεῖρα Il. 5.337, τείχεα Il. 21.178: θάνατος Od. 11.135, Od. 23.282.

au)=qi.head: αὖθι
au)=qi.html: αὖθι [contr. fr. αὐτόθι.] 1 On the spot, there: αὐ. μένων Il. 1.492, ἑζόμενος δὲ κατʼ αὐ. (κατά adv. with the pple.) Il. 13.653, κατʼ αὐ. λίπον Il. 17.535. Cf. Il. 2.328, Il. 10.62, Il. 11.48, Il. 13.37, Il. 22.137, etc.: αὐ. παρʼ Ἀτρεΐδῃ Od. 3.156. Cf. Od. 4.416, Od. 8.275, Od. 10.567, Od. 17.357, etc. So παρʼ αὐ. = παρʼ αὐτόθι (see αὐτόθι (1)) Il. 23.163. 2 On the spot, here: μηκέτʼ αὐ. λεγώμεθα Il. 2.435. Cf. Il. 3.291, Il. 6.84, Il. 9.412, Il. 13.233, etc.: μένʼ αὐ. Od. 2.369. Cf. Od. 7.314, Od. 12.24, Od. 13.44, Od. 20.220, etc. 3 On the spot, at once: αὐ. λύθη ψυχή Il. 5.296. Cf. Il. 6.281, Il. 11.141, Il. 16.331, Il. 17.298, etc.: Od. 18.91, etc.

a)stero/eis.head: ἀστερόεις
a)stero/eis.html: ἀστερόεις -εντος [ἀστήρ.] 1 Starry. Epithet of οὐρανός Il. 4.44, Il. 5.769 = Il. 8.46, Il. 6.108, Il. 15.371, Il. 19.128, 130: Od. 9.527, Od. 11.17, Od. 12.380, Od. 20.113. 2 App., adorned with star-like ornaments (or perh., shining with star-like radiance): θώρηκα Il. 16.134, δόμον Il. 18.370.

a)patima/w.head: ἀπατιμάω
a)patima/w.html: ἀπατιμάω [ἀπ-, ἀπο- 7.] To lay dishonour upon: Πηλεΐωνα Il. 13.113.

a)peilhth/r.head: ἀπειλητήρ
a)peilhth/r.html: ἀπειλητήρ -ῆρος, ὁ [ἀπειλέω.] A boaster Il. 7.96.

a(dino/s.head: ἁδινός
a(dino/s.html: ἁδινός -ή, -όν. App. orig. expressing quick incessant motion. Hence 1 Of bees, flying in swarms Il. 2.87. Sim. of flies Il. 2.469. Of sheep, thick-thronging Od. 1.92 = Od. 4.320. Of the heart, beating, throbbing Il. 16.481: Od. 19.516. Of weeping, thick-coming, vehement Il. 18.316, Il. 22.430, Il. 23.17, Il. 24.747. Of the Sirens, trilling their song Od. 23.326. 2 In neut. ἁδινόν, as adv., of the expression of grief, with thick-coming bursts, vehemently: στοναχῆσαι Il. 18.124: γοόωσα Od. 4.721. Of the incessant lowing of calves Od. 10.413. So in pl. ἁδινά: στεναχίζων Il. 23.225. Cf. Il. 24.123, 510: Od. 7.274, Od. 24.317. So also in neut. comp. ἁδινώτερον: κλαῖον ἁ. ἤ τʼ οἰωνοί Od. 16.216.

a(/lios.head: ἅλιος1
a(/lios.html:
ἅλιος1, -η, -ον [ἅλς1.] Of the sea Il. 1.538 = 556, Il. 18.86, 139, 141, Il. 20.107, Il. 24.84, 562: Od. 3.38, Od. 4.349 = Od. 17.140, Od. 4.365, 384, 401, 438, 542, Od. 13.96, 345, Od. 24.47, 55, 58. Absol. in fem. pl., sea-goddesses Il. 18.432.
ἅλιος2, -η, -ον. 1 Ineffective, effecting nothing, useless, idle, vain, fruitless: πόνον Il. 4.26. Cf. Il. 4.158, 179, 498 = Il. 15.575, Il. 5.18, 715, Il. 11.376, 380, Il. 14.455, Il. 16.480, Il. 18.324, Il. 24.92, 224: ὁδός Od. 2.273, 318. Of a person, inefficient: σκοπός Il. 10.324. 2 In neut. ἅλιον as adv., in vain, without result Il. 13.410, 505 = Il. 16.615.
Ἅλιος-1 Trojan. killed by Odysseus Il. 5.678.
Ἅλιος-2 Son of Alcinous Od. 8.119, 370.

a)/th.head: ἄτη
a)/th.html:
ἄτη -ης, ἡ (ἀϝάτη). 1 Stupor: ἀ. φρένας εἷλεν Il. 16.805. 2 Blindness of the mind sent by the gods, a divine perversion or deception of the mind leading to evil-doing or mischance: Ζεύς μʼ ἄτῃ ἐνέδησεν Il. 2.111 = Il. 9.18, ὡς ὅτʼ ἂν ἄνδρʼ ἀ. λάβῃ Il. 24.480 (the time of this clause and of κατακτείνας in 481 the same; the homicide has been done under impulse of the ἄτη). Cf. Il. 1.412 = Il. 16.274, Il. 6.356, Il. 8.237, Il. 19.88, Il. 24.28: ἄτην μετέστενον Od. 4.261. Cf. Od. 15.233, Od. 21.302, Od. 23.223. In pl. Il. 9.115, Il. 19.270.– Personified Il. 9.504, 505, 512, Il. 19.91, 126, 129, 136. 3 Such blindness or deception of human origin. In pl. Il. 10.391. 4 Hurt, harm: εἴς μʼ ἄτην κοιμήσατε (to my hurt) Od. 12.372.
Ἄτη (ᾱ). πρέσβα Διὸς θυγάτηρ 91 . See further in Lexicon.

a)gre/w.head: †ἀγρέω
a)gre/w.html: †ἀγρέω To take. Only in imp. ἄγρει followed by an imp. Come!: ἀ. ἔπορσον Il. 5.765, ἀ. καταχεῦαι Il. 7.459. Cf. Il. 11.512, Il. 14.271: Od. 21.176. So in pl.: ἀγρεῖτε κορήσατε Od. 20.149.

a)podate/omai.head: †ἀποδατέομαι
a)podate/omai.html: †ἀποδατέομαι [ἀπο- 7.] Fut. ἀποδάσσομαι Il. 17.231, Il. 24.595. Infin. ἀποδάσσεσθαι Il. 22.118. 1 To divide (with a person). With dat.: Ἀχαιοῖς ἄλλα Il. 22.118. Cf. Il. 24.595. 2 To give as a portion: ἥμισυ ἐνάρων Il. 17.231.

a)fikne/omai.head: †ἀφικνέομαι
a)fikne/omai.html: †ἀφικνέομαι [ἀφ-, ἀπο- 7.] 2 sing. fut. ἀφίξεαι Od. 12.39, 127. 3 sing. -εται Il. 18.270. 2 sing. aor. ἀφίκεο Od. 1.171, Od. 14.188, Od. 15.489. 3 sing. -ετο Il. 13.645, Il. 18.395: Od. 1.332, Od. 5.55, Od. 10.502, Od. 15.228, Od. 16.414, Od. 18.208, Od. 20.55, Od. 21.25, 42, 63, Od. 23.338. 1 pl. -όμεθα Od. 3.278, Od. 9.181, 216, 543, Od. 10.1, 135, Od. 11.22. 3 pl. ἀφίκοντο Il. 11.618, Il. 13.329, Il. 22.208, Il. 24.329, 448: Od. 14.344, Od. 17.205. Subj. ἀφίκωμαι Il. 24.431: Od. 23.269. 2 sing. -ηαι Il. 8.482, Il. 11.208: Od. 11.122, Od. 15.36. 3 sing. -ηται Il. 11.193, Il. 16.63. 1 pl. -ώμεθα Od. 16.382. 3 pl. -ωνται Il. 17.454. Opt. ἀφῐκοίμην Od. 20.81. 2 sing. -οιο Od. 15.128. 2 pl. -οίμεθα Od. 10.420, Od. 12.345. Imp. pl. ἀφίκεσθε Od. 8.202. Infin. ἀφῖκέσθαι Il. 10.281: Od. 4.255. Pf. infin. ἀφῖχθαι Od. 6.297. 1 To come to an indicated place: ὁπποίης ἐπὶνηὸς ἀφίκεο (came here) Od. 1.171 = Od. 14.188. 2 To go, proceed, take one's way. With preps.: ἐς Ὀλυμπον Od. 20.55, γαῖαν ὕπο Od. 20.81. With acc. of the place: ἄλλων δῆμον Od. 15.228 (fled to . . .), Od. 16.382 (be forced to flee to . . .). 3 To present oneself before, come into the presence of: μνηστῆρας Od. 1.332 = Od. 18.208 = Od. 21.63, Od. 16.414. Cf. Od. 21.25. 4 a With notion of attainment prominent, to come to, arrive at, reach, find oneself at, be at, a specified place: οὐδʼ ἢν ἔνθʼ ἀφίκηαι Il. 8.482. b With preps. α εἰς, ἐς: ἐς κλισίην Il. 24.431: εἰς ἄντρον Od. 9.216. Cf. Od. 4.255, Od. 10.1, 135, 420, 502, Od. 11.22, Od. 12.127, 345, Od. 23.338. β ἐπί: νῆας Il. 10.281. Cf. Il. 22.208: Od. 17.205. γ κατά: στρατόν Il. 13.329. δ ποτί: δώματα Od. 6.297. c With acc.: νῆας Il. 11.193, 208, Il. 17.454. Cf. Il. 11.618, Il. 13.645, Il. 18.270, Il. 24.329, 448: Σούνιον Od. 3.278. Cf. Od. 5.55, Od. 9.181, 543, Od. 11.122, Od. 12.39, Od. 14.344, Od. 15.36, 128, 489, Od. 21.42, Od. 23.269. Of sound: ὁπότʼ ἂν νῆας ἐμὰς ἀφίκηται ἀϋτή Il. 16.63. Of reaching a mark in a contest Od. 8.202. 5 Of a feeling, to come upon, seize, affect: ὅτε μʼ ἄλγος ἀφίκετο Il. 18.395.

a)/nalkis.head: ἄναλκις
a)/nalkis.html: ἄναλκις -ιδος, ὁ, ἡ [ἀν- 1 + ἀλκή.] Acc. masc. ἄναλκιν Od. 3.375. Incapable of offering defence or resistance, spiritless, cowardly Il. 2.201, Il. 5.331, 349, Il. 8.153, Il. 11.390, Il. 13.104, Il. 16.355, Il. 21.555, etc.: Od. 3.310, 375, Od. 4.334 = Od. 17.125, Od. 9.475. As epithet of φύζα Il. 15.62.

a)me/lgw.head: ἀμέλγω
a)me/lgw.html: ἀμέλγω (ἐν-.) To milk Od. 9.238, 244 = 341, 308. In pass. with the milk in acc.: ἀμελγόμεναι γάλα Il. 4.434.

a)rgh/s.head: ἀργής
a)rgh/s.html: ἀργής -ῆτος. Also -έτος Il. 11.818, Il. 21.127 [ἀργός.] 1 White: ἑανῷ Il. 3.419. Cf. Il. 11.818, Il. 21.127. 2 Bright, glancing, vivid: κεραυνόν Il. 8.133. Cf. Od. 5.128, 131, Od. 7.249, Od. 12.387.

a)gku/los.head: ἀγκύλος
a)gku/los.html: ἀγκύλος [ἄγκος.] Curved. Epithet of τόξα Il. 5.209, Il. 6.322: Od. 21.264. Of ἅρμα (referring to the curved form of the front) Il. 6.39.

ai)twlo/s.head: Αἰτωλός
ai)twlo/s.html: Αἰτωλός Of Aetolia, a district of Greece having the Achelous on the west, and bounded by the Gulf of Corinth on the south. Of Thoas-1 Il. 4.527 . Of Diomedes Il. 23.471. Of one who beguiled Eumaeus Od. 14.379. In pl., the men of Aetolia G (μεγάθυμοι, μενεχάρμαι) Il. 2.638, 643, Il. 5.843; their strife with the Couretes (see Κουρῆτες) Il. 9.529, 531, 549, 575, 597; Il. 13.218, Il. 15.282, Il. 23.633.

a)poni/zw.head: ἀπονίζω
a)poni/zw.html: ἀπονίζω [ἀπο- 1, ἀπο- 7.] Aor. imp. pl. ἀπονίψατε Od. 19.317. Masc. pl. pple. ἀπονίψαντες Od. 24.189. Fem. pple. mid. ἀπονιψαμένη Od. 18.172. Masc. pl. -οι Od. 22.478. Pres. infin. mid. in form ἀπονίπτεσθαι Od. 18.179. 1 To wash off or away Od. 24.189. 2 To wash (a person) Od. 19.317. Absol. Od. 23.75. 3 In mid. a To wash off or away from a part of one's person. With double acc.: ἱδρῶ κνήμας Il. 10.572. b To wash (one's person or a part thereof): χρῶτʼ ἀπονιψαμένη Od. 18.172. Cf. Od. 18.179, Od. 22.478.

a)rkadi/h.head: Ἀρκαδίη
a)rkadi/h.html: Ἀρκαδίη The country of the Arcadians Il. 2.603.

a)frai/nw.head: ἀφραίνω
a)frai/nw.html: ἀφραίνω [ἄφρων.] 1 To act senselessly, foolishly or recklessly Il. 2.258, Il. 7.109. 2 To be out of one's mind, be beside oneself Od. 20.360.

a)mpelo/eis.head: ἀμπελόεις
a)mpelo/eis.html: ἀμπελόεις -εσσα [ἄμπελος.] Rich in vines. Epithet of places Il. 2.561, Il. 3.184, Il. 9.152 = 294.

a)sto/s.head: ἀστός
a)sto/s.html: ἀστός -οῦ, ὁ [ἄστυ.] A (fellow-)citizen: ἀστοῖσιν ἀρήγων Il. 11.242: μή μιν πρὶν γνοῖεν ἀστοί Od. 13.192.

a)pope/tomai.head: †ἀποπέτομαι
a)pope/tomai.html: †ἀποπέτομαι [ἀπο- 1.] Aor. pple. ἀποπτάμενος Il. 2.71. Fem. -η Od. 11.222. To fly away Il. 2.71: Od. 11.222.

a)ntia/w.head: †ἀντιάω
a)ntia/w.html: †ἀντιάω [ἀντίος.] 3 pl. ἀντιόωσι Il. 6.127, Il. 21.151. Acc. sing. fem. pple. ἀντιόωσαν Il. 1.31. 3 pl. imp. ἀντιοώντων Il. 23.643. Infin. ἀντιάαν Il. 13.215. Fut. ἀντιόω Il. 12.368, Il. 13.752. Pple. ἀντιόων, -ωντος Il. 20.125: Od. 1.25. Fem. ἀντιόωσα Il. 21.431: Od. 3.436, Od. 24.56. 2 sing. fut. ἀντιάσεις Od. 22.28. 2 dual aor. subj. ἀντιάσητον Il. 12.356. 2 sing. opt. ἀντιάσειας Od. 18.147. 3 sing. ἀντιάσειε Il. 13.290: Od. 12.88, Od. 13.292, Od. 21.402. 1 pl. ἀντιάσαιμεν Il. 7.231. Pple. ἀντιάσας, -αντος Il. 1.67, Il. 10.551, Il. 15.297: Od. 6.193, Od. 7.293, Od. 13.312, Od. 14.511, Od. 17.442. 2 pl. impf. mid. ἀντιάασθε Il. 24.62. (ὑπ-.) 1 To meet or encounter someone: θεὸν ἀντιάσαντα Il. 10.551: ἱκέτην ἀντιάσαντα (who has met one who can help him) Od. 6.193 = Od. 14.511. Cf. Od. 7.293, Od. 12.88, Od. 13.292, 312, Od. 17.442. 2 To encounter in fight. With genit.: σέθεν Il. 7.231. With dat.: ἐμῷ μένει Il. 6.127 = Il. 21.151, Il. 21.431: ἐκείνῳ Od. 18.147. Absol. Il. 15.297. 3 Of a missile, to reach, strike. With genit.: στέρνων Il. 13.290. 4 To find, get. With genit.: ὀνήσιος Od. 21.402. 5 To join, come to. With genit.: παιδὸς τεθνηότος Od. 24.56. 6 With genit., to take part in: πόνοιο Il. 12.356. Cf. Il. 12.368 = Il. 13.752, Il. 13.215, Il. 20.125, Il. 23.643: ἀέθλων Od. 22.28. In mid.: ἀντιάασθε γάμου Il. 24.62.– Of a god, to take part in (a sacrifice): ἑκατόμβης Od. 1.25, ἱρῶν Od. 3.436. To accept of (a sacrifice) Il. 1.67. With acc., to come to share: ἐμὸν λέχος Il. 1.31.

a)posfa/llw.head: †ἀποσφάλλω
a)posfa/llw.html: †ἀποσφάλλω [ἀπο- 1.] 3 pl. aor. subj. ἀποσφήλωσι Od. 3.320. 3 sing. opt. ἀποσθήλειε Il. 5.567. 1 To balk of the fruits of. With genit.: πόνοιο Il. 5.567. 2 To drive from one's course Od. 3.320.

a)reta/w.head: ἀρετάω
a)reta/w.html: ἀρετάω [ἀρετή.] To thrive, prosper: οὐκ ἀρετᾷ κακὰ ἔργα Od. 8.329, ἀρετῶσι λαοί Od. 19.114.

a)perweu/s.head: ἀπερωεύς
a)perweu/s.html: ἀπερωεύς ὁ [ἀπερωέω, in causal sense. Cf. ἐρωέω1 4.] A thwarter: ἐμῶν μενέων Il. 8.361.

a)/rhs.head: Ἄρης
a)/rhs.html:
Ἄρης [use of the proper name.] Genit. Ἄρηος. Dat. Ἄρηϊ, Ἄρῃ. Acc. Ἄρηα. 1 War, battle Il. 2.381, 385, Il. 3.132, Il. 9.532, Il. 13.630, Il. 19.142, Il. 21.112, etc.: Od. 16.269, Od. 20.50. 2 Applied to wounds inflicted in war: ἔνθα μάλιστα γίγνετʼ Ἀ. ἀλεγεινός Il. 13.569.
Ἄρης (α᷌). Genit. Ἄρεος (α᷌), Ἄρηος (α᷌)). Dat. Ἄρεϊ (α᷌), Ἄρει (ᾱ) , Ἄρηϊ (α᷌), Ἄρῃ (ᾰ) . Acc. Ἄρηα (α᷌). Voc. Ἆρες, Ἄρες. (ἀΐδηλος, ἀλλοπρόσαλλος , ἀνδροφόνος, ἆτος πολέμοιο , βριήπυος, βροτολοιγός , ἐγχέσπαλος, θοός , θοῦρος, κορυθαίολος , κρατερός, λαοσσόος , μιαιφόνος, ὄβριμος , ὀξύς, οὖλος, πελώριος, πτολίπορθος, ῥινοτόρος, ταλαύρινος πολεμιστής , τειχεσιπλήτης, χάλκεος , χρυσήνιος). See also Ἐνυάλιος. Son of Zeus and Her and father by Astyoche of Ascalaphus and Ialmenus. Athene leads him from the fray Il. 5.30; Aphrodite begs the use of his horses Il. 5.355; had been put in bonds by Otus-1 and Ephialtes Il. 5.385 ; Athene and Diomedes go against him Il. 5.840, Diomedes wounds him and puts him to flight 855, his complaint to Zeus 872 , he is cured 899; his rage on hearing of the death of Ascalaphus Il. 15.113, restrained by Athene 125; in the Battle of the Gods attacks Athene Il. 21.391, who lays him low 403 , Aphrodite leads him off 416, Athene lays them both low 423; etc: Od. 8.115; Demodocus's tale of Ares and Aphrodite Od. 8.266, 276 , 285, 309, 330, 345, 353, 355; Od. 8.518, Od. 11.537, Od. 14.216, Od. 16.269, Od. 20.50. See also Ἄρης in Lexicon.

a)blh/s.head: ἀβλής
a)blh/s.html: ἀβλής -ῆτος [ἀ-1 + βλη-, βάλλω.] Not (yet) shot, new: ἰόν Il. 4.117.

a)popla/zw.head: †ἀποπλάζω
a)popla/zw.html: †ἀποπλάζω [ἀπο- 1.] 2 sing. aor. pass. ἀπεπλάγχθης Od. 8.573, Od. 15.382. 3 sing. -η Il. 22.291. Pple. ἀποπλαγχθείς, -έντος Il. 13.592: Od. 9.259, Od. 12.285. Fem. -εῖσα Il. 13.578. In pass. 1 To be driven from one's course: Τροίηθεν (i.e. in the course of the voyage from Troy) Od. 9.259. 2 To wander or rove under stress of circumstances Od. 8.573. 3 With genit., to be carried away from: πατρίδος Od. 15.382. App. of voluntarily steering a course away from: νήσου Od. 12.285. 4 Of a missile, to glance off (from something) Il. 13.592. To glance off from. With genit.: σάκεος Il. 22.291. 5 Of something struck, to be struck off Il. 13.578.

a)lu/w.head: ἀλύω
a)lu/w.html: ἀλύω ( υ Od. 9.398). 1 To be beside oneself from pain or grief: ἀλύουσʼ ἀπεβήσετο Il. 5.352. Cf. Il. 24.12. From exultation Od. 18.333 = 393. 2 To manifest distraction by gestures: χερσὶν ἀλύων Od. 9.398.

a)/loxos.head: ἄλοχος
a)/loxos.html: ἄλοχος -ου, ἡ [ἀ-2 + λοχ-, λέχος.] A wife, one's wife Il. 1.114, Il. 2.136, Il. 5.480, Il. 6.95, Il. 9.336, etc.: Od. 1.36, Od. 3.264, Od. 4.92, Od. 5.210, Od. 8.243, Od. 11.117, Od. 12.452, etc.

a)mfi/maxos.head: Ἀμφίμαχος-1
a)mfi/maxos.html:
Ἀμφίμαχος-1 (μεγαλήτωρ) See Ἀκτορίων. Son of Cteatus and grandson of Poseidon, and a leader of the Epeians Il. 2.620. Killed by Hector Il. 13.185, 189, 195, 203; Poseidon's wrath at his slaying Il. 13.206.
Ἀμφίμαχος-2 (ἀγλαός). Son of Nomion and a leader of the Carians Il. 2.870, 871. Killed by Achilles Il. 2.874.

a)mfiforeu/s.head: ἀμφιφορεύς
a)mfiforeu/s.html: ἀμφιφορεύς -ῆος, ὁ [ἀμφι- 2 + θορ-, θέρω.] A two-handled jar Il. 23.92, 170: Od. 2.290, 349, 379, Od. 9.164, 204, Od. 13.105 (of natural formations in a cave), Od. 24.74.

a)/dmhtos.head: ἄδμητος
a)/dmhtos.html:
ἄδμητος -η [as ἀδμής.] Not broken in : βοῦν Il. 10.293. Cf. Il. 23.266, 655: Od. 3.383.
Ἄδμητος Husband of Alcestis and father of Eumelus Il. 2.713, 714, Il. 23.289, 391, 532.

a)qhnai=os.head: Ἀθηναῖος
a)qhnai=os.html: Ἀθηναῖος Greek. (μήστωρες ἀϋτῆς). Ἀθηναῖοι, the Athenians Il. 2.551, 558, Il. 4.328, Il. 13.196, 689, Il. 15.337.

a)stua/nac.head: Ἀστυάναξ
a)stua/nac.html: Ἀστυάναξ (ἀγαπητός, ἀλίγκιος ἀστέρι καλῷ). Infant son of Hector and Andromache (called Scamandrius by his father). The name explained Il. 6.403; Il. 22.500, 506.

a)a/sxetos.head: ἀάσχετος
a)a/sxetos.html: ἀάσχετος [an unexplained form.] = ἄσχετος. Not to be restrained, ungovernable: μένος Il. 5.892. Of grief, uncontrollable: πένθος Il. 24.708.

ai)gialo/s.head: αἰγιαλός
ai)gialo/s.html:
αἰγιαλός -οῦ, ὁ. A beach or shore of the sea: ὡς ὅτε κῦμα θαλάσσης αἰγιαλῷ μεγάλῳ βρέμεται Il. 2.210. Cf. Il. 4.422, Il. 14.34: Od. 22.385.
Αἰγιαλός-1 A town in Agamemnon's realm Il. 2.575.
Αἰγιαλός-2 A Paphlagonian town Il. 2.855.

a)gkulo/tocos.head: ἀγκυλότοξος
a)gkulo/tocos.html: ἀγκυλότοξος [ἀγκύλος + τόξον.] Armed with curved bows, bearing bows. Epithet of the Paeonians Il. 2.848, Il. 10.428.

a)peme/w.head: †ἀπεμέω
a)peme/w.html: †ἀπεμέω [ἀπ-, ἀπο- 1.] 3 sing. aor. ἀπέμεσσε. To vomit forth, throw up: αἷμα Il. 14.437.

a)utmh/.head: ἀϋτμή
a)utmh/.html: ἀϋτμή -ῆς, ἡ [ἀϋ-τ-μή. ἀϝ-, ἄ(ϝ)ημι.] 1 Breath Il. 9.609, Il. 10.89. 2 Of the wind from bellows Il. 18.471. Of the blowing of the winds Od. 11.400 = 407. Of the breath of fire Il. 21.366: Od. 9.389, Od. 16.290 = Od. 19.9, Od. 19.20 (in these three passages referring to smoke). Of fragrance or odour: κνίσης αὐ. Od. 12.369. Cf. Il. 14.174.

a)ma/qeia.head: Ἀμάθεια
a)ma/qeia.html: Ἀμάθεια (ὲϋπλόκαμος). A Nereid Il. 18.48 .

a)mfafa/w.head: †ἀμφαφάω
a)mfafa/w.html: †ἀμφαφάω [ἀμφ-, ἀμφι- 3.] Pres. pple. ἀμφαφόων Od. 8.196. Acc. pl. ἀμφαφόωντας Od. 19.586. Fem. ἀμφαφόωσα Od. 4.277. 3 pl. impf. mid. ἀμφαφόωντο Od. 15.462. Infin. ἀμφαφάασθαι Il. 22.373: Od. 8.215, Od. 19.475. 1 To put the hands round, handle. In mid.: [ὅρμον] ἀμφαφόωντο Od. 15.462. Cf. Od. 19.475. So μαλακώτερος ἀμφαφάασθαι (easier to deal with) Il. 22.373. To handle and use: τόξον Od. 19.586. In mid. Od. 8.215. 2 To put the hands on in passing round: κοῖλον λόχον (the wooden horse) Od. 4.277. 3 Absol., to feel about with the hands Od. 8.196.

a)pode/xomai.head: †ἀποδέχομαι
a)pode/xomai.html: †ἀποδέχομαι [ἀπο- 7.] 3 sing. aor. ἀπεδέξατο. To accept: ἄποινα Il. 1.95.

a)nh/noqe.head: †ἀνήνοθε
a)nh/noqe.html: †ἀνήνοθε [3 sing., in the first passage of a plupf. (with secondary person-ending), in the second of a pf., fr. ἀνεθ- = ἀνθ-, ἄνθος. (Cf. ἐνήνοθε).] (ἐπ-.) To come to the surface, come forth: αἷμʼ ἀ. Il. 11.266. To rise up, spread upwards: κνίση ἀ. Od. 17.270.

a)koi/ths.head: ἀκοίτης
a)koi/ths.html: ἀκοίτης -ου, ὁ [ἀ-2 + κοῖτος.] A husband, one's husband Il. 15.91: Od. 5.120, Od. 21.88.

a)ntiferi/zw.head: ἀντιφερίζω
a)ntiferi/zw.html: ἀντιφερίζω [ἀντιφέρω.] To set oneself against, rival. With dat.: σοί Il. 21.357, ὅτι μοι μένος ἀντιφερίζεις (in the matter of might) 488.

a)nthnori/dhs.head: Ἀντηνορίδης
a)nthnori/dhs.html: Ἀντηνορίδης Patronymic from next. Of Helicaon Il. 3.122 , 123. Of Laodocus-1 Il. 4.87. Of Polybus-1 Il. 11.59. Of Agenor Il. 11.59 . Of Acamas-1 Il. 11.59 . Of Iphidamas Il. 11.221. Of Coon Il. 11.249 , Il. 19.53.

au)/tws.head: αὔτως
au)/tws.html: αὔτως [adv. fr. αὐτός with changed accent.] 1 Without change, as before, as ever: ἔργον αὐ. ἀκράαντόν [ἐστιν] Il. 2.138. Cf. Od. 13.336. 2 Just as one or it is (was): αὐ. ἧσθαι δευόμενον Il. 1.133, ὅσσʼ ἔρρεξεν αὐ. (without extraneous aid) Il. 10.50, κτενέει με αὐ. (without effort) Il. 22.125, λευκὸν ἔτʼ αὐ. (fresh from the maker's hand) Il. 23.268, δίδωμί τοι τόδʼ ἄεθλον αὐ. (without a contest) 621. Cf. Il. 5.255, Il. 16.117, Il. 18.198, 338, Il. 24.413: οἴχεται αὐ. (trusting to his own resources) Od. 4.665, αὐ. ἐκείμεθα Od. 13.281, οὐδέ τις ἡμέας αὐ. ἀππέμψει (empty-handed) Od. 15.83, ἦ αὐ. κεῖται ἀκηδής; (without attention) Od. 20.130. Cf. Od. 12.284.–καὶ αὐ., even as it is, without that: καὶ αὐ. νεικεῖ Il. 1.520. Strengthening ὥς Il. 3.339, Il. 7.430, Il. 9.195, Il. 10.25: Od. 3.64, Od. 6.166, Od. 9.31, Od. 20.238, Od. 21.203, 225, Od. 22.114, Od. 24.409. 3 Quite, just: ἄφρονα αὐ. Il. 3.220. Cf. Il. 6.400, Il. 7.100, Il. 22.484, Il. 24.726. 4 Just, merely, only, doing no more: αὐ. ἐνδίεσαν κύνας Il. 18.584. Cf. Il. 14.18: φαγέμεν αὐ. (has not so much as barely eaten) Od. 16.143. Cf. Od. 6.143, Od. 14.151, Od. 17.309. 5 To no end or purpose, idly, uselessly, vainly: αὐ. ἐριδαίνομεν Il. 2.342, κακὸν ἤμυνε καὶ αὐ. Il. 9.599. Cf. Il. 13.104, 810, Il. 15.128, 513, Il. 17.633, Il. 21.474, Il. 23.74: αὐ. ἄχθος ἀρούρης (a useless cumberer of the ground) Od. 20.379. Cf. Od. 16.313. Just for that, idly: εὔχεαι Il. 11.388. Cf. Il. 17.450. Idly, without justification: αὐ. σε κλέος ἐσθλὸν ἔχει Il. 17.143. Cf. Il. 20.348. Idly, thoughtlessly, lightly: σῖτον ἔδοντας μὰψ αὐ. Od. 16.111.

a)ute/w.head: ἀϋτέω
a)ute/w.html: ἀϋτέω [ἀϋτή.] 3 pl. impf. ἀΰτευν Il. 12.160. 1 To shout, cry, call Il. 20.50, Il. 21.582. Of the sound of struck armour Il. 12.160. 2 To shout or call to: πάντας ἀρίστους Il. 11.258.

au)tokasi/gnhtos.head: αὐτοκασίγνητος
au)tokasi/gnhtos.html: αὐτοκασίγνητος -ου, ὁ [αὐτός + κασίγνητος.] A brother of the whole blood Il. 2.706, Il. 3.238, Il. 11.427, Il. 13.534, Il. 14.156, Il. 16.718.

a)nti/.head: ἀντί
a)nti/.html: ἀντί [orig. sense over against, opposite.] Prep. with genit. (sometimes (without anastrophe) following the case). 1 Instead of, in the place of: Ἕκτορος ἀντί Il. 24.254. Cf. Od. 20.307. For, in exchange for: τρεῖς ἑνὸς ἀντί Il. 13.447. Cf. Il. 14.471. 2 As good as, the equivalent of: πολλῶν λαῶν Il. 9.116. Entitled to the rights of: ἱκέταο Il. 21.75. Cf. Od. 8.546. No better than: γυναικός Il. 8.163. 3 In return for: τῶνδʼ ἀντί Il. 23.650. Cf. Od. 22.290.

a)spa/zomai.head: ἀσπάζομαι
a)spa/zomai.html: ἀσπάζομαι To welcome, greet: δεξιῇ Il. 10.542: χερσίν Od. 3.35, Od. 19.415, Ὀδυσῆα Od. 22.498.

a)mfado/n.head: ἀμφαδόν
a)mfado/n.html: ἀμφαδόν [as ἀμφάδιος.] Openly, without concealment or subterfuge: βαλέειν Il. 7.243, ἀγορευέμεν Il. 9.370: ἠὲ δόλῳ ἢ ἀ. Od. 1.296, Od. 11.120, ἢ ἀ. ἦε κρυφηδόν Od. 14.330 = Od. 19.299.

a)nti/qeos.head: ἀντίθεος
a)nti/qeos.html: ἀντίθεος -η [ἀντι- 4 + θεός.] Like the gods. A vague general epithet of commendation Il. 4.88, Il. 5.663, Il. 9.623, Il. 11.140, Il. 14.322, Il. 23.360, etc.: Od. 1.21, Od. 4.571, Od. 6.241, Od. 11.117, Od. 14.18 (here merely conventional), Od. 15.90, etc.

a)rxe/kakos.head: ἀρχέκακος
a)rxe/kakos.html: ἀρχέκακος -ον [ἄρχω + κακός.] Giving rise to mischief Il. 5.63.

ai)o/los.head: αἰόλος
ai)o/los.html: αἰόλος -η, -ον. 1 Glancing, gleaming, flashing Il. 5.295, Il. 7.222, Il. 16.107. 2 The notion of glancing light passing into that of rapid movement. (Cf. ἀργός 2.) Of wasps: σφῆκες μέσον αἰόλοι (flexible about the middle) Il. 12.167. Of a serpent and worms, wriggling Il. 12.208 (or this might come under (1), glistening), Il. 22.509. Of the gadfly, darting Od. 22.300. Of the rapid motion of a horse's feet: πόδας αἰόλος ἵππος Il. 19.404.

a)/rguros.head: ἄργυρος
a)/rguros.html: ἄργυρος -ου, ὁ [ἀργός. The white metal.] Silver Il. 2.857, Il. 5.726, Il. 10.438, Il. 11.237, Il. 17.52, Il. 18.475: Od. 4.73, Od. 6.232 = Od. 23.159, Od. 10.35, 45, Od. 19.56, Od. 23.200.

a)mfima/xomai.head: ἀμφιμάχομαι
a)mfima/xomai.html: ἀμφιμάχομαι [ἀμφι- 3, ἀμφι- 4.] 1 With acc., in local sense, to fight round or about: Ἴλιον Il. 6.461. Cf. Il. 9.412, Il. 16.73, Il. 18.208. 2 With genit., to fight for the possession of: τείχεος Il. 15.391. Cf. Il. 16.496 = 533, Il. 18.20.

a)li/astos.head: ἀλίαστος
a)li/astos.html: ἀλίαστος -ον [ἀ-1 + λιάζομαι.] 1 Unabating, unceasing Il. 2.797, Il. 12.471 = Il. 16.296, Il. 14.57, Il. 20.31, Il. 24.760. 2 In neut., ἀλίαστον as adv., without ceasing Il. 24.549.

a)pokhde/w.head: ἀποκηδέω
a)pokhde/w.html: ἀποκηδέω [ἀπο- 6 + κῆδος.] To be careless, fail to do one's best: αἴ κʼ ἀποκηδήσαντε θερώμεθα χεῖρον ἄεθλον Il. 23.413 (the dual referring to the horses only, but the speaker being included in the subjects of the verb).

ai)=nos.head: αἶνος
ai)=nos.html:
αἶνος -ου, ὁ. 1 Praise, commendation, compliment Il. 23.795: Od. 21.110. 2 A discourse or tale Il. 23.652: Od. 14.508.
Αἶνος The mod. Enos, a Thracian town at the mouth of the Hebrus. Αἰνόθεν [-θεν], from Aenus Il. 4.520.

a)mu/mwn.head: ἀμύμων
a)mu/mwn.html: ἀμύμων -ονος. 1 An epithet of persons of general commendation, noble, illustrious, goodly, or the like: μάντις Il. 1.92, Αἰθιοπῆας 423. Cf. Il. 2.674, Il. 5.247, Il. 6.155, Il. 11.835, Il. 20.236, etc.: Αἰγίσθοιο (app. as a merely conventional epithet) Od. 1.29, Ὀδυσῆος Od. 2.225. Cf. Od. 4.187, Od. 7.29, Od. 8.117, Od. 19.332, Od. 8.325, etc. Of women: ἄκοιτιν Il. 6.374. Cf. Od. 4.4, Od. 7.303, Od. 13.42, Od. 15.15, etc. Of a nymph Il. 14.444. Of a horse Il. 16.152. 2 Sim. of things or abstractions, indicating excellence or perfection: πομπῇ Il. 6.171, ἔργα Il. 9.128, τόξῳ Il. 15.463. Cf. Il. 9.270, Il. 10.19, Il. 13.637, Il. 16.119, Il. 19.245, Il. 23.263: οἶκος Od. 1.232, μῆτις Od. 9.414. Cf. Od. 10.50, Od. 12.261, Od. 14.508, Od. 16.237, Od. 22.442 = 459, Od. 23.145, Od. 24.80, 278. 3 Absol. in neut. pl.: δς ἂν ἀμύμονα εἰδῇ (is of noble heart) (see εἴδω III.12) Od. 19.332.

a)skani/h.head: Ἀσκανίη
a)skani/h.html: Ἀσκανίη (ἐριβῶλαξ). A lake (and its district) connected with the Propontis, on which lake lay the later town of Nicaea Il. 2.863, Il. 13.793 .

a)te/w.head: ἀτέω
a)te/w.html: ἀτέω (ἀϝατέω) [ἀϝάτη, ἄτη.] To act rashly or recklessly Il. 20.332.

a)/gxw.head: ἄγχω
a)/gxw.html: ἄγχω (ἀπ-.) To choke, throttle Il. 3.371.

a)mfida/mas.head: Ἀμφιδάμας-1
a)mfida/mas.html:
Ἀμφιδάμας-1 A Cytherian Il. 10.268, 269 .
Ἀμφιδάμας-2 His son killed in a quarrel by Patroclus Il. 23.87.

a)pomimnh/|skomai.head: †ἀπομιμνῄσκομαι
a)pomimnh/|skomai.html: †ἀπομιμνῄσκομαι [ἀπο- 5.] 3 pl. mid. ἀπεμνήσαντο. To remember a favour Il. 24.428.

a)stu/noos.head: Ἀστύνοος-1
a)stu/noos.html:
Ἀστύνοος-1 Trojan. killed by Diomedes Il. 5.144.
Ἀστύνοος-2 Trojan. Son of Protiaon Il. 15.455.

au)toxo/wnos.head: αὐτοχόωνος
au)toxo/wnos.html: αὐτοχόωνος [app. for αὐτόχωνος = αὐτοχόανος, fr. αὐτός + χόανος.] Of a mass of iron, just as it came from the smelting furnace, i.e. in the condition of pig-iron: σόλον Il. 23.826.

a)rdmo/s.head: ἀρδμός
a)rdmo/s.html: ἀρδμός -οῦ, ὁ [ἄρδω, to water (cattle).] A watering-place Il. 18.521: Od. 13.247.

a)xrei=os.head: ἀχρεῖος
a)xrei=os.html: ἀχρεῖος [ἀ-1 + χρείη, use, advantage. Cf. χρεῖος.] Serving no good purpose. In neut. ἀχρεῖον as adv.: ἀ. ἰδών (looking (about him) like one dazed, with helpless look) Il. 2.269: ἀ. ἐγέλασσεν (a forced laugh (to cover embarrassment in announcing her intention)) Od. 18.163.

a)pokru/ptw.head: †ἀποκρύπτω
a)pokru/ptw.html: †ἀποκρύπτω [ἀπο- 1.] 3 sing. aor. ἀπέκρυψε Il. 11.718. Infin. ἀποκρύψαι Il. 18.465: Od. 17.286. To hide away, conceal Il. 11.718, Il. 18.465. To hide away, make a secret of Od. 17.286.

a)nami/mnw.head: ἀναμίμνω
a)nami/mnw.html: ἀναμίμνω [ἀνα- 6.] To wait for, await: ἀλλήλους Il. 11.171. Absol., to stand one's ground Il. 16.363.

a)ta/sqalos.head: ἀτάσθαλος
a)ta/sqalos.html: ἀτάσθαλος -ον. 1 Reckless, careless of consequences, ungoverned Il. 22.418: Od. 7.60, Od. 8.166, Od. 24.282. 2 Of character, deeds, etc., displaying such characteristics: μένος Il. 13.634. Cf. Od. 16.86, Od. 22.314, Od. 24.352. 3 In neut. ἀτάσθαλον, a deed displaying such characteristics: οὔ ποτʼ ἀ. ἄνδρα ἐώργει Od. 4.693. In neut. pl. ἀτάσθαλα, such deeds: ἀ. μηχανόωντο Il. 11.695. Cf. Od. 3.207, Od. 16.93, Od. 17.588, Od. 18.139, 143, Od. 20.170, 370, Od. 22.47.

a)rneio/s.head: ἀρνειός
a)rneio/s.html: ἀρνειός -οῦ, ὁ [ἄρνα.] A full-grown ram Il. 2.550, Il. 3.197: Od. 1.25, Od. 9.239, 432, 444, 463, 550, Od. 11.131 = Od. 23.278. Joined with ὄϊς Od. 10.527, 572.

a)poskudmai/nw.head: ἀποσκυδμαίνω
a)poskudmai/nw.html: ἀποσκυδμαίνω [ἀπο- 7.] To be angry or wroth with. With dat.: θεοῖσιν Il. 24.65.

a)rhi/lukos.head: Ἀρηΐλυκος-1.
a)rhi/lukos.html:
Ἀρηΐλυκος-1. Father of Prothoenor-2 Il. 14.451.
Ἀρηΐλυκος-2 Trojan. killed by Patroclus Il. 16.308.

a)ndro/kmhtos.head: ἀνδρόκμητος
a)ndro/kmhtos.html: ἀνδρόκμητος [ἀνδρ-, ἀνήρ + κμη-, κάμνω.] Made by the hands of man, the work of men's hands Il. 11.371.

a)naba/llw.head: ἀναβάλλω
a)naba/llw.html: ἀναβάλλω [ἀνα- 1, ἀνα- 3.] Contr. 1 pl. subj. mid. ἀμβαλλώμεθα Il. 2.436. 1 To put off, delay: ἄεθλον Od. 19.584. In mid.: ἔργον Il. 2.436. 2 In mid., to strike up, begin (to sing) (cf. βάλλω II.4 and ἀμβλήδην): ἀνεβάλλετʼ ἀείδειν Od. 1.155, Od. 8.266.

a)=sson.head: ἆσσον
a)=sson.html: ἆσσον [comp. of ἄγχι.] 1 Near (rather than far off), to within a short distance: φέρον Od. 9.380, πάντʼ ἐφόρει Od. 13.368. Near to, close to. With genit.: ἐμεῖο (into my presence) Il. 24.74: ἔθεν Od. 19.481. 2 With εἶμι, etc., to approach, draw near: ἀ. ἴτε Il. 1.335. Cf. Il. 6.143 = Il. 20.429, Il. 9.508, Il. 23.8, 667: Od. 9.300, Od. 19.392. To approach, draw near to. With genit.: Ζηνὸς οὐκ ἂν ἀ. ἱκοίμην Il. 14.247. Cf. Il. 22.4: Od. 10.537 = Od. 11.50 = 89, 148, Od. 17.303, Od. 24.221. So of something inanimate, to be brought near to: λοετρὰ καρήατος ἀ. ἱκέσθαι Il. 23.44. With dat.: ἀ. μοι στῆθι Il. 23.97. In hostile sense, to attack, make an attack: μίμνʼ ἀ. ἰόντα Il. 22.92. Cf. Il. 1.567, Il. 15.105.

a)marugkeu/s.head: Ἀμαρυγκεύς
a)marugkeu/s.html: Ἀμαρυγκεύς (κρείων). Father of Diores-1. His funeral games Il. 23.630.

a)/xri.head: ἄχρι
a)/xri.html: ἄχρι (ἄχρις) 1 Adv., utterly, completely: τένοντε ἀ. ἀπηλοίησεν Il. 4.522, ἀπʼ ὀστέον ἀ. ἄραξεν Il. 16.324, γράψεν οἱ ὀστέον ἀ. (app. implying that though the wound was a superficial one (a portion of) the bone was destroyed) Il. 17.599. 2 Prep. with genit., until, up to: κνέφαος Od. 18.370.

a)polixma/omai.head: ἀπολιχμάομαι
a)polixma/omai.html: ἀπολιχμάομαι [ἀπο- 1 + λιχμάομαι conn. with λείχω, to lick.] To lick off. With double acc.: ὠτειλὴν αἷμʼ ἀπολιχμήσονται Il. 21.123.

a)lweu/s.head: Ἀλωεύς
a)lweu/s.html: Ἀλωεύς Husband of Iphimedeia and nominal father of Otus-1 and Ephialtes Il. 5.386: Od. 11.305.

a)zale/os.head: ἀζαλέος
a)zale/os.html: ἀζαλέος -η, -ον [ἄζω.] Dried up, dry: βῶν Il. 7.239, δρῦς Il. 11.494, οὔρεος Il. 20.491: ὕλης Od. 9.234.

a)rtu/nw.head: ἀρτύνω
a)rtu/nw.html: ἀρτύνω [ἀρ-, ἀραρίσκω.] 3 pl. fut. ἀρτῦνέουσι Od. 1.277, Od. 2.196. Aor. pple. ἀρτύνας, -αντος Il. 12.43, 86, Il. 13.152: Od. 14.469, Od. 24.153. 3 pl. aor. mid. ἠρτύναντο Od. 4.782, Od. 8.53. 3 sing. aor. pass. ἀρτύνθη Il. 11.216. 1 To make ready, prepare: ἔεδνα Od. 1.277 = Od. 2.196. 2 To set in order, array: σφέας αὐτούς Il. 12.43, 86, Il. 13.152. Cf. Il. 11.216, Il. 15.303. To get together, muster: λόχον Od. 14.469. 3 To put in position. In mid.: ἐρετμά Od. 4.782 = Od. 8.53. 4 To plan, contrive: θάνατον Od. 24.153. To devise, invent, frame: ψεύδεα Od. 11.366. To put into words, put forward. In mid.: ἀρτύνετο βουλήν Il. 2.55 = Il. 10.302.

a)ptoeph/s.head: ἀπτοεπής
a)ptoeph/s.html: ἀπτοεπής [prob. (ϝ)ι-(ϝ)άπτω as in προϊάπτω + ἔπος.] Thus, thrower about of words, reckless in speech: Ἥρη ἀπτοεπές Il. 8.209.

a)nou/tatos.head: ἀνούτατος
a)nou/tatos.html: ἀνούτατος [ἀ-1 οὐτάω.] Not wounded (by thrust): ἄβλητος καὶ ἀνούτατος Il. 4.540.

a)ne/lkw.head: ἀνέλκω
a)ne/lkw.html: ἀνέλκω [ἀν-, ἀνα- 1, ἀνα- 3.] 1 To draw up Il. 12.434. 2 To draw back (i.e. away from one): τόξου πῆχυν Il. 11.375, Il. 13.583. To draw back (a spear in order to recover it). In mid. Od. 22.97. To bend a bow Od. 21.128, 150.

a)stuo/xeia.head: Ἀστυόχεια
a)stuo/xeia.html: Ἀστυόχεια Captured by Heracles at Ephyra-1 and bore him Tlepolemus-1 Il. 2.658 .

a)ci/nh.head: ἀξίνη
a)ci/nh.html: ἀξίνη -ης, ἡ. An axe (referred to only as in warlike use) Il. 13.612, Il. 15.711 (see under πέλεκυς).

a)po/proqen.head: ἀπόπροθεν
a)po/proqen.html: ἀπόπροθεν [ἀπο- + προ- + -θεν 2.] 1 Far away: νῆσός τις ἀ. κεῖται Od. 7.244. Cf. Od. 17.408. 2 At a distance: μένειν Il. 10.209 = 410. Cf. Il. 17.66, 501: Od. 6.218. 3 Apart from others, aloof: ποιμαίνεσκεν Od. 9.188.

a)/rotron.head: ἄροτρον
a)/rotron.html: ἄροτρον -ου, τό [ἀρόω.] A plough Il. 10.353, Il. 13.703: Od. 13.32, Od. 18.374.

a)gkuloxei/lhs.head: ἀγκυλοχείλης
a)gkuloxei/lhs.html: ἀγκυλοχείλης [ἀγκύλος + χεῖλος.] With curved lips; hence, with hooked beak Il. 16.428:= Od. 22.302, Od. 19.538.

a)fika/nw.head: ἀφικάνω
a)fika/nw.html: ἀφικάνω [ἀφ-, ἀπο- 7.] To be in the condition of having come to, arrived at, reached, to find oneself at, be at, a specified place: τίπτε δεῦρʼ ἀφικάνεις; Il. 14.43. With prep.: πρὸς τεῖχος Il. 6.388. With acc.: ῥοὰς ποταμῶν Od. 9.450. Cf. Od. 14.159 = Od. 17.156 = Od. 19.304 = Od. 20.231, Od. 23.318.

a(/rpuia.head: Ἅρπυια
a(/rpuia.html:
Ἅρπυια [prob. for Ἁρέπυια. Cf. ἅρπη.] A personification of the storm-gust: Ἁ. ποδάργη Il. 16.150 (here represented as a semi-divine being in the form of a mare). Cf. Od. 1.241= Od. 14.371, Od. 20.77.
Ἅρπυια See Lexicon.

a)leghnori/dhs.head: Ἀλεγηνορίδης
a)leghnori/dhs.html: Ἀλεγηνορίδης Patronymic of Promachus Il. 14.503.

ai)yhro/s.head: αἰψηρός
ai)yhro/s.html: αἰψηρός -ή [αἶψα.] Quick: ἀγορήν (quick to disperse) Il. 19.276: = Od. 2.257, αἰψηρὸς κόρος γόοιο (soon comes on one) Od. 4.103.

ai)/c.head: αἴξ
ai)/c.html: αἴξ αἰγός, ὁ, ἡ. A goat: ταύρων ἠδʼ αἰγῶν Il. 1.41, ἰξάλου αἰγὸς ἀγρίου (i.e. of goat's horn) Il. 4.105. Cf. Il. 2.474, Il. 3.24, Il. 9.207, Il. 10.486, Il. 13.198, etc.: Od. 2.56, Od. 9.118, Od. 14.101, Od. 17.213, 247, Od. 18.44, etc.

a)nakumbalia/zw.head: ἀνακυμβαλιάζω
a)nakumbalia/zw.html: ἀνακυμβαλιάζω [app. ἀνα- 6 + *κυμβαλιάζω in sim. sense fr. κύμβαλον, cymbal.] Thus, of chariots, to rattle (in upsetting) Il. 16.379.

au)gei/as.head: Αὐγείας
au)gei/as.html: Αὐγείας (ἄναξ ἀνδρῶν). Ruler of Elis and father of Agasthenes and Agamede. Detained Neleus's race-horses Il. 11.701, 739.

a)mei/lixos.head: ἀμείλιχος
a)mei/lixos.html: ἀμείλιχος [as ἀμείλικτος.] Inflexible, implacable, relentless: Ἀΐδης Il. 9.158, ἦτορ 572, ἄνακτος Il. 24.734.

a)mhth/r.head: ἀμητήρ
a)mhth/r.html: ἀμητήρ -ῆρος, ὁ [ἀμάω1.] A reaper Il. 11.67.

a)re/skw.head: †ἀρέσκω
a)re/skw.html: †ἀρέσκω Aor. infin. ἀρέσαι Il. 9.120, Il. 19.138. Fut. mid. ἀρέσσομαι Od. 8.402. 1 pl. -όμεθα Il. 4.362, Il. 6.526. 3 pl. aor. imp. ἀρεσάσθω Il. 19.179. ἀρεσσάσθω Od. 8.396. Pple. ἀρεσσάμενος, -ου Il. 9.112: Od. 8.415, Od. 22.55. (ἀπ-.) 1 To make atonement, effect reconciliation Il. 9.120 = Il. 19.138. 2 In mid. a To conciliate, make matters up with Il. 9.112, Il. 19.179: Od. 8.396, 402. Absol. Od. 8.415. b To make atonement for, make up for: ταῦτα Il. 4.362, τά Il. 6.526. To make up to a person for a loss by levying a contribution Od. 22.55.

a)na/ssw.head: ἀνάσσω
a)na/ssw.html: ἀνάσσω (ϝανάσσω) [ἄναξ.] 3 sing. fut. ἀνάξει Il. 19.104, 122, Il. 20.307. Infin. -ειν Il. 19.109, Il. 20.180. Aor. infin. mid. -ασθαι Od. 3.245 (in mid. only here). 1 To protect, be patron of. With genit.: τενέδοιο Il. 1.38 = 452. 2 To be king, chief or ruler: μετὰ τριτάτοισιν Il. 1.252. Cf. Il. 4.61 = Il. 18.366, Il. 16.172, Il. 23.471: Od. 7.23, 62, Od. 19.110. In mid.: τρὶς ἀνάξασθαι γένεʼ ἀνδρῶν (app., during three generations) Od. 3.245. With local words: ἐν Βουδείῳ Il. 16.572. Cf. Od. 11.276, 284, Od. 24.26. 3 To be king or chief of or ruler over. a With genit.: Ἀργείων Il. 10.33. Cf. Od. 11.276. With local words: Ἰλίου Il. 6.478. Cf. Od. 3.304, Od. 4.602, Od. 17.443. b With dat.: Μυρμιδόνεσσιν Il. 1.180. Cf. Il. 1.231, Il. 2.643, Il. 6.397, Il. 14.85, 94, Il. 19.104, Il. 24.202, etc.: Od. 1.181, 419, Od. 2.234 = Od. 5.12, Od. 4.9, Od. 7.11, Od. 9.552 = Od. 13.25, Od. 10.110, Od. 11.349, 491, Od. 15.240, Od. 20.112, Od. 24.26, 378. With local words: πολλῇσιν νήσοισιν Il. 2.108. 4 In pass., to be ruled by, be under the sway of. With dat.: ἀνάσσονται ἐμοὶ αὐτῷ Od. 4.177. 5 To be lord or master of, possess, enjoy. a With genit.: τιμῆς Il. 20.180: Od. 24.30. b With dat.: κτήμασιν οἶσιν Od. 1.117. Cf. Od. 1.402, Od. 4.93.

a)mfipone/omai.head: ἀμφιπονέομαι
a)mfipone/omai.html: ἀμφιπονέομαι [ἀμφι- 4.] To busy oneself about, attend to: τάθον Od. 20.307. To do the offices of a second to: εὐρύαλον Il. 23.681.

a)qle/w.head: ἀθλέω
a)qle/w.html: ἀθλέω [ἆθλος. See ἄεθλος.] To toil Il. 7.453, Il. 15.30.

a)mfidai/w.head: †ἀμφιδαίω
a)mfidai/w.html: †ἀμφιδαίω [ἀμφι- 3 + δαίω1.] 3 sing. pf. ἀμφιδέδηε. To burn or blaze all round. With acc. Fig.: ἀϋτὴ ἄστυ ἀμφιδέδηε Il. 6.329.

ai)tw/lios.head: Αἰτώλιος
ai)tw/lios.html: Αἰτώλιος =next. Of Tydeus Il. 4.399 . Of Trechus Il. 5.706 .

a)/cwn.head: ἄξων
a)/cwn.html: ἄξων -ονος, ὁ. An axle Il. 5.723, 838, Il. 11.534, Il. 13.30, Il. 16.378, Il. 20.499.

a)norou/w.head: ἀνορούω
a)norou/w.html: ἀνορούω [ἀν-, ἀνα- 1.] 1 To rise or start up, spring up: ταφὼν ἀνόρουσεν Il. 9.193. Cf. Il. 1.248, Il. 10.162, 519, Il. 11.273 = 399, 777, Il. 17.130, Il. 19.396, Il. 21.246, Il. 23.101: Od. 3.149, Od. 4.839, Od. 10.557, Od. 14.518, Od. 16.12, Od. 22.23. 2 Of the sun, to rise Od. 3.1.

a)/ggos.head: ἄγγος
a)/ggos.html: ἄγγος τό. A vessel or receptacle Od. 2.289. For milk Il. 2.471 = Il. 16.643: Od. 9.222, 248. For wine Od. 16.13.

a)pa/lamnos.head: ἀπάλαμνος
a)pa/lamnos.html: ἀπάλαμνος [ἀ-1 + παλάμη.] Handless, shiftless, without resource: ἀνήρ Il. 5.597.

a)porri/ptw.head: †ἀπορρίπτω
a)porri/ptw.html: †ἀπορρίπτω [ἀπο- 1.] Acc. sing. masc. aor. pple. ἀπορρίψαντα Il. 9.517. Infin. ἀπορρῖψαι Il. 16.282. To cast away. Fig.: μῆνιν Il. 9.517, μηνιθμόν Il. 16.282.

a)/ter.head: ἄτερ
a)/ter.html: ἄτερ Prep. with genit. 1 Aloof or apart from: ἀ. ἄλλων Il. 1.498. Cf. Il. 5.753. 2 Without: ἀ. πολέμου (not on a warlike errand) Il. 4.376, ἀ. λαῶν Il. 5.473, ἀ. Ζηνός (without his goodwill) Il. 15.292. Cf. Il. 9.604, Il. 21.50, Il. 23.441: ἀ. σπείρου Od. 2.102, Od. 19.147 = Od. 24.137. Cf. Od. 7.325, Od. 21.409.

a)gxisia/dhs.head: Ἀγχισιάδης-1
a)gxisia/dhs.html:
Ἀγχισιάδης-1 Patronymic from prec. Of Aeneas Il. 17.754 , Il. 20.160.
Ἀγχισιάδης-2. Patronymic of Echepolus-2 Il. 23.296.

a)/atos.head: ἄατος
a)/atos.html: ἄατος [ἀ-1 + (σ)άω.] Except in Il. 22.218 in contr. form ἆτος. Insatiate of, indefatigable in. With genit.: πολέμοιο Il. 5.388. Cf. Il. 5.863, Il. 6.203, Il. 11.430, Il. 13.746, Il. 22.218: Od. 13.293.

a)mfote/rwqen.head: ἀμφοτέρωθεν
a)mfote/rwqen.html: ἀμφοτέρωθεν [ἀμφότερος + -θεν 1.] 1 From both sides: ὦρτʼ ἀϋτὴ ἀ. Il. 15.313. Cf. Il. 12.431. Of plainting strands of a rope, across and across Od. 10.167. 2 On both sides, on either side: πλῆμναί εἰσιν ἀ. Il. 5.726. Cf. Il. 12.55, Il. 16.563, Il. 17.440, Il. 20.170, Il. 23.628: Od. 22.404. On both edges: ἀ. ἀκαχμένον Od. 5.235, Od. 22.80. At both ends: ἅψας ἀ. Od. 8.408. Of stating alternatives: ἐρέω ἀ. Od. 12.58. 3 In both directions: θόως γένετʼ ἀ. Il. 15.669. With περί, app., in both directions so as to meet: περὶ ἕρκος ἐλήλαται ἀ. Od. 7.113. Cf. Od. 10.88.

a)naxwre/w.head: ἀναχωρέω
a)naxwre/w.html: ἀναχωρέω [ἀνα- 3.] 1 To go back, return Il. 10.210 = 411, Il. 13.457. 2 To withdraw, retire Od. 17.453, 461. To draw back from danger Il. 3.35. Of hounds retreating from a boar Il. 17.729. To draw back or retire in fight Il. 4.305, Il. 5.107, Il. 11.189, 440, Il. 17.30, Il. 20.196, 335: Od. 22.270.

a)lla/.head: ἀλλά
a)lla/.html: ἀλλά [ἄλλος.] 1 Adversative particle, but Il. 1.24, 25, 94, 116, 125, etc.: Od. 1.6, 16, 22, 42, 48, etc. Elliptically: ἀλλʼ οὐ γάρ δʼ ἐθέλω . . . (but I say no more, for . . .) Il. 7.242: ἀλλʼ οὐ γάρ τις πρῆξις ἐγίγνετο (but they soon gave over, for . . . ) Od. 10.202 = 568, ἀλλʼ οὐ γάρ οἱ ἔτʼ ἦν ἴς ἔμπεδος (but it was of no avail, for . . . ) Od. 11.393. Cf. Od. 19.591. 2 Introducing an apodosis, yet, nevertheless: εἴ περ γὰρ . . . ἀλλʼ οὐ πείσονται Il. 8.154. Cf. Il. 1.82, Il. 12.349, Il. 16.38, Il. 24.771, etc.: εἰ . . . ἀλλʼ ἤδη παῖς τοῖος Od. 19.86, etc. Introducing a statement: ἀλλὰ μάλʼ ὤφελλες (why . . . ) Od. 4.472. 3 With imp. (or infin. as imp.) in command, challenge, entreaty, remonstrance, persuasion, encouragement, indignation, etc., nay but, come now ! ἴθι Il. 1.32, πίθεσθε Il. 1.259. Cf. Il. 1.393, Il. 1.508, Il. 1.565, Il. 2.163, 360, etc.: μένʼ αὖθι Od. 2.369, ὧδʼ ἔρδειν Od. 6.258. Cf. Od. 3.323, 380, Od. 4.28, 35, 379, etc. Sim. with subj.: ἴομεν Il. 6.526, etc.: φραζώμεσθα Od. 2.167, φθεγγώμεθα Od. 10.228, etc. With opt.: ἐπιτρέψειας ἕκαστα δμῳάων ἥ τις . . . Od. 15.24. With fut.: ἐρέω Od. 12.156. With ἄνα. See ἄνα1. For ἀλλʼ ἄγε (ἄγετε) see ἄγε.

ai)/gina.head: Αἴγινα
ai)/gina.html: Αἴγινα The Aegean island. In the realm of Diomedes Il. 2.562.

a(rmo/zw.head: ἁρμόζω
a(rmo/zw.html: ἁρμόζω [ἀρ-, ἀραρίσκω.] 3 sing. aor. ἥρμοσε Il. 3.333, Il. 17.210: Od. 5.247. (ἐφ-.) 1 To fit or adjust (to something): [δούρατʼ] ἀλλήλοισιν Od. 5.247. 2 To put together, construct. In mid.: σχεδίην Od. 5.162. 3 To fit well, be well adapted (to something). With dat.: θώρηξ αὐτῷ Il. 3.333. Cf. Il. 17.210.

a)hqe/ssw.head: ἀηθέσσω
a)hqe/ssw.html: ἀηθέσσω [ἀ-1 + ἦθος, custom.] To be unused to. With genit.: νεκρῶν Il. 10.493.

a)nabro/xw.head: †ἀναβρόχω
a)nabro/xw.html: †ἀναβρόχω [ἀνα- 6 + βρόχω, to swallow.] 3 sing. aor. opt. ἀναβρόξειε Od. 12.240. Neut. aor. pple. pass. ἀναβροχέν Od. 11.586. (κατα-.) To swallow down, swallow Od. 11.586, Od. 12.240.

a)/kmwn.head: ἄκμων
a)/kmwn.html: ἄκμων An anvil. Il. 15.19, Il. 18.476: Od. 3.434, Od. 8.274.

a)legi/zw.head: ἀλεγίζω
a)legi/zw.html: ἀλεγίζω [cf. ἀλέγω.] With neg., not to care for, trouble oneself about, have regard for. With genit.: σέθεν οὐκ ἀλεγίζω Il. 1.180. Cf. Il. 1.160, Il. 8.477, Il. 11.80, Il. 12.238. Absol. Il. 15.106.

a)lektruw/n.head: Ἀλεκτρυών
a)lektruw/n.html: Ἀλεκτρυών (μεγάθυμος). Father of Leitus Il. 16.602.

a)/bromos.head: ἄβρομος
a)/bromos.html: ἄβρομος [ἀ-2 + βρόμος.] With united noise Il. 13.41.

a)polei/pw.head: ἀπολείπω
a)polei/pw.html: ἀπολείπω [ἀπο- 7.] 1 To forsake, abandon: κοῖλον δόμον Il. 12.169. 2 To leave a remnant, not to consume all: ἤσθιε, οὐδʼ ἀπέλειπεν Od. 9.292. 3 To fail, be lacking: καρπός Od. 7.117.

a)ni/sthmi.head: †ἀνίστημι
a)ni/sthmi.html: †ἀνίστημι [ἀν-, ἀνα- 1.] A 3 sing. impf. ἀνίστη Il. 24.515, 689. 3 pl. fut. ἀναστήσουσι Il. 7.116. Contr. 2 sing. ἀνστήσεις Il. 24.551. 3 pl. -ει Il. 15.64. Contr. pple. ἀνστήσων Il. 10.32. 3 sing. aor. ἀνέστησε Il. 24.756. 3 sing. opt. ἀναστήσειε Il. 1.191. Contr. imp. ἄνστησον Il. 10.176. Pple. ἀναστήσας Il. 10.179: Od. 6.7, Od. 7.163, 170, Od. 14.319. Contr. fem. ἀνστήσασα Il. 18.358. B 3 sing. aor. ἀνέστη Il. 1.68, 101, Il. 2.76, Il. 7.354, 365, Il. 9.195, Il. 15.287, Il. 18.305, 410, Il. 23.635, Il. 24.597: Od. 2.224, Od. 5.195, Od. 12.439, Od. 18.157, Od. 20.380, Od. 21.139, 166, 243, 392, Od. 23.164. 3 pl. ἀνέσταν Il. 1.533, Il. 7.161, Il. 23.886: Od. 8.258, Od. 10.215. Contr. 3 dual ἀνστήτην Il. 1.305. 3 sing. subj. ἀναστῇ Od. 18.334. Pple. ἀναστάς, -άντος Il. 1.387, Il. 19.77, 175, Il. 23.542, Il. 24.11: Od. 4.343, 776, Od. 16.378, Od. 17.134, Od. 18.47. Contr. ἀνστάς, -άντος Il. 2.398, Il. 19.269, Il. 23.848: Od. 4.674, Od. 12.170, 195, Od. 15.58, 96, Od. 16.358, 407, Od. 17.177. Fem. ἀνστᾶσα Il. 14.336: Od. 19.357. Contr. infin. ἀνστήμεναι Il. 10.55. Mid. 3 sing. impf. ἀνίστατο Il. 7.94, 123, Il. 23.491, 566, 677, 709, 734: Od. 20.124, Od. 21.144. Pple. ἀνιστάμενος, -ου Il. 1.58, Il. 9.52, Il. 19.55: Od. 3.341. 3 pl. fut. ἀναστήσονται Od. 21.56. Contr. infin. ἀνστήσεσθαι Il. 2.694. I In impf. act. and the other forms (A) 1 To cause to rise or stand up: γέροντʼ ἀνίστη Il. 24.515. Cf. Od. 7.163, 170, Od. 14.319. To break up (an assembly) Il. 1.191. To cause (a people) to migrate Od. 6.7. 2 To rouse from sleep Il. 10.32, 176, 179, Il. 24.689. 3 To raise from the dead Il. 24.551, 756. 4 To cause to take action, rouse to action Il. 15.64, Il. 18.358. To put forward (a champion) Il. 7.116. II In mid. and the other forms (B) 1 To rise or stand up: πάτροκλος ἀνέστη Il. 9.195. Cf. Il. 18.410, Il. 24.597: Od. 5.195, Od. 18.157 = Od. 21.139 = 166 = Od. 23.164, Od. 21.243 = 392. To rise up in token of respect Il. 1.533. Of a beast, to stand on its hind legs Od. 10.215. 2 To rise up with a view to action: ἀνστάντες ἔφερον Il. 23.848. Cf. Od. 3.341, Od. 4.674 = Od. 16.407, Od. 4.776, Od. 8.258, Od. 12.170, 195, Od. 16.358, Od. 17.177, Od. 18.47, Od. 19.357. 3 To rise to speak: ἀνιστάμενος μετέφη Il. 1.58 = Il. 19.55. Cf. Il. 1.68 = 101 = Il. 2.76 = Il. 7.354 = 365, Il. 1.387, Il. 7.94, 123, Il. 9.52, Il. 19.77, 175, 269, Il. 23.491, 542, 566, 734: ἀνέστη μαντεύεσθαι Od. 20.380. Cf. Od. 2.224, Od. 16.378. 4 To rise at the close of an assembly Il. 1.305, Il. 2.398. At the close of judicial business Od. 12.439. 5 To rise from bed or from sleep Il. 10.55, Il. 14.336, Il. 24.11: Od. 15.58, 96, Od. 20.124. 6 To rise from the dead Il. 21.56. As if from the dead Il. 15.287. 7 To rouse oneself to action Il. 2.694, Il. 18.305. To stand up to take part in a contest Il. 23.709, 886: Od. 4.343 = Od. 17.134, Od. 21.144. To stand up as a volunteer champion Il. 7.161. 8 To stand up (to another) in a fight, etc. Il. 23.635, 677: Od. 18.334.

a)paura/w.head: †ἀπαυράω
a)paura/w.html: †ἀπαυράω Impf. ἀπηύρων 131, Il. 19.89, Il. 23.560, 808: Od. 13.132. 2 sing. ἀπηύρας Il. 8.237. 3 sing. -α Il. 6.17, Il. 9.273, Il. 10.495, Il. 11.115, 334, Il. 15.462, Il. 16.828, Il. 17.125, 236, Il. 20.290, Il. 21.179, 201, Il. 23.291, 800, Il. 24.50: Od. 3.192, Od. 4.646, Od. 11.203, Od. 18.273. 3 pl. ἀπηύρων Il. 1.430. 3 pl. fut. ἀπουρήσουσι (v.l. ἀπουρίσσουσι; see ἀπουρίζρω) Il. 22.489. Aor. pple. ἀπούρας Il. 1.356, 507, Il. 2.240, Il. 6.455, Il. 9.107, Il. 11.432, Il. 16.831, Il. 20.193, Il. 21.296: Od. 13.270. [For the impf. ἀπηύρων, -ας, -α should prob. be read aor. ἀπέϝραν, -ας, -α (from ἀπο- 1 + ϝρα-, ϝερ- as in ἀπό (ϝ)ερσα) With 3 pl. ἀπέϝρασαν (metrically = ἀπηύρων), pple. ἀποϝράς and fut. ἀποϝρήσουσι.] 1 To take away: γυναῖκα Il. 1.430, θυμόν Il. 21.179. Cf. Il. 1.356 = 507 = Il. 2.240, Il. 6.455, Il. 9.107, 131, 273, Il. 21.201, Il. 24.50. 2 To take away from (a person), deprive (him) of. With genit. of person: Ἀχιλλῆος γέρας Il. 19.89. Cf. Od. 18.273. With dat.: πολέσσι θυμόν Il. 17.236. Cf. Il. 21.296, Il. 22.489: Od. 3.192, Od. 13.132. With double acc.: κῦδός μιν Il. 8.237. Cf. Il. 6.17, Il. 10.495, Il. 11.115, 334, 432, Il. 15.462, Il. 16.828, 831, Il. 17.125, Il. 20.193, 290, Il. 23.291, 560, 800, 808: νῆά σε Od. 4.646. Cf. Od. 11.203, Od. 13.270.

ai)/qh.head: Αἴθη
ai)/qh.html: Αἴθη (καλλίθριξ). A mare of Agamemnon's. Driven by Menelaus in the chariot-race Il. 23.295, 409, 525.

a)na/ednos.head: ἀνάεδνος
a)na/ednos.html: ἀνάεδνος ἡ [app. for ἀνέϝεδνος fr. ἀν- 1 + ἔϝεδνα. See ἕδνα, ἔεδνα.] Without bride-price Il. 9.146, 288, Il. 13.366.

a)lu/skw.head: ἀλύσκω
a)lu/skw.html: ἀλύσκω 3 sing. fut. ἀλύξει Od. 17.547, Od. 19.558. Infin. ἀλύξειν Il. 10.371. Aor. ἤλυξα Od. 12.335. 3 sing. ἤλυξε Il. 11.476. ἄλυξε Od. 23.332. 3 pl. ἤλυξαν Od. 3.297. ἄλυξαν Od. 23.328. 2 sing. subj. ἀλύξῃς Od. 11.113, Od. 12.140. 3 sing. -ῃ Il. 10.348: Od. 22.66. 1 pl. opt. ἀλύξαιμεν Od. 10.269. Pple. ἀλύξας Il. 12.113, Il. 13.395, Il. 15.287: Od. 2.352, Od. 5.387, Od. 8.353. Infin. ἀλύξαι Il. 8.243, Il. 21.565, Il. 22.201: Od. 4.416, Od. 5.345, Od. 12.216, Od. 22.460. (ὑπ-.) 1 To escape, evade, avoid (impending danger): ὄλεθρον Il. 10.371. Cf. Il. 11.476, Il. 12.113, Il. 13.395, Il. 15.287, Il. 21.565: κῆρας Od. 2.352 = Od. 5.387. Cf. Od. 3.297, Od. 10.269, Od. 12.216, Od. 17.547 = Od. 19.558, Od. 22.66, 363, 382, Od. 23.328, 332. 2 To get away from, effect one's escape or release from (something in which one is involved): χρέος καὶ δεσμόν (getting out of the debt and freeing himself from the bonds) Od. 8.353. To get free from the company of: ἑταίρους Od. 12.335. 3 Absol., to effect one's escape, escape, save oneself Il. 21.243, Il. 10.348, Il. 22.201: Od. 4.416, Od. 5.345, Od. 11.113 = Od. 12.140, Od. 22.460.

a)napeta/nnumi.head: †ἀναπετάννυμι
a)napeta/nnumi.html: †ἀναπετάννυμι [ἀνα- 6.] Acc. fem. pf. pple. pass. ἀναπεπταμένας. To open wide (a gate) Il. 12.122.

a)/titos.head: ἄτιτος
a)/titos.html: ἄτιτος (ι᷌)-ον [ἀ-1 + τίω.] 1 Unavenged: οὐκ ἄτῖτος κεῖτʼ Ἄσιος Il. 13.414. 2 Unpaid: ἵνα μὴ ποινὴ ἄτιτος ἔῃ Il. 14.484.

a)polu/w.head: ἀπολύω
a)polu/w.html: ἀπολύω [ἀπο- 1, ἀπο- 4.] 1 To loose or untie from. With genit.: ίμάντα κορώνης Od. 8.46. In mid., to undo (something) from one's person, [κρήδεμνον] Od. 5.349. 2 a To set free (a captive) on payment of ransom Il. 1.95, Il. 6.427, Il. 10.449. To restore (a corpse) Il. 24.115, 136. b In mid., to effect the ransoming of, [Λυκάονα καὶ Πολύδωρον] χαλκοῦ (genit. of price) Il. 22.50.

a)rh/gw.head: ἀρήγω
a)rh/gw.html: ἀρήγω Fut. infin. ἀρηξέμεν Il. 13.9, Il. 14.265. -ειν Il. 1.77, Il. 5.833. Aor. infin. ἀρῆξαι Il. 1.408. (ἐπ-.) To help, aid, succour. With dat.: μοι Il. 1.77. Cf. Il. 1.408, 521, Il. 5.507, 833, Il. 8.11, Il. 11.242, Il. 12.68, Il. 13.9, Il. 14.192, 265, 391, Il. 15.42, 493, Il. 16.701, Il. 17.630, Il. 20.25. With a form in -φιν: φρήτρηφιν Il. 2.363.

a)/skopos.head: ἄσκοπος
a)/skopos.html: ἄσκοπος [ἀ-1 + σκοπός. Not aiming.] Acting on impulse without consideration Il. 24.157 = 186.

a)gora/omai.head: ἀγοράομαι
a)gora/omai.html: ἀγοράομαι [ἀγορή.] 2 pl. άγοράασθε Il. 2.337. 2 pl. impf. ἠγοράασθε Il. 8.230. 3 pl. ἠγορόωντο Il. 4.1. 1 To sit in assembly, hold debate Il. 2.337, Il. 4.1. 2 To speak or discourse in an assembly or company Il. 1.73, 253, etc.: Od. 2.24, Od. 4.773, etc. 3 To utter in an assembly: εὐχωλάς Il. 8.230.

a)i/dhlos.head: ἀΐδηλος
a)i/dhlos.html: ἀΐδηλος -ον [ἀ-1 + (ϝ)ιδ-, εἴδω. making unseen.] Destroying, working destruction or harm, baneful Il. 2.455, Il. 5.880, 897, Il. 9.436, Il. 11.155: Od. 8.309, Od. 16.29, Od. 22.165, Od. 23.303.

a)rsi/noos.head: Ἀρσίνοος
a)rsi/noos.html: Ἀρσίνοος (μεγαλήτωρ). Father of Hecamede Il. 11.626.

a)dh/ritos.head: ἀδήριτος
a)dh/ritos.html: ἀδήριτος [ἀ-1 + δηρίομαι.] Free from strife: πόνος (i.e. unfought) Il. 17.42.

a)rgo/s.head: ἀργός
a)rgo/s.html: ἀργός -ή, -όν. 1 White, bright. Of oxen, app., glistening, sleek Il. 23.30. So of a goose Od. 15.161. 2 The notion of brightness or gleam passing into that of rapid movement (cf. αἰόλος 2). Of dogs, swift Il. 1.50, Il. 18.283: Od. 17.62 = Od. 20.145. Sim.: κύνες πόδας ἀργοί (swift-footed) Il. 18.578: Od. 2.11.

a)frone/w.head: ἀφρονέω
a)frone/w.html: ἀφρονέω [ἄφρων.] To act senselessly or foolishly: Ζηνὶ μενεαίνομεν ἀφρονέοντες Il. 15.104.

a)/rektos.head: ἄρεκτος
a)/rektos.html: ἄρεκτος [ἀ-1 + ῥεκ-, ῥέζω.] Undone, still to do: ἔτι μέγα ἔργον ἄρεκτον Il. 19.150.

a)nth/nwr.head: Ἀντήνωρ
a)nth/nwr.html: Ἀντήνωρ (ἀγαυός, ἱππόδαμος , πεπνυμένος). A Trojan elder. Husband of Theano and father of Acamas-1 Agenor , Archelochus, Coon, Demoleon , Helicaon, Iphidamas, Laodocus-1, Laodamas-1, Pedaeus (bastard), and Polybus-1 Il. 2.822 , Il. 3.148; had entertained Odysseus and Menelaus Il. 3.203; Il. 3.262, 312, Il. 6.299; counsels the restoration of Helen Il. 7.347; Il. 7.357, Il. 11.262, Il. 12.99, Il. 14.463, 473, Il. 15.517, Il. 20.396, Il. 21.546, 579.

a)krokelainia/w.head: †ἀκροκελαινιάω
a)krokelainia/w.html: †ἀκροκελαινιάω [ἄκρος + κελαινός.] In pres. pple. ἀκροκελαινιόων, of a river, with black or dark surfaceIl. 21.249.

a)kesto/s.head: ἀκεστός
a)kesto/s.html: ἀκεστός -ή [ἀκεσ-, ἀκέομαι.] That can be healed: ἀκεσταὶ φρένες ἐσθλῶν Il. 13.115 (app., are open to propitiation).

a)/rhtos.head: Ἄρητος-1
a)/rhtos.html:
Ἄρητος-1 (ᾱ) T (θεοειδής) Il. 17.494 . Killed by Automedon Il. 17.517, 535.
Ἄρητος-2 (ᾱ). Son of Nestor Od. 3.414 , 440.

a(li/artos.head: Ἁλίαρτος
a(li/artos.html: Ἁλίαρτος (ποιήεις) A Boeotian town Il. 2.503.

a)podru/ptw.head: †ἀποδρύπτω
a)podru/ptw.html: †ἀποδρύπτω [ἀπο- 7.] 3 pl. aor. subj. ἀποδρύψωσι Od. 17.480. 3 sing. aor. opt. ἀποδρύθοι Il. 23.187, Il. 24.21. 3 pl. aor. pass. ἀπέδρυθεν Od. 5.435. To tear or lacerate the skin of (a person) Il. 23.187, Il. 24.21: Od. 17.480. In pass., of the skin, to be torn Od. 5.435.

ai)pu/s.head: αἰπύς
ai)pu/s.html: αἰπύς -εῖα, -ύ. 1 Steep, sheer: ὄρος Il. 2.603. Cf. Il. 2.811, 829, Il. 5.367, 868, Il. 11.711, Il. 15.84: αἰπεῖα εἰς ἅλα πέτρη (running sheer down into the sea) Od. 3.293. Cf. Od. 3.287, Od. 4.514, Od. 19.431. Applied to walls Il. 6.327, Il. 11.181: Od. 14.472. Of a noose, hung from on high Od. 11.278. 2 Of cities, set on a steep Il. 2.538, Il. 9.668, Il. 15.71: Od. 3.485, Od. 10.81, Od. 15.193. 3 Fig., difficult, hard. In impers. construction : αἰπύ οἱ ἐσσεῖται Il. 13.317. Of ὄλεθρος (thought of as a precipice or gulf), sheer, utter Il. 6.57, Il. 10.371, Il. 11.174, 441, Il. 12.345, 358, Il. 13.773, Il. 14.99, 507=Il. 16.283, Il. 16.859, Il. 17.155, 244, Il. 18.129: Od. 1.11, 37, Od. 5.305, Od. 9.286, 303, Od. 12.287, 446, Od. 17.47, Od. 22.28, 43, 67. Sim. of φόνος Il. 17.365: Od. 4.843, Od. 16.379. Of the toil and moil of war, hard, daunting Il. 11.601, Il. 16.651. Of wrath, towering Il. 15.223.

a)poko/ptw.head: †ἀποκόπτω
a)poko/ptw.html: †ἀποκόπτω [ἀπο- 1, ἀπο- 3.] Fut. infin. ἀποκόψειν Il. 9.241. Aor. ἀπέκοψα Od. 9.325, Od. 23.195. 3 sing. -ε Il. 11.261, Il. 16.474: Od. 3.449. 1 To cut off, strike off: κάρη Il. 11.261. Cf. Il. 9.241: Od. 9.325, Od. 23.195. 2 To cut through, sever: τένοντας Od. 3.449. To cut loose: παρήορον Il. 16.474.

a)yeudh/s.head: Ἀψευδής
a)yeudh/s.html: Ἀψευδής A Nereid Il. 18.46 .

a)/stu.head: ἄστυ
a)/stu.html: ἄστυ -εος, τό (ϝάστυ). A town or city (used as = πόλις 1 Il. 21.607: Od. 6.177-8, Od. 8.524-5, Od. 14.472-3; but in Il. 17.144 app. the inhabited part of the city as opposed to the citadel; see πόλις (2)) Il. 2.332, Il. 3.116, Il. 6.256, Il. 7.32, etc.: Od. 1.3, Od. 3.107, Od. 4.9, Od. 7.40, etc. With name of a particular town in genit.: ἀ. ζελείης Il. 4.103 = 121. Cf. Il. 14.281, Il. 21.128: Od. 18.1, Od. 22.223.

a)mopa/wn.head: Ἀμοπάων
a)mopa/wn.html: Ἀμοπάων Trojan. Patronymic Πολυαιμονίδης . Killed by Teucrus Il. 8.276.

a(marth=|.head: ἁμαρτῇ
a(marth=|.html: ἁμαρτῇ [ἅμα + ἀρ-, ἀραρίσκω.] 1 Both or all together: δούρατʼ ἤϊξαν Il. 5.656, ῥήσσοντες Il. 18.571. 2 At the same moment, simultaneously Il. 21.162: Od. 22.81.

a)rgale/os.head: ἀργαλέος
a)rgale/os.html: ἀργαλέος -η, -ον. 1 Hard to endure, painful, grivous, burdensome, toilsome Il. 4.471, Il. 10.521, Il. 11.278, 812, Il. 13.85, 667, 669, Il. 14.87, 105, Il. 15.10, Il. 16.109, 528, Il. 17.385, 544, 667, Il. 19.214, Il. 21.386, Il. 22.61: Od. 2.199, Od. 4.393, 483, Od. 11.101, 293, Od. 12.161, Od. 15.232, 444, Od. 24.531. 2 Grievous or disastrous in results, baleful: χόλου Il. 10.107, χόλος Il. 18.119. In comp.: ἀργαλεώτερος χόλος Il. 15.121. Cf. Od. 4.698. Ill-omened, presaging disaster: ἔπος Od. 21.169. Baneful, destructive, working disaster: Ἔριδα Il. 11.4. Of Scylla Od. 12.119. Of winds, blowing with violence Il. 13.795, Il. 14.254: Od. 11.400 = 407, Od. 24.110. Difficult to traverse: λαῖτμα θαλάσσης Od. 5.175. Hard to force: στόμα λαύρης Od. 22.137. Of a wave, dashing or breaking with violence Od. 5.367.– Hard to manage: βόας Od. 11.291. 3 In neut. ἀργαλέον, with or without copula, it is hard or difficult. With infin.: ῥῦσθαι Il. 15.140. Cf. Il. 20.368, Il. 21.498: Od. 7.241. With dat. and infin.: ἀ. μοί ἐστι θέσθαι κέλευθον Il. 12.410. Cf. Il. 17.252, Il. 20.356, Il. 23.791: Od. 13.312. With acc. and infin.: ἀ. με ταῦτʼ ἀγορεῦσαι Il. 12.176. Cf. Od. 16.88, Od. 19.221. App. rather in sense oppressive, unfair. With infin.: ἀ. ἀνδράσι καὶ πλεόνεσσι μαχήσασθαι (i.e. to have to fight with them) Od. 2.244. Sim. with acc. and infin.: ἀ. ἕνα προικὸς χαρίσασθαι (hard, too much) Od. 13.15. 4 In personal construction. With infin.: ἀργαλέος Ὀλύμπιος ἀντιφέρεσθαι (is hard to set oneself against) Il. 1.589. Cf. Il. 12.63: Od. 4.397.

a)polh/gw.head: ἀπολήγω
a)polh/gw.html: ἀπολήγω [ἀπο- 7.] 2 sing. fut. ἀπολλήξεις Od. 19.166. 2 sing. aor. subj. ἀπολλήξης Il. 15.31. 3 pl. -ωσι Od. 13.151. 3 pl. opt. -ειαν Od. 12.224. 1 To cease, give over, desist, stop Il. 13.230, Il. 20.99. To fail, die out Il. 6.149. 2 To cease or desist from. With genit.: μάχης Il. 7.263, Il. 11.255. Cf. Il. 15.31, Il. 21.577, Il. 24.475: Od. 12.224, Od. 13.151. To cease or desist. With complementary pple.: δηϊόων Il. 17.565. Cf. Od. 19.166.

a)menhno/w.head: ἀμενηνόω
a)menhno/w.html: ἀμενηνόω [ἀμενηνός.] To deprive of efficiency or effect: αἰχμήν Il. 13.562.

a)treu/s.head: Ἀτρεύς
a)treu/s.html: Ἀτρεύς (δαΐφρων, ἱππόδαμος , ποιμὴν λαῶν). Son of Pelops, brother of Thyestes and father of Agamemnon and Menelaus Il. 2.23; the sceptre given to him by Pelops and by him to Thyestes Il. 2.105, 106; Il. 3.37, Il. 6.46, Il. 17.1; etc.: Od. 4.462, 543, Od. 11.436.

a)/mmoros.head: ἄμμορος
a)/mmoros.html: ἄμμορος -ον [ἀ-1 + μόρος.] 1 Denied the just dues of mankind, ill - fated Il. 6.408, Il. 24.773. 2 Having no share in, not entering. With genit.: λοετρῶν Ὠκεανοῖο Il. 18.489: = Od. 5.275.

a)nia/zw.head: ἀνιάζω
a)nia/zw.html: ἀνιάζω [ἀνίη.] 1 To molest, annoy Od. 19.323. To weary, tire Il. 23.721. 2 To be overcome by distress or pain Il. 21.270: Od. 22.87. To weary, become tired Od. 4.460. To become impatient Od. 4.598. To be oppressed, feel hampered (by the possession of something): κτεάτεσσιν Il. 18.300.

a)skhqh/s.head: ἀσκηθής
a)skhqh/s.html: ἀσκηθής [app. ἀ-1. Second element unkon.] Unhurt, unharmed Il. 10.212, Il. 16.247: Od. 5.26 = 144, 168, Od. 9.79, Od. 11.535, Od. 14.255.

a)kleh/s.head: ἀκλεής
a)kleh/s.html: ἀκλεής [ἀ-1 + κλέος.] Acc. ἀκλέα (for ἀκλεέα) Od. 4.728. Nom. pl. ἀκλεέες Il. 12.318. 1 Without fame, inglorious Il. 12.318. In neut. ἀκλεές as adv. = ἀκλειῶς 1: ἥμενοι Il. 7.100. 2 (So as to be) the subject of no tidings: παῖδʼ ἀνηρείψαντο θύελλαι ἀκλέα Od. 4.728.

a)/nta.head: ἄντα
a)/nta.html: ἄντα [ἀντί.] I Adv. 1 Face to face: μάχεσθαι Il. 19.163, ἀνασχομένω Il. 23.686, θεοῖσιν ἀ. ἐῴκει (when set face to face, when brought into comparison) Il. 24.630. –Facing a person: στῆ Od. 6.141. 2 Straight in front of one: ἰδών Il. 13.184 = 404 = 503 = Il. 16.610 = Il. 17.305 = 526, Il. 22.274. Cf. Od. 21.48, 421, Od. 22.266, Od. 24.181. II Prep. with genit. (freq. following the case). 1 Over against, opposite: Ἥλιδος ἀ. Il. 2.626. In the presence of: ἀ. σέθεν Od. 4.160. 2 In hostile sense, against: Διὸς ἀ. Il. 8.424, 428. Cf. Il. 8.233, Il. 15.415, Il. 16.621, Il. 20.75, 76, 355, 365, Il. 21.477: Od. 22.232. Facing: μευ Il. 16.29. Cf. Il. 17.167, Il. 20.69, 73, 89. 3 A (fitting) match for Il. 21.331. 4 In front of, before: ἀ. παρειάων Od. 1.334 = Od. 16.416 = Od. 18.210 = Od. 21.65. Cf. Od. 4.115 = 154.

a)poguio/w.head: ἀπογυιόω
a)poguio/w.html: ἀπογυιόω [ἀπο- 7.] To lame, cripple; fig., to deprive (of vigour): μή μʼ ἀπογυιώσῃς μένεος Il. 6.265.

a)kerseko/mhs.head: ἀκερσεκόμης
a)kerseko/mhs.html: ἀκερσεκόμης [ἀ-1 + κερσ-, κείρω + κόμη.] With unshorn hair. Epithet of Phoebus Il. 20.39.

a)li/gkios.head: ἀλίγκιος
a)li/gkios.html: ἀλίγκιος Like, resembling. With dat.: ἀστέρι καλῷ Il. 6.401: ἀθανάτοισιν Od. 8.174.

a)si/nh.head: Ἀσίνη
a)si/nh.html: Ἀσίνη A town in the realm of Diomedes (Argos-1 (1)) Il. 2.560.

a)ri/sbh.head: Ἀρίσβη
a)ri/sbh.html: Ἀρίσβη (δῖα). A town of the Troad between A bydus and Percote Il. 2.836, Il. 6.13, Il. 21.43. Ἀρίσβηθεν [-θεν], from Arisbe Il. 2.838, Il. 12.96.

a)rhgw/n.head: ἀρηγών
a)rhgw/n.html: ἀρηγών -όνος [ἀρήγω.] A helper, aider Il. 4.7, Il. 5.511.

a)/ktwr.head: Ἄκτωρ-1
a)/ktwr.html:
Ἄκτωρ-1 Patronymic Ἀζεΐδης. Apparently father of Astyoche Il. 2.513.
Ἄκτωρ-2 Father of Menoetius Il. 11.785, Il. 16.14.

a)nati/qhmi.head: †ἀνατίθημι
a)nati/qhmi.html: †ἀνατίθημι [ἀνα- 1.] 3 sing. fut. ἀναθήσει. To lay (reproach) upon. With dat.: ἐλεγχείην μοι Il. 22.100.

ai)/shpos.head: Αἴσηπος-1
ai)/shpos.html:
Αἴσηπος-1 A river of the Troad flowing into the Propontis Il. 2.825 , Il. 4.91 Il. 12.21.
Αἴσηπος-2 Trojan. Son of Boucolion and Abarbaree. With his twin brother Pedasus-3 killed by Euryalus-1 Il. 6.21 .

a)fi/hmi.head: †ἀφίημι
a)fi/hmi.html: †ἀφίημι [ἀφ-, ἀπο- 1 + ἵημι1.] Fem. pl. pres. pple. ἀφιεῖσαι Od. 7.126. Fut. ἀφήσω Il. 2.263. 3 sing. aor. ἀφέηκε Il. 12.221, Il. 21.115, Il. 23.841. ἀφῆκε Il. 8.133, Il. 10.372, Il. 13.410, Il. 21.590, Il. 23.432. 3 dual aor. ἀφέτην Il. 11.642. 3 sing. subj. ἀφήῃ Il. 17.631. ἀφέῃ Il. 16.590. 3 sing. opt. ἀφείη Il. 3.317, Il. 20.464. From ἀφιέω 3 sing. impf. ἀφίει Il. 1.25, 379, Il. 11.702, Il. 13.444, Il. 16.613, Il. 17.529: Od. 24.539. Mid. 3 sing. impf. ἀφίετο Od. 23.240. 1 To throw, hurl, launch (a missile): ἔγχος Il. 3.317. Cf. Il. 8.133, Il. 10.372, Il. 16.590, Il. 17.631, Il. 23.432: Od. 24.539. Absol., to make one's throw Il. 23.841. With genit. of the throwing limb: ἄκοντα χειρὸς ἀφῆκεν Il. 21.590. Cf. Il. 13.410. 2 To send from one-self, let fall: ἔγχος Il. 21.115. Cf. Il. 12.221. 3 To send forth, cause to cease: μένος [ἔγχεος] Il. 13.444 = Il. 16.613 = Il. 17.529. 4 To get rid of, slake (thirst): δίψαν Il. 11.642. 5 To shed (blossom) Od. 7.126. 6 In mid., to loose (a part of oneself) from. With genit.: δειρῆς οὐκ ἀφίετο πήχεε Od. 23.240. 7 To send away, dismiss (a person) Il. 1.25 = Il. 1.379, Il. 2.263, Il. 11.702. To let go, set free: ζωόν Il. 20.464.

au)lh/.head: αὐλή
au)lh/.html: αὐλή -ῆς, ἡ. 1 a An enclosure or steading for sheep, goats, swine, etc. Il. 4.433, Il. 5.142, Il. 10.183: Od. 9.184, 239, 338, 462, Od. 14.5, 13, Od. 15.555, Od. 16.165, b The enclosing wall or fence thought of rather than the space enclosed: αὐλῆς ὑπεράλμενον Il. 5.138. 2 A courtyard in front of or surrounding a house: ὑπʼ αἰθούσῃ αὐλῆς Il. 9.472, ἑρκίον αὐλῆς 476. Cf. Il. 6.247, 316, Il. 11.774, Il. 24.161, 452, 640: ὅθι οἱ θάλαμος αὐλῆς δέδμητο (in the αὐλή) Od. 1.425, δόμοι καὶ αὐ. Od. 6.303. Cf. Od. 2.300, Od. 4.678, Od. 7.112, 130, Od. 10.10, Od. 15.162, Od. 16.343, Od. 17.266, Od. 18.101, 102, 237, Od. 20.355, Od. 21.191, 240, 389, Od. 22.137, 376, 442 = 459, 449, 474, 494. 3 App. loosely as = δῶμα 3..b Od. 4.74.

a)steroph/.head: ἀστεροπή
a)steroph/.html: ἀστεροπή -ῆς, ἡ [στεροπή.] Lightning, the lightning flash Il. 11.184, Il. 13.242, Il. 14.386.

a)/llote.head: ἄλλοτε
a)/llote.html: ἄλλοτε [ἄλλος + ὅτε.] 1 At another time, at other times Il. 10.120, Il. 13.776, Il. 19.200, Il. 20.53, Il. 22.171, Il. 24.511. 2 Repeated: ἀ. . . ἀ. . . ., at one time . . . at another . . ., now . . . now . . . Il. 5.595, Il. 18.159, 472, Il. 21.464, Il. 23.368, Il. 24.530: Od. 4.102, Od. 5.331, Od. 11.303, Od. 16.209, Od. 23.94. Thrice (followed by τοτέ) Il. 24.10. Sim. ὁτὲ . . . ἀ . . . Il. 11.65, Il. 18.602, Il. 20.50.– ἀ . . . .ὁτὲ . . . Il. 11.566. 3 With ἄλλος: ἀ. ἐπʼ ἄλλον (now on to one, now on to another) Il. 15.684: ἀ. ἄλλῳ (now to one, now to another) Od. 4.236. 4 At another time, on a former occasion: ἀ. με ῥίψεν Il. 1.590. Cf. Il. 20.90, 187.

a)/rimoi.head: Ἄριμοι
a)/rimoi.html: Ἄριμοι A mythical people in whose country Typhoeus was put in bonds by Zeus Il. 2.783.

a)ssa/rakos.head: Ἀσσάρακος
a)ssa/rakos.html: Ἀσσάρακος Son of Trus-1, father of Capys and grandfather of Anchises Il. 20.232 , 239.

a)nu/w.head: ἀνύω
a)nu/w.html: ἀνύω [cf. ἄνω1.] 3 sing. aor. ἤνῦσε Od. 4.357, Od. 24.71. 3 sing. opt. ἀνύ̆σειε Od. 15.294. Fut. infin. pass. ἀνύσσεσθαι Od. 16.373. (ἀπ-, δι-, ἐξ-.) 1 To effect, accomplish: ἀνύσσεσθαι τάδε ἔργα Od. 16.373. To effect one's purpose Il. 4.56. 2 To consume: ἐπεί σε φλὸξ ἤνυσεν Od. 24.71. 3 To pass over, traverse: θαλάσσης ὕδωρ Od. 15.294. To perform a voyage Od. 4.357.

a)le/cw.head: ἀλέξω
a)le/cw.html: ἀλέξω [cf. ἄλαλκον.] 2 sing. fut. ἀλεξήσεις Il. 9.251. Acc. sing. masc. pple. ἀλεξήσοντα Il. 6.109. Infin. ἀλεξήσειν Il. 20.315, Il. 21.374. 3 sing. aor. opt. ἀλεξήσειε Od. 3.346. Aor. infin. mid. ἀλέξασθαι Il. 13.475, Il. 15.565, Il. 16.562: Od. 18.62. (ἀπ-, ἐπ-.) 1 To ward or keep off, avert Od. 3.346. With dat. of person or thing protected: Δαναοῖσι κακὸν ἦμαρ Il. 9.251. Cf. Il. 9.347, 674, Il. 17.365, Il. 20.315 = Il. 21.374. 2 With dat., to succour, defend, protect: ἀλλήλοισιν Il. 3.9. Cf. Il. 5.779, Il. 6.109. Absol., to afford succour, defence, or protection Il. 1.590, Il. 11.469, Il. 13.356. 3 In mid., to ward or keep off from oneself, defend oneself against, encounter: ἀλέξασθαι κύνας Il. 13.475: τοῦτον ἀλέξασθαι Od. 18.62. Absol., to defend oneself, offer resistance Il. 11.348 = Il. 22.231, Il. 15.565 = Il. 16.562: Od. 9.57.

ai)doi=os.head: αἰδοῖος
ai)doi=os.html: αἰδοῖος -η, -ον [αἰδώς.] 1 Worthy to be held in reverence or honour, having a special claim to one's regard: ἑκυρός Il. 3.172, βασιλῆος Il. 4.402. Cf. Il. 2.514, Il. 6.250, Il. 10.114, Il. 11.649, Il. 14.210, Il. 18.386 = 425, Il. 18.394, Il. 21.75, 460, 479, Il. 22.451: παρακοίτι Od. 3.381, ἱκέτῃσιν Od. 7.165 = 181. Cf.
