Od. 1.139 = Od. 4.55 = Od. 7.175 = Od. 10.371 = Od. 15.138 = Od. 17.94 = 259, Od. 3.451, Od. 5.88, 447, Od. 8.22, 420, 544, Od. 9.271, Od. 10.11, Od. 14.234, Od. 17.152 = Od. 19.165 = 262 = 336 = 583, Od. 18.314, Od. 19.191, 254, 316. Absol. in pl., those who have a special claim to one's regard: αἰδοίοισιν ἔδωκα Od. 15.373. In comp.: αἰδοιότερος πᾶσιν Od. 11.360. 2 In neut. pl., the private parts: αἰδοίων τε μεσηγὺ καὶ ὀμφαλοῦ Il. 13.568. 3 Shamefaced, bashful, shy: ἀλήτης Od. 17.578.

a)/nusis.head: ἄνυσις
a)/nusis.html: ἄνυσις [ἀνύω.] Accomplishment, effect, result: αὐτῶν (app., on their part) Il. 2.347. Cf. Od. 4.544.

a)mfibai/nw.head: †ἀμφιβαίνω
a)mfibai/nw.html: †ἀμφιβαίνω [ἀμφι- 1, ἀμφι- 3.] 2 sing. pf. ἀμφι-βέβηκας Il. 1.37, 451. 3 sing. -ε Il. 6.355, Il. 16.66: Od. 8.541, Od. 12.74. 3 sing. subj. ἀμφιβεβήκῃ Od. 4.400. 3 sing. plupf. ἀμφιβεβήκει Il. 8.68, Il. 16.777: Od. 9.198. 1 To be round, cover completely, a double (organ) (cf. ἀμφί I.1.b). With acc.: πόνος (ἄχος) φρένας ἀμφιβέβηκεν Il. 7.355: Od. 8.541. 2 To come round, surround. With dat.: Τρώων νέφος νηυσίν Il. 16.66. 3 To be round, envelop, cover up. With acc. Od. 12.74. 4 To have the feet on each side of, bestride (cf. βαίνω I.6.a). With acc. Fig.: ἠέλιος μέσον οὐρανόν (thought of as standing with both feet in the midst of heaven) Il. 8.68, Il. 16.777: Od. 4.400. Hence to protect (a place) as a tutelary power Il. 1.37 = 451: Od. 9.198.

a)mu/ssw.head: ἀμύσσω
a)mu/ssw.html: ἀμύσσω 2 sing. fut. ἀμύξεις Il. 1.243. (κατ-.) To tear, lacerate: χερσὶ στήθεα Il. 19.284. Fig.: θυμόν Il. 1.243.

a(li/ploos.head: ἁλίπλοος
a(li/ploos.html: ἁλίπλοος [ἅλς1 + πλέω.] Floating on the sea, in the state of flotsam: τείχεα Il. 12.26.

a)kh/destos.head: ἀκήδεστος
a)kh/destos.html: ἀκήδεστος [ἀκηδεσ-, ἀκηδής.] Without funeral rites: ἐξαπολοίατʼ ἀκήδεστοι Il. 6.60.

a)podeirotome/w.head: ἀποδειροτομέω
a)podeirotome/w.html: ἀποδειροτομέω [ἀπο- 7.] To cut the throat of: Τρώων τέκνα Il. 18.336, Il. 23.22: μῆλα Od. 11.35.

a)pe/leqros.head: ἀπέλεθρος
a)pe/leqros.html: ἀπέλεθρος -ον [ἀ-1 + πέλεθρον.] 1 Unmeasured, i.e. very great: ἶνα Il. 5.245, Il. 7.269: = Od. 9.538. 2 In neut., ἀπέλεθρον as adv., to a very great distance: ἀνέδραμεν Il. 11.354.

a)/potmos.head: ἄποτμος
a)/potmos.html: ἄποτμος [ἀ-1 + πότμος. Bereft of a (good) lot.] Hence, unlucky, ill-starred Il. 24.388. Absol.: ἀ. τις Od. 13.140. Superl.: ἀποτμότατος Od. 1.219.

a)poblu/zw.head: ἀποβλύζω
a)poblu/zw.html: ἀποβλύζω [ἀπο- 1+ βλύζω, which recurs only in late Greek in sense to gush forth.] To send or spirt out: οἴνου ἀποβλύζων (partitive genit.) Il. 9.491.

a)maima/ketos.head: ἀμαιμάκετος
a)maima/ketos.html: ἀμαιμάκετος -η, -ον [perh. redup. fr. μακ-, μακρός.] Thus, of very great size or height: χίμαιραν Il. 6.179, Il. 16.329: ἱστὸν νηός Od. 14.311.

a)pria/thn.head: ἀπριάτην
a)pria/thn.html: ἀπριάτην [adv. fr. acc. fem. of *πρίατος fr. ἀ-1 + πρίαμαι.] Without price or payment Il. 1.99: Od. 14.317.

a)le/w.head: †ἀλέω
a)le/w.html: †ἀλέω 3 pl. aor. ἄλεσσαν. To grind: πυρόν Od. 20.109.

ai)sxu/nw.head: αἰσχύνω
ai)sxu/nw.html: αἰσχύνω [αἶσχος.] 2 sing aor. ᾔσχυνας Il. 23.571. 3 pl. -ε Il. 18.24, 27: Od. 8.269. Pf. pple. pass. ᾐσχυμμένος Il. 18.180. (κατ-.) 1 To disfigure, mar, spoil the beauty of Il. 18.24, 27. To mar, mutilate Il. 18.180, Il. 22.75, Il. 24.418. To defile (the marriage-bed) Od. 8.269. 2 To bring shame upon, act unworthily of: γένος πατέρων Il. 6.209. To put to shame, discredit: ἐμὴν ἀρετήν Il. 23.571.–to throw blame upon Od. 2.86. 3 In pass., to feel shame, hesitate: δείσας αἰσχυνόμενός τε Od. 7.305. Cf. Od. 18.12. To feel shame at the prospect of, hesitate to incur: αἰσχυνόμενοι φάτιν ἀνδρῶν Od. 21.323.

a)go/s.head: ἀγός
a)go/s.html: ἀγός -οῦ, ὁ [ἄγω.] A leader, commander, chief Il. 3.231, Il. 4.265, Il. 5.217, Il. 12.61, Il. 13.304, Il. 23.160, etc.

a)/hmi.head: †ἄημι
a)/hmi.html: †ἄημι (ἄϝημι) [cf. ἀΐω2, ἰαύω.] 2 dual ἄητον Il. 9.5. Pple. ἀείς, -έντος Il. 5.526: Od. 5.478, Od. 19.440. Infin. ἀήμεναι Il. 23.214: Od. 3.176. ἀῆναι Od. 3.183, Od. 10.25. 3 sing. impf. ἄ̆η Od. 12.325, Od. 14.458. Pres. pple. pass. ἀήμενος Od. 6.131. 3 sing. impf. ἄ̆ητο Il. 21.386. (δι-.) 1 Of the winds, to blow Il. 5.526, Il. 9.5 : Od. 3.176, 183, Od. 5.478, Od. 10.25, Od. 12.325, Od. 14.458, Od. 19.440. 2 To blow upon (something): πόντον ἵκανον ἀήμεναι (so as to blow upon it) Il. 23.214. 3 In pass., to be blown upon: ὑόμενος καὶ ἀήμενος Od. 6.131. Fig.: θυμὸς ἄητο (was blown about (by gusts of passion)) Il. 21.386.

a)eiki/zw.head: ἀεικίζω
a)eiki/zw.html: ἀεικίζω [ἀεικής.] Fut. ἀεικιῶ Il. 22.256. 3 pl. aor. subj. ἀεικίσσωσι Il. 16.545, Il. 19.26. 1 pl. aor. opt. mid. ἀεικισσαίμεθα Il. 16.559. Infin. ἀεικίσσασθαι Il. 22.404. Aor. infin. pass. ἀεικισθήμεναι Od. 18.222. (καταικίζω.) 1 To treat in unseemly wise Od. 18.222. 2 To work despite upon, mutilate (a corpse) Il. 16.545, 559, Il. 22.256, 404, Il. 24.22, 54. Of flies marring (a corpse) Il. 19.26.

a)tre/mas.head: ἀτρέμας
a)tre/mas.html: ἀτρέμας Before a consonant ἀτρέμα Il. 15.318. [ἀ-1 + τρέμω.] Without motion, still Il. 2.200, Il. 5.524, Il. 13.280, 438, 557, Il. 14.352, Il. 15.318: Od. 13.92, Od. 19.212.

a)olli/zw.head: †ἀολλίζω
a)olli/zw.html: †ἀολλίζω [ἀολλής.] 3 pl. aor. ἀόλλισσαν Il. 6.287. Fem. pple. ἀολλίσσασα Il. 6.270. 3 pl. aor. pass. ἀολλίσθησαν Il. 19.54. Infin. ἀολλισθήμεναι Il. 15.588. 1 To gather together, cause to assemble: γεραιάς Il. 6.270, 287. 2 In pass., to come together, assemble: ἐπεὶ πάντες ἀολλίσθησαν Il. 19.54. Cf. Il. 15.588.

a)fneio/s.head: ἀφνειός
a)fneio/s.html: ἀφνειός [ἄφενος.] Rich, wealthy Il. 2.570, 825, Il. 5.9, Il. 6.47, Il. 9.483, Il. 13.664, Il. 17.576, Il. 24.318, 398, 482: Od. 1.232, 393, Od. 11.414, Od. 14.116, 200, Od. 15.227, 426, 433, Od. 17.420 = Od. 19.76, Od. 17.423 = Od. 19.79, Od. 18.127. Absol. Od. 18.276. In superl. ἀφνειότατος Il. 20.220. With genit.: βιότοιο (in . . .) Il. 5.544, Il. 6.14, Il. 14.122. So in comp.: ἐλαφρότεροι πόδας εἶναι ἢ ἀφνειότεροι χρυσοῖο (light of foot rather than rich in . . .) Od. 1.165.

a)ntikru/.head: ἀντικρύ
a)ntikru/.html: ἀντικρύ ( ῦ Il. 5.130, 819) [ἀντί.] 1 Face to face: μάχεσθαι Il. 5.130, 819. 2 Straight on, right on: διʼ ὤμου Il. 4.481. Cf. Il. 3.359 = Il. 7.253, Il. 5.67, 74, 100, 189, Il. 11.253, Il. 13.595, 652, Il. 16.346, Il. 17.49 = Il. 22.327, Il. 20.416, Il. 23.876: Od. 10.162, Od. 19.453, Od. 22.16. 3 Right over: τάφρον ὑπέρθορον Il. 16.380. 4 (Aiming) straight in front Il. 16.285. 5 With genit., straight against: Ἕκτορος ἀ. Il. 8.301 = 310. 6 Vehemently: μεμαώς Il. 13.137. Right out, without circumlocution Il. 7.362. 7 Utterly, completely: ἀπάραξε Il. 16.116. Cf. Il. 23.673, 867.

a)/falos.head: ἄφαλος
a)/falos.html: ἄφαλος -ον [ἀ-1 + φάλος.] Having no φάλος Il. 10.258.

a)ma/w.head: ἀμάω1
a)ma/w.html:
ἀμάω1 (ἀπ-, δι-.) 1 To reap, act as reaper Il. 18.551. 2 To reap (a crop) Od. 9.135. To cut (reeds) Il. 24.451. 3 To slice off: ἀπʼ οὔατʼ ἀμήσαντες Od. 8.301.
ἀμάω2 [perh. conn. with ἅμα.] (ὲπ-, κατ-.) To collect, bring together. In mid. : ἐν ταλάροισιν ἀμησάμενος Od. 9.247.

a)zei/dhs.head: Ἀζεΐδης
a)zei/dhs.html: Ἀζεΐδης Patronymic of Actor-1 Il. 2.513.

a)/htos.head: ἄητος
a)/htos.html: ἄητος [perh. fr. ἄημι.] Thus, vehement, violent, fierce: θάρσος Il. 21.395.

ai(re/w.head: αἱρέω
ai(re/w.html: αἱρέω 3 sing. fut. αἱρήσει Il. 21.555, Il. 24.206. 2 pl. αἱρήσομεν Il. 2.141, 329, Il. 9.28. Infin. αἱρησέμεν Il. 17.488, Il. 18.260. αἱρήσειν Il. 2.37, Il. 13.42. Aor. εἷλον, -ες Il. 3.35, Il. 4.406, Il. 5.47, Il. 8.77, Il. 10.561, Il. 21.77, Il. 22.17, etc.: Od. 8.330, Od. 9.416, Od. 19.155, Od. 21.299, Od. 24.377, etc. ἕλον, -ες Il. 1.197, Il. 4.457, Il. 5.127, Il. 6.35, Il. 7.8, Il. 9.271, Il. 11.738, Il. 16.351, Il. 17.276, etc. : Od. 1.121, Od. 2.81, Od. 3.37, Od. 8.106, Od. 15.496, Od. 22.187, etc. Subj. ἕλω, -ῃς Il. 2.228, 332, Il. 4.239, 416, Il. 7.71, 81, Il. 16.128, 725. 3 sing. ἕλῃσι Il. 23.345 : Od. 12.96, Od. 17.323, Od. 19.515. ἕλῃ Il. 7.77, Il. 11.315, etc. : Od. 21.294. Opt. ἕλοιμι, -οις Il. 2.12, 29, 66, Il. 9.304, Il. 10.206, 345, Il. 11.509, Il. 15.71, etc. : Od. 4.463, 596, Od. 19.511. Imp. ἕλε Il. 14.272. 3 sing. ἑλέτω Od. 20.52. Pple. ἑλών, -οῦσα Il. 1.139, 501, Il. 3.316, Il. 8.13, etc. : Od. 1.318, Od. 4.750, Od. 8.436, Od. 9.165, etc. Infin. ἑλέειν Il. 15.558, Il. 22.142 : Od. 11.205, 206, 210, 426. ἑλεῖν Il. 5.118, Il. 8.319, Il. 15.720. Pa. iterative ἕλεσκον Od. 14.220. 3 sing. ἕλεσκε Il. 24.752: Od. 8.88. Mid. Nom. pl. pres. pple. αἱρεύμενοι Il. 16.353. Fut. αἱρήσομαι Od. 2.357. 2 sing. αἱρήσεαι Il. 10.235. Aor. ἑλόμην Il. 5.210, Il. 8.108, Il. 19.60. 2 sing. εἵλευ Il. 17.206. 3 sing. εἵλετο Il. 2.46, Il. 3.294, Il. 6.472, Il. 9.344, etc. : Od. 1.99, Od. 5.47, Od. 6.140, Od. 10.363, etc. ἕλετο Il. 4.116, Il. 9.368, Il. 11.32, Il. 12.102, etc. : Od. 4.746, Od. 5.121, Od. 12.246, Od. 14.530. 1 pl. εἱλόμεθα Od. 9.157, Od. 11.21. ἑλόμεσθα Il. 11.730. 3 pl. εἵλοντο Il. 7.380, Il. 18.314 : Od. 6.97. ἕλοντο Il. 2.399, Il. 7.122, Il. 8.53, Il. 16.663, etc. : Od. 4.786, Od. 6.91, Od. 8.372, Od. 9.86, etc. Subj. ἕλωμαι Il. 1.137, Il. 17.17, etc. 3 sing. ἕληται Il. 12.150, Il. 16.650, etc. : Od. 12.123. 3 pl. ἕλωνται Il. 16.82, 545. Opt. ἑλοίμην, -οιο Il. 2.127, Il. 3.66, Il. 5.317, Il. 16.655, etc. : Od. 14.297, 405, Od. 16.149, 297, Od. 17.236, Od. 20.62, Od. 22.462, Od. 24.334. 3 pl. ἑλοίατο Od. 20.117. Imp. ἕλευ Il. 13.294. 3 sing. ἑλέσθω Il. 9.139, 391 : Od. 18.47. 2 pl. ἕλεσθε Il. 5.529, Il. 7.370, Il. 18.298. Infin. ἑλέσθαι Il. 5.852, Il. 9.578, Il. 13.268, etc. : Od. 8.68, Od. 9.334, Od. 11.584, etc. (ἀν-, ἀποπρο-, ἀφ-, ἐξ-, ἐξαφ-, καθ-, μεθ-, συν-.) I In act. 1 To take, take hold of, grasp, seize : ἡνία Il. 8.319, γαῖαν Il. 11.425. Cf. Il. 5.75, 353, Il. 11.749, Il. 14.137, Il. 21.242, Il. 24.227, etc. : χεῖρα Od. 1.121. Cf. Od. 7.252, Od. 11.205, Od. 22.269, etc. With genit. of a part grasped : κόμης Πηλεΐωνα (by the . . .) Il. 1.197. Cf. Il. 1.323, Il. 7.108, Il. 19.126, Il. 21.71, etc. : χειρὸς Ὀδυσῆα Od. 7.168. Cf. Od. 12.33, Od. 17.263, etc. Sim. ἕλκε δουρὸς ἑλών Il. 16.406. With quasi-partitive genit. : μέσσου δουρὸς ἑλών Il. 3.78 = Il. 7.56. 2 Of feelings, bodily or mental states, or the like, to take hold of, come to or upon, seize, affect : μή σε λήθη αἱρείτω Il. 2.34, χόλος μιν ᾕρει Il. 4.23. Cf. Il. 3.446, Il. 4.421, Il. 5.136, 862, Il. 13.581, Il. 16.805, etc. : οἶκτος Od. 2.81, θάμβος Od. 3.372. Cf. Od. 4.596, Od. 8.304, Od. 11.43, Od. 21.122, Od. 22.500, etc. Of the darkness of death Il. 5.47, Il. 13.672 = Il. 16.607. Of sleep Il. 10.193, Il. 22.502, Il. 24.5 : Od. 9.373, Od. 19.511, Od. 20.52. 3 to take, capture, seize upon : ἑλὼν ἔχει γέρας Il. 1.356, εἴ σʼ αἱρήσει (get you in his power) Il. 24.206. Cf. Il. 6.38, Il. 10.206, 345, Il. 11.315, Il. 17.488, Il. 21.77, etc.: ἐπαΐξανθʼ ἑλέτην Od. 22.187. Cf. Od. 4.463, Od. 12.96, Od. 16.369. To come upon, catch: με Od. 19.155. To catch up, overtake Il. 23.345: Od. 8.330. To take (a town): πόλιν Τρώων Il. 2.12. Cf. Il. 2.37, 141, Il. 4.406, Il. 9.129, Il. 16.153, etc.: Od. 9.165, Od. 24.377. To take as prey: πέλειαν Il. 22.142. Of Scylla Od. 12.310. 4 To kill, slay: ἄνδρα κορυστήν Il. 4.457. Cf. Il. 5.37, Il. 9.304, Il. 10.561, Il. 11.92, Il. 15.328, Il. 20.382, Il. 21.327, Il. 22.253, etc.: Od. 14.220, Od. 16.383. 5 To take away, remove: ἔγχος ἀπὸ χειρός Il. 15.126. Cf. Il. 2.154, Il. 5.127, etc.: Od. 8.88, Od. 19.61, Od. 21.56, etc. 6 To take for use or for some purpose, take into the hands: σῖτον Il. 9.216, σάκος Il. 14.9. Cf. Il. 9.656, Il. 10.335, Il. 15.474, Il. 18.416, Il. 23.839, Il. 24.93, etc.: τρίαιναν Od. 4.506, ἐπὶ πήχει ἑλών (taking it and placing it on the . . .) Od. 21.419. Cf. Od. 1.318, Od. 4.750, Od. 8.89, Od. 10.145, Od. 17.343, Od. 19.386, etc. 7 To draw (a person to one-self): τὴν προτὶ οἷ εἷλεν Il. 21.508. Cf. Od. 24.348. 8 In various uses. a To take as one's due: λέβητα Il. 23.613, βοῦν 779. b To win (fame) Il. 17.321. c To take (wine) Od. 21.294. d Of a condition of life, to come upon (one): δούλιον ἦμαρ Od. 17.323. e In reference to change of a person's colour: ὦχρός μιν εἷλε παρειάς Il. 3.35. f To take up (a lay): ἔνθεν ἑλὼν [ἀοιδὴν] ὡς . . . (from the point where . . .) Od. 8.500. 9 With adverbs. a With διά, to separate, tear apart: διὰ δʼ ἕλε κύκλους Il. 20.280. b With ἐκ, to choose, select: ἐκ δʼ ἕλον Χρυσηΐδα Il. 1.369. c With κατά, to lower: κὰδ δʼ ἕλον ἱστόν Od. 15.496. To close (the eyes of the dead) Od. 11.426. 10 In aor. pple. with a finite vb., to take and . . . (cf. ἄγω I.9): γέρας ἄξω ἑλών Il. 1.139, ἑλὼν ῥίψω Il. 8.13. Cf. Il. 3.72, 316, Il. 6.302, Il. 18.23, Il. 19.143, Il. 24.795, etc.: ξύλα δαῖον ἑλοῦσαι Od. 8.436, δὸς ἑλών Od. 17.400. Cf. Od. 4.66, Od. 8.84, Od. 9.382, etc. II In mid. 1 To seize upon to one's own use, take away, appropriate: ἕλωμαί κε γέρας Il. 1.137. Cf. Il. 9.336, Il. 18.445, etc. With acc. of person deprived: τήν [μʼ] ἐκ χειρῶν ἕλεθʼ ὡς εἴ τινα μετανάστην Il. 16.58. 2 To take, capture: [Βρισηΐδα] Il. 19.60. With acc. of person deprived: οὓς ἀπʼ Αἰνείαν ἑλόμην Il. 8.108. To take as prey: βοῶν ἐκ πῖαρ ἑλέσθαι Il. 11.550 = Il. 17.659, [ἄρνας] αἱρεύμενοι Il. 16.353. Of Scylla Od. 12.123, 246. To carry off: Ὠρίωνα Od. 5.121. 3 To take away, remove: ἀπὸ κρατὸς κόρυθʼ εἵλετο Il. 6.472. Cf. Il. 7.122, Il. 10.458, Il. 16.663, etc.: Od. 12.199, Od. 22.271, etc. In reference to life, strength, feelings, etc.: ἀπὸ μένος εἵλετο χαλκός Il. 3.294. Cf. Il. 5.317, Il. 9.377, Il. 11.381, Il. 17.17, etc.: ἐκ δέος εἵλετο γυίων Od. 6.140. Cf. Od. 10.363, Od. 14.405, etc. Sim. in reference to one's home-coming: μὴ ἀπὸ νόστον ἕλωνται Il. 16.82. 4 To take for use or for some purpose, take into the hands: εἵλετο σκῆπτρον Il. 2.46, ἐκ δʼ ἕλετ ἰόν Il. 4.116. Cf. Il. 3.338, Il. 6.494, Il. 11.32, Il. 13.611, Il. 17.593, Il. 24.343, etc.: εἵλετʼ ἔγχος (ῥάβδον) (πέδιλα) Od. 1.99, Od. 5.47, Od. 16.154. Cf. Od. 2.357, Od. 6.91, Od. 8.372, Od. 9.157, etc. To take or carry with one: τόξον οὔ ποθʼ ᾑρεῖτο Od. 21.40. 5 In reference to meals, to take, partake of: δεῖπνον ἕλοντο Il. 2.399, δόρπον ἕλεσθε Il. 7.370, etc.: δόρπον ἕλοντο Od. 4.786, δεῖπνον εἵλοντο Od. 6.97, πύματον ἑλοίατο δαῖτα Od. 20.117, etc. In reference to drink: πιέειν οὐκ εἶχεν ἑλέσθαι Od. 11.584. 6 To get, obtain: ἑκὼν οὐκ ἄν τις ἕλοιτο Il. 3.66, οὔ πως ἅμα πάντα δυνήσεαι ἑλέσθαι Il. 13.729, πεῖραρ ἑλέσθαι Il. 18.501. 7 To choose, select: εἴ κʼ ἄνδρα ἕκαστοι ἑλοίμεθα Il. 2.127, γυναῖκας ἐείκοσιν ἑλέσθω Il. 9.139. Cf. Il. 11.697, Il. 12.102, Il. 16.282, etc.: τοὺς ἄν κε καὶ ἤθελον ἑλέσθαι Od. 9.334. Cf. Od. 16.149, Od. 18.47, etc. 8 In various uses. a To receive, get (gifts) Od. 24.334.–(A price) Od. 14.297.–(A bride-price) μυρίʼ ἕλοντο Od. 15.367. b To take the benefit of, take, accept: ὕπνου δῶρον ἕλοντο Il. 7.482, Il. 9.713: Od. 16.481, Od. 19.427. c To agree to take, accept: ἀναίνετο μηδὲν ἑλέσθαι (refused to accept the blood-price) Il. 18.500. d To take or exact (an oath): εἴ κε Τρωσὶν ὅρκον ἕλωμαι Il. 22.119. Cf. Od. 4.746. e To take (heart): ἄλκιμον ἦτορ ἕλεσθε Il. 5.529.

a)ei/dw.head: ἀείδω
a)ei/dw.html: ἀείδω Fut. pple. in mid. form ἀεισόμενος Od. 22.352. 3 sing. aor. ἄεισε Od. 21.411. Imp. ἄεισον Od. 8.492. Infin. ἀεῖσαι Od. 14.464. (παρ-.) 1 To sing: μουσάων, αἳ ἄειδον Il. 1.604. Cf. Il. 2.598, Il. 9.191: ἀοιδὸς ἄειδεν Od. 1.325. Cf. Od. 1.154, 155, Od. 8.45, 87, 90, 266, Od. 10.221, 254, Od. 14.464, Od. 17.262, 358, 385, 520, Od. 22.331, 346, 352. With cognate acc.: παιήονα Il. 1.473, Il. 22.391. Cf. Il. 18.570: Od. 17.519. Of the nightingale Od. 19.519. Of a bowstring Od. 21.411. 2 To sing of, tell of in song: μῆνιν Il. 1.1. Cf. Il. 9.189: Od. 1.326, 339, 350, Od. 8.73, 83 = 367 = 521, Od. 8.489, 492, 538. With infin. : πόλιν κεραϊζέμεν Od. 8.516. With clause : ὡς . . . Od. 8.514.

a)kh/n.head: ἀκήν
a)kh/n.html: ἀκήν [adv. fr. acc. of *ἀκή, silence.] 1 In silence, without speech: ἴσαν Il. 4.429. 2 Silent: ἔσαν Od. 2.82, Od. 4.285, ἔμεναι Od. 21.239 = 385. With σιωπῇ: ἀ. ἐγένοντο σιωπῇ Il. 3.95 = Il. 7.92 = 398 = Il. 8.28 = Il. 9.29 = 430 = 693 = Il. 10.218 = 313 = Il. 23.676: = Od. 8.234 = Od. 11.333 = Od. 13.1 = Od. 16.393 = Od. 20.320, Od. 7.154.

ai)gi/liy.head: αἰγίλιψ
ai)gi/liy.html:
αἰγίλιψ -ιπος [sense unknown. Traditionally explained as fr. αἰγ-, αἴξ + λιπ-, λείπω, so steep as to be deserted (even) by goats.] Of a rock: πέτρης Il. 9.15 = Il. 16.4, Il. 13.63.
Αἰγίλιψ (τρηχεῖα). Apparently a town of Ithaca Il. 2.633.

a)sa/minqos.head: ἀσάμινθος
a)sa/minqos.html: ἀσάμινθος -ου, ἡ. A bath Il. 10.576: = Od. 4.48, Od. 3.468, Od. 4.128, Od. 8.450, 456, Od. 10.361, Od. 17.87, 90, Od. 23.163, Od. 24.370.

a)pa/gw.head: ἀπάγω
a)pa/gw.html: ἀπάγω [ἀπ-, ἀπο- 1, ἀπο- 4.] Fut. infin. ἀπάξειν Il. 18.326: Od. 15.436. 3 sing. aor. ἀπήγαγε Il. 15.706: Od. 4.289, Od. 16.370. 3 pl. -ον Od. 13.211. 1 To drive or lead off: βόας Od. 18.278. To lead, conduct or bring away Od. 4.289, Od. 13.211. 2 To bring or conduct back Il. 15.706, Il. 18.326: Od. 15.436, Od. 16.370.

a)mfiti/qhmi.head: †ἀμφιτίθημι
a)mfiti/qhmi.html: †ἀμφιτίθημι [ἀμφι- 1, ἀμφι- 3.] 3 sing. aor. mid. ἀμφέθετο Od. 8.431. Aor. fem. pple. pass. ἀμφιτεθεῖσα Il. 10.271. 1 To put round or about something Il. 10.271. 2 In mid., to put on, arm oneself with: ξίφος Od. 8.431 (i.e. the belt rested on both shoulders).

a)/lloqen.head: ἄλλοθεν
a)/lloqen.html: ἄλλοθεν [ἄλλος + -θεν 1.] 1 a From another place or source, from elsewhere: ἵνα μή ποθεν ἀ. αὕῃ Od. 5.490, καλεῖ ἀ. Od. 17.382. b ἀ. ἄλλος, some or one from one side or quarter, some or one from anotherIl. 2.75, Il. 9.311, 671, Il. 13.551: Od. 9.401, 493 = Od. 10.442, Od. 10.119, Od. 11.42, Od. 4.231, Od. 24.415. Sim. νείκεον ἀ. ἄλλον, one beginning with one man, one with anotherOd. 12.392. 2 From another or strange land, from abroad: εἰλήλουθεν Od. 3.318. Cf. Od. 6.283, Od. 7.33, 52, Od. 16.26, Od. 17.112, Od. 20.360.

a)/rnumai.head: ἄρνυμαι
a)/rnumai.html: ἄρνυμαι Aor. ἀρόμην Il. 23.592. 3 sing. -ετο Il. 9.188, Il. 11.625. 3 pl. -οντο Il. 9.124, 266, 269. 2 sing. subj. ἄρηαι Il. 16.84. 3 sing. -ηται Il. 12.435, Il. 14.130, 365. 2 pl. -ησθε Il. 11.290. Opt. ἀροίμην Il. 18.121. 2 sing. -οιο Il. 4.95, Il. 9.303. 3 sing. -οιτο Il. 5.3, Il. 10.307, Il. 20.247, Il. 22.207: Od. 13.422. 1 pl. -οίμεθα Il. 5.273. Infin. ἀρέσθαι Il. 7.203, Il. 12.407, Il. 16.88, Il. 17.16, 287, 419, Il. 18.294, Il. 20.502, Il. 21.297, 543, 596: Od. 1.390, Od. 22.253. 1 To win, achieve, gain, receive, get: τιμήν Il. 1.159, ἀέθλια Il. 9.124 =266, 269, οὐχ ἱερήϊον οὐδὲ βοείην (were to gain, were contending for) Il. 22.160. Cf. Il. 4.95, Il. 5.3, 273, 553, Il. 6.446, Il. 7.203, Il. 9.188, 303, Il. 10.307, Il. 11.290, 625, Il. 12.407, 435, Il. 14.365, Il. 16.84, 88, Il. 17.16, 287, 419, Il. 18.121, 294, Il. 20.502, Il. 21.297, 543, 596, Il. 22.207, Il. 23.592: Od. 1.5, 390, Od. 13.422, Od. 22.253. To get (a wound) Il. 14.130. 2 To be fitted to receive the weight of: [ὀνείδεα] ἄχθος (as lading) Il. 20.247.

au)dh/.head: αὐδή
au)dh/.html: αὐδή -ῆς, ἡ. 1 Voice, speech: Ἕκτορος αὐδήν Il. 13.757, θεῷ ἐναλίγκιος αὐδήν (in . . . ) Il. 19.250. Cf. Il. 1.249, Il. 15.270, Il. 19.418: τοῦ τερπόμεθʼ αὐδῇ Od. 4.160. Cf. Od. 1.371 = Od. 9.4, Od. 2.268 = 401 = Od. 22.206 = Od. 24.503 = 548, Od. 2.297, Od. 4.831, Od. 10.311, 481. 2 The faculty of speech: ἔχοντʼ ἐν στήθεσιν αὐδήν Il. 4.430. Cf. Il. 18.419. 3 A rumour or report: θεοῦ αὐδήν (sent abroad by a god) Od. 14.89. 4 Applied to sound produced by twitching a stretched bowstring Od. 21.411.

a)nqemo/eis.head: ἀνθεμόεις
a)nqemo/eis.html: ἀνθεμόεις -εντος [ἄνθος.] 1 Flowery: λειμῶνι Il. 2.467. Cf. Il. 2.695: Od. 12.159. 2 Adorned with flower-like ornaments Il. 23.885: Od. 3.440, Od. 24.275.

a)/n.head: ἄν1.
a)/n.html:
ἄν1. Conditional or limiting particle. (Cf. κεν.) For the uses with subj., opt. and fut., aor. and impf. indic. in protasis and apodosis see 6. 1 With subj.: τάχʼ ἂν θυμὸν ὀλέσσῃ Il. 1.205. Cf. Il. 18.192, Il. 22.505: ἐγὼ ἂν ξεῖνος ἔω Od. 9.17. Cf. Od. 4.240, Od. 11.328, 517, Od. 12.81. In Il. 22.50 (ἀπολυσόμεθα) : Od. 4.240, Od. 11.328, 517 (μυθήσομαι), Od. 6.221 (λοέσσομαι) may be aor. subj. or fut. indic. 2 With opt. in potential or fut. sense: τῶν οὐκ ἄν τι θέροις Il. 1.301. Cf. Il. 2.250 (conveying an order), Il. 3.52 (will you not . . .?), 66, Il. 5.32, 362, Il. 6.141, Il. 9.77, Il. 10.204, Il. 13.741, Il. 14.58, Il. 22.108, Il. 24.437, etc.: πῶς ἂν Ὀδυσῆος λαθοίμην; Od. 1.65. Cf. Od. 3.232, Od. 4.78, Od. 6.57, 300, Od. 10.573, Od. 20.135 (do not . . .), Od. 22.325, etc. 3 In potential sense in reference to the past in suppositions contrary to fact. a With impf. or aor. indic.: ἦ τʼ ἂν κέρδιον ἦεν Il. 5.201 = Il. 22.103, οὐκ ἂν θυμὸν ὤρινεν Il. 19.271. Cf. Il. 8.455, Il. 13.676, Il. 16.638: οὐκ ἂν τόσσʼ ἀγόρευες (would not have . . .) Od. 2.184. Cf. Od. 9.211, 228, 334. b With pres. or aor. opt.: ἦ ἄν ὕστατα λωβήσαιο Il. 1.232 = Il. 2.242. Cf. Il. 1.271, Il. 4.223, Il. 5.85 Il. 13.127: οὐκ ἄν ὀχλίσσειαν Od. 9.241. 4 With infin. in indirect discourse: καὶ δʼ ἂν τοῖς ἄλλοισιν ἔθη παραμυθήσασθαι Il. 9.684. 5 Joined with κεν. See κεν 5. 6 For uses in protasis with εἰ and in the corresponding relative sentences see Table at end II.B.a 3 subj., (D) (7) subj., (23) opt., III.B.a 3 subj., (D) (11) fut., (34) (35) (36) (37) (38) (43) (44) subj., (49) (65) opt. For uses in apodosis see II.C.a 3 aor. or impf. indic., (6) opt., c.2 opt., (D) (6) opt., (23) fut., (30) opt., (52) subj., (57) (63) opt. For ὅτʼ ἄν (not in protasis) see ὅτε 1.a.γ, b.α b.δ b.ε, 4. For ὄφρʼ ἅν (not in protasis) see ὄφρα 1.b, ὄφρα 1.c, 5.a b . For ὡς ἄν (not in protasis) see ὡς 7.a, b.β, 8.α 8.γ, b.γ.
ἄν2. See next.

a)po/fhmi.head: ἀπόφημι
a)po/fhmi.html: ἀπόφημι [ἀπο- 7 + φημί.] Imp. pl. mid. ἀπόθασθε Il. 9.422, 649. 1 To speak out, declare one's mind plainly Il. 7.362. 2 To deliver (a message) plainly. In mid. Il. 9.422, 649.

a)natre/xw.head: †ἀνατρέχω
a)natre/xw.html: †ἀνατρέχω [ἀνα- 1, ἀνα- 3.] 3 sing. aor. ἀνέδραμε Il. 11.354, Il. 16.813, Il. 17.297, Il. 18.56, 437. 3 pl. -ον Il. 23.717. 3 sing. pf. ἀναδέδρομε Od. 5.412, Od. 10.4. 1 To spirt up Il. 17.297. 2 To run up, shoot up (like a quickly growing plant) Il. 18.56 = 437. Of welts, to start up Il. 23.717. 3 To run, stretch, extend up: πέτρη Od. 5.412, Od. 10.4. 4 To run back, retire Il. 11.354, Il. 16.813.

a)popaptai/nw.head: †ἀποπαπταίνω
a)popaptai/nw.html: †ἀποπαπταίνω [ἀπο- 1.] 3 pl. fut. ἀποπαπτανέουσι. To look about away from something (i.e. away from the fight), look out for a chance of escape Il. 14.101.

a)ristero/s.head: ἀριστερός
a)ristero/s.html: ἀριστερός Locative ἀριστερόφιν Il. 13.309. 1 That is on the left side, the left . . .: ὦμον Il. 5.16, Il. 16.106, 478, Cf. Il. 5.660, Il. 11.321. The left hand . . .: ἵππος Il. 23.338. 2 ἐπʼ ἀριστερά. a To the left: νωμῆσαι βῶν Il. 7.238, εἴτʼ ἐπʼ ἀ. [ἴωσιν] (from right to left of a spectator, i.e. in the unlucky direction) Il. 12.240. To the left of. With genit.: νηῶν Il. 12.118. Cf. Il. 13.326, Il. 23.336. b On the left: θωρήσσοντο Il. 2.526, λαὸν ἐέργων Il. 12.201 = Il. 12.219 (the bird having its left to the line and passing along from the line's right to its left): Ψυρίην ἔχοντες Od. 3.171. Sim.: ἐπʼ ἀ. χειρός Od. 5.277. On the left of. With genit.: μάχης Il. 5.355, Il. 11.498, Il. 13.765, Il. 17.116 = 682, νηῶν Il. 13.675. With locative: ἐπʼ ἀριστερόφιν [παντὸς στρατοῦ] Il. 13.309. 3 Of a bird of omen, passing as in Il. 12.240 above, boding ill Od. 20.242.

a)nafe/rw.head: †ἀναφέρω
a)nafe/rw.html: †ἀναφέρω [ἀνα- 1.] Aor. ἀνένεικα Od. 11.625. 3 sing. aor. mid. ἀνενείκατο Il. 19.314. 1 To bring or fetch up Od. 11.625. 2 In mid., to fetch a sigh Il. 19.314.

a)/spermos.head: ἄσπερμος
a)/spermos.html: ἄσπερμος -ον [ἀ-1 + σπέρμα.] Without issue Il. 20.303.

a)lkth/r.head: ἀλκτήρ
a)lkth/r.html: ἀλκτήρ -ῆρος, ὁ [ἀλκ-, ἄλαλκον.] 1 A protector: ἀρῆς (against . . . ) Il. 14.485. Cf. Il. 18.100, 213. 2 A means of protection: κυνῶν Od. 14.531, Od. 21.340.

a)mfi/guos.head: ἀμφίγυος
a)mfi/guos.html: ἀμφίγυος [prob. as ἀμφιγυήεις.] Thus, of spears, (having a head) curved on each side, i.e. leafshaped; or perh., bending to either side, elastic Il. 13.147 = Il. 15.278 = Il. 17.731, Il. 14.26 = Il. 16.637, Il. 15.386, 712: Od. 16.474, Od. 24.527.

a)/or.head: ἄορ
a)/or.html: ἄορ -ορος, τό. Dat. ἄορι (ᾶ). Acc. pl. in masc. form ἄορας Od. 17.222. A sword Il. 10.484, 489, Il. 11.240, 265 = 541, Il. 14.385, Il. 16.115, 473, Il. 20.290, 378, 462, Il. 21.21, 173, 179, 208: Od. 8.403, Od. 10.321, 333, 439 = Od. 11.231, Od. 11.24, Od. 17.222, Od. 19.241.

a)fre/w.head: ἀφρέω
a)fre/w.html: ἀφρέω [ἀφρός.] To be covered with foam Il. 11.282.

a)kmh/.head: ἀκμή
a)kmh/.html: ἀκμή -ῆς, ἡ. An edge: ξυροῦ Il. 10.173.

a)/kros.head: ἄκρος
a)/kros.html: ἄκρος -η, -ον. Extreme, at the furthest point. 1 Topmost, the topmost part of: πόλει Il. 6.88 (the citadel), πρώονες Il. 8.557 = Il. 16.299. Cf. Il. 5.460, Il. 6.257, 297, 317, 512, Il. 7.345, Il. 8.83, Il. 9.241, Il. 11.351, Il. 12.282, Il. 13.523, 615, Il. 14.292, 352, Il. 15.152, Il. 22.383: σκοπέλοισιν Od. 12.239. 2 Outermost, the extremity of: πόδας Il. 16.640. Cf. Il. 17.264 (see ἠϊών 2), 309, 599, Il. 20.227: οἰήϊον Od. 9.483 = 540. The edge of: χείλει Il. 12.51. Growing on the extremity: τρίχες οὐραῖαι Il. 23.519. At the end of a row: νῆες Il. 15.653. The base or root of: χεῖρα Il. 5.336 (cf. 458). 3 The surface of: ὕδωρ Il. 16.162: ῥινόν Od. 22.278. App. in neut. ἄκρον as adv., on the surface: ἀ. ἐπὶ ῥηγμῖνος θέεσκον Il. 20.229 (v. l. ἀ. ἔπι, taking ἀ. as sb., the surface; see ἄκρον 4). 4 In superl. ἀκρότατος, -η, -ον (in Od. 12.11 of two terminations), much like the positive. a Topmost, the topmost part of: κορυφῇ Il. 1.499 = Il. 5.754 = Il. 8.3. Cf. Il. 2.793, Il. 6.470, Il. 13.12, Il. 14.157, 228, 285, Il. 15.536, Il. 20.52, Il. 22.172: τύμβῳ Od. 12.15. Absol.: ἐπʼ ἀκροράτῃ (at the top) Il. 4.484. b The extremity of: ὄζῳ Il. 2.312. Sim. ἀκρότατον παρʼ οὐδόν Od. 22.127 (app., to one side of (and passing at right angles) one of the extremities of the threshold). Predicatively: ὅθʼ ἀκρότατος πρόεχʼ ἀκτή (where the beach ran furthest out) Od. 12.11. c The surface of: χρόα Il. 4.139, χαλκόν Il. 7.246.

a)nidrwti/.head: ἀνιδρωτί
a)nidrwti/.html: ἀνιδρωτί [ἀ-1 + ἱδρώς.] Without sweat, i.e. without conflict: οὔ κεν ἀ. γε τελέσθη Il. 15.228.

a)nade/smh.head: ἀναδέσμη
a)nade/smh.html: ἀναδέσμη -ης, ἡ [ἀνα- 6 + δεσ-, δέω.] A woman's head-dress, app. in the form of a plaited band Il. 22.469.

a)ma/rh.head: ἀμάρη
a)ma/rh.html: ἀμάρη -ης, ἡ. An irrigation trench Il. 21.259.

a)nai/ssw.head: ἀναΐσσω
a)nai/ssw.html: ἀναΐσσω [ἀν-, ἀνα- 1.] 3 pl. aor. ἀνήϊξαν Il. 15.86, Il. 23.203: Od. 18.40, Od. 24.463. 3 sing. opt. ὰναΐξειε Il. 3.216. 3 pl. -ειαν Il. 4.114. Pple. ἀναΐξας, -αντος Il. 1.584, Il. 15.6, Il. 23.733, etc.: Od. 1.410, Od. 8.186, Od. 21.300, etc. Fem. ἀναΐξασα Od. 22.240. 1 To start, spring or dart up, rise quickly or suddenly: πάντες ἀνήϊξαν Il. 15.86, Il. 23.203. Cf. Il. 1.584, Il. 4.114, Il. 7.106, Il. 15.6, Il. 23.733, Il. 24.621: ἀναΐξας οἴχεται Od. 1.410. Cf. Od. 8.186, 361, Od. 9.288, Od. 13.197, Od. 18.40, Od. 19.31, Od. 21.119, 300, Od. 22.240, Od. 24.50, 463. 2 To rush or spring on to. With acc.: ἅρμα Il. 24.440. 3 Of springs, to gush forth Il. 22.148. 4 To rise to speak Il. 3.216 (the notion of quickness not here to be pressed).

a)poti/qhmi.head: ἀποτίθημι
a)poti/qhmi.html: ἀποτίθημι [ἀπο- 1.] 3 sing. aor. ἀπέθηκε Il. 16.254. Aor. subj. mid. ἀποθείουαι Il. 18.409. Infin. ἀποθέσθαι Il. 3.89, Il. 5.492. 1 To put away in the appropriate place Il. 16.254. In mid. Il. 18.409. 2 In mid. a To lay aside and place somewhere Il. 3.89. b To put away from oneself, avoid incurring: ἐνιπήν Il. 5.492.

a)pwqe/w.head: †ἀπωθέω
a)pwqe/w.html: †ἀπωθέω [ἀπ-, ἀπο- 1, ἀπο- 4.] Fut. ἀπώσω Od. 15.280. 3 sing. -ει Il. 1.97. Infin. -έμεν Il. 13.367. 3 sing. aor. ἀπέωσε Od. 9.81. ἀπῶσε Il. 17.649, Il. 24.446. 3 pl. ἀπῶσαν Il. 21.537. 1 pl. subj. ἀπώσομεν Il. 15.96: Od. 22.76. Infin. ἀπῶσαι Od. 2.130. Mid. 3 sing. aor. ἀπώσατο Il. 24.508: Od. 13.276. 2 sing. subj. ἀπώσεαι Od. 1.270. 3 sing. -εται Il. 8.533. Pple. ἀπωσάμενος, -ου Il. 12.276, Il. 16.301, Il. 18.13. Infin. ἀπώσασθαι Il. 8.206, Il. 15.407, 503, Il. 16.251: Od. 9.305. 1 To drive or thrust back. In mid.: Τρῶας ἀπώσασθαι Il. 8.206. Cf. Il. 8.533, Il. 15.407. To drive away, expel: ἐκ Τροίης Il. 13.367. In mid. Od. 1.270. To thrust back, ward or keep off. In mid.: νεῖκος Il. 12.276. Cf. Il. 18.13. In reference to driving away or dispersing immaterial or impalpable things: λοιγόν Il. 1.97, ὀμίχλην Il. 17.649. 2 With genit., to drive away from: γέροντος ἄγριον ἄνδρα Il. 8.96. Cf. Od. 22.76. To expel from: δόμων Od. 2.130. To thrust away or debar from: νηός Od. 15.280. To thrust aside from. In mid.: θυράων λίθον Od. 9.305. To ward or keep off from. In mid.: κακὰ νηῶν Il. 15.503. Cf. Il. 16.251, 301. 3 In mid., to push away from oneself Il. 24.508. 4 To drive out of one's course Od. 9.81. In mid. Od. 13.276. 5 To thrust back, unfasten: ὀχῆας Il. 21.537, Il. 24.446.

a)mfa/dios.head: ἀμφάδιος
a)mfa/dios.html: ἀμφάδιος [as ἀμφαδά.] 1 Open, public: γάμον Od. 6.288. 2 Adv. of acc. fem. form ἀμφαδίην = ἀμφαδά. Il. 7.196, Il. 13.356: Od. 5.120.

a)/drhstos.head: Ἄδρηστος-1
a)/drhstos.html:
Ἄδρηστος-1 King of Sicyon, and father of Aegialeia Il. 2.572 ; father also of the wife of Tydeus (Deipyle) Il. 14.121; his horse Arion Il. 23.347.
Ἄδρηστος-2 Son of Merops and with his brother Amphius-1 the leader of the men of Adresteia, etc. Il. 2.830; both killed by Diomedes Il. 11.328.
Ἄδρηστος-3 Trojan. Taken by Menelaus Il. 7.37, 45. Killed by Agamemnon Il. 7.63.
Ἄδρηστος-4 Trojan. killed by Patroclus Il. 16.694.

a)gkai=os.head: Ἀγκαῖος-1.
a)gkai=os.html:
Ἀγκαῖος-1. Father of Agapenor Il. 2.609.
Ἀγκαῖος-2 (Πλευρώνιος). Nestor beat him at wrestling Il. 23.635.

a)/gh.head: ἄγη1
a)/gh.html:
ἄγη1, ἡ [ἄγαμαι.] Wonder, amazement, confusion: ἄγη μʼ ἔχει Il. 21.221: Od. 3.227, Od. 16.243.
ἄγη2, 3 sing. aor. pass. ἄγνυμι.

ai)aki/dhs.head: Αἰακίδης
ai)aki/dhs.html: Αἰακίδης Patronymic from next. Of Peleus Il. 16.15 , Il. 18.433, Il. 21.189 . Of Achilles (grandson) Il. 2.860, Il. 9.184, Il. 10.402, Il. 11.805, Il. 16.134, Il. 17.76, etc. : Od. 11.471, 538.

a)mfiku/pellos.head: ἀμφικύπελλος
a)mfiku/pellos.html: ἀμφικύπελλος [ἀμφι- 2 + (perh.) *κυπέλη, handle, conn. with κώπη.] Two-handled: δέπας Il. 1.584, Il. 6.220, Il. 9.656, Il. 23.219, 656, 663, 667, 699: Od. 3.63, Od. 8.89, Od. 13.57, Od. 15.102, 120, Od. 22.86, δέπα Od. 20.153.

a)rtu/w.head: ἀρτύω
a)rtu/w.html: ἀρτύω [as ἀρτύνω.] (ἐπ-.) 1 To fashion, form Il. 18.379. 2 To make ready, prepare: γάμον Od. 4.771. 3 To plan, contrive: δόλον Od. 11.439. Cf. Od. 3.152, Od. 16.448, Od. 20.242.

a)khde/w.head: †ἀκηδέω
a)khde/w.html: †ἀκηδέω [ἀκηδής.] 2 sing. impf. ἀκήδεις Il. 23.70. 3 sing. aor. ἀκήδεσε Il. 14.427. To take no care for. With genit.: εὑ Il. 14.427, μευ Il. 23.70.

a)xeu/w.head: ἀχεύω
a)xeu/w.html: ἀχεύω [ἄχος.] To be grieved or troubled, grieve, sorrow. Only in pres. pple.: θυμὸν ἀχεύων (in his heart) Il. 5.869, Il. 18.461, Il. 23.566. Cf. Il. 9.612, Il. 24.128: Od. 2.23, Od. 4.100, Od. 11.88, Od. 21.318. With genit. of person grieved for: ἄνακτος Od. 14.40. Cf. Od. 16.139.

a)ka/khta.head: ἀκάκητα
a)ka/khta.html: ἀκάκητα [sense unknown. Traditionally explained as fr. ἀ-1+ κακός, the guileless, or fr. ἀκέομαι, the healer.] (Prob. orig. a voc. turned into a nom.) Epithet of Hermes Il. 16.185: Od. 24.10.

ai)te/w.head: αἰτέω
ai)te/w.html: αἰτέω (ἐπ-.) To ask for, request: ἵππους Il. 5.358. Cf. Il. 13.365, Il. 24.292: Od. 10.17, Od. 20.74. With acc. of the person from whom something is asked: ᾔτεέ με δεύτερον Od. 9.354, αἰτήσων φῶτα ἕκαστον (to ask alms from . . .) Od. 17.365. With infin., to ask to. . .: σῆμα ἰδέσθαι Il. 6.176. With acc. and infin.: ᾐτέομεν θεὸν φῆναι τέρας Od. 3.173. With double acc. of person and thing: ᾔτεέ μιν δόρυ Il. 22.295. Cf. Od. 2.387, Od. 24.85, 337. Absol., to ask alms Od. 18.49.

a)/maqos.head: ἄμαθος
a)/maqos.html: ἄμαθος [cf. ψάμαθος.] Loose or sandy soil Il. 5.587.

au)=os.head: αὖος
au)=os.html: αὖος -η, -ον [αὔω1.] 1 Dry, dried up Il. 23.327: Od. 5.240 (sapless), Od. 18.309. Made of well-dried hide Il. 12.137, Il. 17.493. 2 In neut. αὖον as adv., with a dry, i.e. a harsh or grating sound (cf. καρφαλέος 2): κόρυθες αὖον ἀΰτευν Il. 12.160. Cf. Il. 13.441.

a)/neuqe.head: ἄνευθε
a)/neuqe.html: ἄνευθε (-θεν) [ἄνευ.] 1 Adv. a Far away: ἀ. ἐών Il. 2.27 = 64 = Il. 24.174. Cf. Il. 4.277, Il. 22.300, Il. 23.452, 474. b Away, removed: πολλὸν ἀ. Il. 23.378. Cf. Od. 4.356, Od. 19.575. c Apart, aside, aloof: ἀ. ἔθηκεν Il. 22.368. Cf. Il. 23.241, Il. 24.208: Od. 9.26, Od. 11.82. 2 Prep. with genit. a Far from: πατρός Il. 21.78. b Away from: νῶϊν Il. 22.88. c Apart or aloof from: ἄλλων Il. 22.39. Cf. Od. 10.554. d Without, free from: πόνου Od. 7.192. e Without the help of: ἐμεῖο Il. 16.89. Cf. Il. 16.239. Without the good will or permission of: θεοῦ Il. 5.185. f App., in the background as regards, ready to take the place of: τοῖο ἀ. λελείμμην Il. 22.333.

a)xaii/s.head: Ἀχαιΐς
a)xaii/s.html: Ἀχαιΐς Fem. adj. (1) Achaean. Ἀχαιῒς γαῖα (αἶα) (Ἀχαιός 2.b (a)) Il. 1.254, Il. 7.124: Od. 13.249, Od. 21.107. Absol. (καλλιγύναιξ) Il. 3.75 , 258 (for these cf. under Ἄργος-1 (4)): Od. 11.166, 481, Od. 23.68. Apparently in particular of the realm of Peleus (πουλοβότειρα) Il. 11.770 . In pl., (the) Achaean women Il. 2.235, Il. 7.96. Apparently in particular of the maidens of the realm of Peleus Il. 9.395: of the realm of Odysseus Od. 21.251.

a)po/rqhtos.head: ἀπόρθητος
a)po/rqhtos.html: ἀπόρθητος -ον [ἀ-1 + πορθέω.] Not sacked Il. 12.11.

a)mixqalo/eis.head: ἀμιχθαλόεις
a)mixqalo/eis.html: ἀμιχθαλόεις -εσσα [prob. = ὀμιχθαλόεις fr. ὀμίχλη.] Thus, misty, steaming. Of Lemnos Il. 24.753. (Lemnos is not volcanic. The reference may be to some jet of natural gas which has now disappeared.)

a)kaxme/nos.head: ἀκαχμένος
a)kaxme/nos.html: ἀκαχμένος [a ppl. form fr. *ἀκή = ἀκωκή.] 1 Furnished with a sharp point: δούρατα Il. 12.444. Cf. Il. 17.412, Il. 21.72. With dat. expressing the material: ὀξέϊ χαλκῷ Il. 10.135 = Il. 14.12 = Il. 15.482: = Od. 1.99 = Od. 15.551 = Od. 20.127. 2 Furnished with a sharp (double) edge: πέλεκυν (φάσγανον) ἀμφοτέρωθεν ἀκαχμένον Od. 5.235, Od. 22.80.

a)pomhni/w.head: ἀπομηνίω
a)pomhni/w.html: ἀπομηνίω [ἀπο- 7.] To be very wroth, take deadly offence: ἀπομηνίσας Ἀγαμέμνονι (against. . .) Il. 2.772 = Il. 7.230. Cf. Il. 9.426, Il. 19.62: Od. 16.378.

a)riqme/w.head: ἀριθμέω
a)riqme/w.html: ἀριθμέω [ἀριθμός.] 1 To number, count, reckon up Il. 2.124: Od. 4.411, Od. 13.215, 218, Od. 16.235. 2 To number off: δίχα πάντας ἑταίρους Od. 10.204.

a)farpa/zw.head: †ἀφαρπάζω
a)farpa/zw.html: †ἀφαρπάζω [ἀφ-, ἀπο-n(1).] Aor. infin. ἀφαρπάξαι. To snatch from. With genit.: κόρυθα κρατός Il. 13.189.

a)/puros.head: ἄπυρος
a)/puros.html: ἄπυρος [ἀ-1 + πῦρ.] Not yet put on the fire, new: τρίποδας Il. 9.122 = 264, λέβητα Il. 23.267, 885.

a)ndreifo/nths.head: ἀνδρειφόντης
a)ndreifo/nths.html: ἀνδρειφόντης [prob. rather ἆδριφόντης, fr. ἀδρ-, ἀνδρ-, ἀνήρ + φον-, *φένω. Cf. ἀνδροτής.] Slayer of men. Epithet of Enyalius Il. 2.651, Il. 7.166 = Il. 8.264 = Il. 17.259.

a)no/leqros.head: ἀνόλεθρος
a)no/leqros.html: ἀνόλεθρος [ἀ-1 + ὄλεθρος.] Unscathed Il. 13.761.

a)lu/ssw.head: ἀλύσσω
a)lu/ssw.html: ἀλύσσω = ἀλύω: ἀλύσσοντες (maddened) Il. 22.70.

a)/leison.head: ἄλεισον
a)/leison.html: ἄλεισον τό. A drinking-cup (= δέπας) Il. 11.774, Il. 24.429: Od. 3.50, 53, Od. 4.591, Od. 8.430, Od. 15.85, 469, Od. 22.9.

a(/ma.head: ἅμα
a(/ma.html: ἅμα [σα-. Cf. ἀ-2, ἅπαξ, ἅπας, ἁπλοΐς, L. simul.] I Adv. 1 With, along with, a person or persons, in his or their company: ἁ. ἕποντο Il. 1.424, θέρει ἁ. παῖδα Il. 6.389. Cf. Il. 3.447, Il. 4.274, Il. 9.170, Il. 10.194, Il. 11.344, etc.: κήρυχʼ ἁ. ὀπάσσας Od. 9.90. Cf. Od. 2.287, 413, Od. 6.319, Od. 8.109, Od. 13.68, etc. 2 All or both together, in a body, without exception: πάντες ἁ. Il. 1.495, ταῦθʼ ἁ. χρὴ σπεύδειν (with united effort) Il. 13.235. Cf. Il. 1.533, Il. 6.59, Il. 8.8, Il. 15.718, Il. 18.50, etc.: ἁ. πλέομεν Od. 3.276. Cf. Od. 8.121, Od. 10.259, Od. 11.232, Od. 12.110, Od. 13.82, etc. In reference to things, all at once, without exception: ἁ. πάνθʼ ἑλέσθαι Il. 13.729. Cf. Il. 4.320. 3 At the same time: σκεψάμενος ἐς νῆʼ ἁ. καὶ μεθʼ ἑταίρους Od. 12.247. Cf. Od. 10.123, Od. 18.356. Together, at the same moment: ἁ. ἄμφω σύν ῥʼ ἔπεσον Il. 7.255. Cf. Il. 13.613, Il. 19.242, etc.: ὁμαρτήσαντες ἁ. ἄμφω Od. 8.188. In reference to something done while others are doing other things: τῇ ἁ. Ἀ. κλισίην ἔθηκεν, Ἀ. δὲ . . . Φ. δὲ . . . Od. 4.123. 4 At the same time, besides, too, also: ἁ. δʼ ἄλλʼ ἀποδάσσεσθαι Il. 22.117. Cf. Il. 24.304: Od. 19.376.–ἁ. . . . καὶ . . . , both . . . and . . . : ἁ. πρόσσω καὶ ὀπίσσω Il. 1.343. Cf. Il. 2.707, Il. 13.299, etc.: Od. 3.111, Od. 19.471, etc. So ἁ. . . . τε . . . καὶ . . . Od. 24.249.– ἁ. τε . . . τε Il. 13.669.– ἁ. τε . . . δὲ . . . Il. 9.519.– Other combinations in Il. 1.417, Il. 2.281, Il. 4.450, Il. 13.85, Il. 24.773, etc.: Od. 14.403. II Prep. with dat. (freq. following the case). 1 With, along with, in company with: ἁ. ἡγεμόνεσσιν Il. 3.1. Cf. Il. 1.158, 226, 251, Il. 2.249, 524, etc.: τῷ ἁ. πομπὸν ἕπεσθαι Od. 4.162. Cf. Od. 1.98, 331, 428, Od. 2.11, Od. 3.359, etc. 2 At the same time with, at the time of: ἁ. ἠελίῳ καταδύντι Il. 1.592. Cf. Il. 7.331, Il. 9.618, Il. 11.685, Il. 18.136, Il. 24.600, etc.: ἁ. ἠοῖ Od. 4.407. Cf. Od. 6.31, Od. 12.24, Od. 14.266, Od. 16.2, Od. 23.362, etc.

a)ersi/pous.head: ἀερσίπους
a)ersi/pous.html: ἀερσίπους -ποδος [ἀερ-, ἀείρω + -σι- + πούς.] Lifting the feet, high-stepping. Epithet of horses: Il. 3.327, Il. 23.475. Applied to ἵπποι in sense chariot (see ἵππος 3) Il. 18.532.

a)postado/n.head: ἀποσταδόν
a)postado/n.html: ἀποσταδόν [ἀπο- 2 + στα-, ἵστημι] = ἀποσταδά: μάρνασθαι Il. 15.556.

a)eikh/s.head: ἀεικής
a)eikh/s.html: ἀεικής -ές (ἀϝεικής) [ἀ-1 + (ϝ)είκω1.] Dat. pl. ἀεικέσσι Il. 2.264. 1 Unseemly, not right or fitting Il. 11.142, Il. 22.395 = Il. 23.24: Od. 3.265, Od. 4.694, Od. 11.429, Od. 15.236, Od. 16.107 = Od. 20.317, Od. 23.222. Absol.: ἀεικέα μερμηρίζων Od. 4.533. Cf. Od. 20.394, Od. 22.432. In neut. in impers. construction : οὔ τοι ἀεικές [ἐστιν] Il. 9.70. So with infin.: οὔ οἱ ἀεικὲς ἀνασσέμεν Il. 19.124. Cf. Il. 15.496. 2 Inadequate in amount or value Il. 12.435, Il. 24.594. 3 Shabby, worn: πήρην Od. 13.437, Od. 17.197 = Od. 18.108. Absol. : ἀεικέα ἕσσο (ἕσσαι) Od. 16.199, Od. 24.250. 4 Of one's fate, hard, grievous Il. 4.396: Od. 2.250, Od. 4.339 = Od. 17.130, Od. 4.340 = Od. 17.131, Od. 19.550, Od. 22.317 = 416. 5 Baneful, baleful Il. 1.97, 341, 398, 456, Il. 9.495, Il. 14.13, Il. 16.32. Horrid, horrifying : στόνος Il. 10.483, Il. 21.20: Od. 22.308, Od. 24.184. 6 Involving disgrace or degradation: πληγῆσιν Il. 2.264, ἔργον Il. 19.133, Il. 24.733. 7 Of the mind, not giving right guidance Od. 20.366. 8 In neut. ἀεικές as adv., in unseemly wise Od. 17.216.

a)postufeli/zw.head: †ἀποστυφελίζω
a)postufeli/zw.html: †ἀποστυφελίζω [ἀπο- 1, ἀπο- 4.] 3 sing. aor. ἀπεστυθέλιξε Il. 16.703. 3 pl. -αν Il. 18.158. To smite so as to drive back Il. 16.703. So as to drive away from. With genit.: νεκροῦ Il. 18.158.

a)/rrhktos.head: ἄρρηκτος
a)/rrhktos.html: ἄρρηκτος -ον [ἀ-1 + ῥηκ-, ῥήγνυμι.] 1 Not to be broken, broken through or severed Il. 13.37, 360, Il. 14.56 = 68, Il. 15.20: Od. 8.275, Od. 10.4. 2 Not to be broken into: πόλις Il. 21.447. 3 Not to be dispersed: νεφέλην Il. 20.150. 4 Of the voice, tireless (cf. ἀτειρής 2, χαλκεόφωνος) Il. 2.490.

au)to/fonos.head: Αὐτόφονος
au)to/fonos.html: Αὐτόφονος Father of Polyphontes Il. 4.395.

a)kh/ratos.head: ἀκήρατος
a)kh/ratos.html: ἀκήρατος [app. = ἀκήριος1.] 1 Unharmed, intact Il. 15.498: Od. 17.532. 2 Pure, undefiled: ὕδωρ Il. 24.303 (cf. ἀκηράσιος.).

a)trei/wn.head: Ἀτρεΐων
a)trei/wn.html: Ἀτρεΐων Patronymic from next, = prec. Of Agamemnon Il. 1.387, Il. 2.192, 445 , Il. 23.233, Il. 24.395 .

a)/xqos.head: ἄχθος
a)/xqos.html: ἄχθος τό. 1 A weight, burden, load: ἀ. ἀρούρης (cumbering the earth) Il. 18.104. Cf. Il. 12.452: Od. 20.379. A weight or load carried: ἀ. ὕλης Od. 9.233. 2 The lading or cargo of a ship Il. 20.247: Od. 3.312.

a)gxe/maxos.head: ἀγχέμαχος
a)gxe/maxos.html: ἀγχέμαχος [ἄγχι + μάχομαι.] Fighting at close quarters or hand to hand Il. 13.5, Il. 16.248, 272, Il. 17.165.

a)/gxistos.head: ἄγχιστος
a)/gxistos.html: ἄγχιστος [superl. fr. ἄγχι.] 1 In neut. ἄγχιστον as adv., nearest. With dat.: ἀ. αὐτῷ Od. 5.280. 2 So in pl. ἄγχιστα a Most nearly Il. 20.18 (see δαίω1 2). b With regard to resemblance, most closely, very closely. With dat.: Νέστορι ἀ. ἐῴκει Il. 2.58. Cf. Il. 14.474: Od. 6.152, Od. 13.80.

a)qh=nai.head: Ἀθῆναι
a)qh=nai.html: Ἀθῆναι also Ἀθήνη-1Od. 7.80 (ἐϋκτίμενον πτολίεθρον, εὐρυάγυια, ἱεραί, δῆμος Ἐρεχθῆος) Athens Il. 2.546, 549: Od. 3.278, 307, Od. 7.80, Od. 11.323.

a(rmatophgo/s.head: ἁρματοπηγός
a(rmatophgo/s.html: ἁρματοπηγός [ἁρματ-, ἅρμα + πήγνυμι.] That makes chariots. With ἀνήρ, a chariot-maker Il. 4.485.

a)ndro/meos.head: ἀνδρόμεος
a)ndro/meos.html: ἀνδρόμεος [ἀνδρ-, ἀνήρ.] Of man, human Il. 11.538 (the throng of men), Il. 17.571, Il. 20.100, Il. 21.70: Od. 9.297 (of man's flesh), Od. 9.347, Od. 9.374, Od. 22.19.

au)lo/s.head: αὐλός
au)lo/s.html: αὐλός -οῦ, ὁ. 1 A wind-instrument resembling a flute or clarionet: αὐλῶν συρίγγων τʼ ἐνοπήν (app. (to avoid asyndeton) to be rendered flute-pipes, taking αὐλῶν συρίγγων as virtually a compound word) Il. 10.13, αὐλοὶ φόρμιγγές τε Il. 18.495. 2 Applied (app. from resemblance to a tube) to a jet or column of blood Od. 22.18. 3 A hollow or socket in a spear-head to receive the end of the shaft Il. 17.297. 4 A tube or sheath to receive a pin of a περόνη Od. 19.227 ( = the κληῗδες of Od. 18.294: see κληΐς 5).

a(pa/nth|.head: ἁπάντῃ
a(pa/nth|.html: ἁπάντῃ [ἅπας.] In all directions: φέρων ἀνʼ ὅμιλον ἁ. Il. 7.183, 186: χέε δέσμαθʼ ἁ. Od. 8.278.

a)risteu/w.head: ἀριστεύω
a)risteu/w.html: ἀριστεύω [ἀριστεύς.] 3 sing. pa. iterative ἀριστεύεσκε Il. 6.460, Il. 11.627, 746, Il. 16.292, 551, Il. 17.351. 1 To be best, excel, take the lead Il. 6.208 = Il. 11.784, Il. 11.409: Od. 4.652. With complementary infin.: μάχεσθαι Il. 6.460, Il. 11.746, Il. 16.292, 551, Il. 17.351. 2 To excel (others in something). With genit. and dat.: βουλῇ ἁπάντων Il. 11.627. 3 To perform feats, do deeds of valour Il. 7.90, Il. 11.506, Il. 15.460.

a)/lfiton.head: ἄλφιτον
a)/lfiton.html: ἄλφιτον -ου, τό. Barley (i.e. the prepared corn): ἀλθίτου ἀκτήν (barley-meal) Il. 11.631. Cf. Od. 2.355, Od. 14.429. In pl.: ἄλθιτα λευκά Il. 11.640. Cf. Il. 18.560: Od. 2.290, 354, 380, Od. 10.234, 520, Od. 11.28, Od. 14.77, Od. 19.197, Od. 20.108, 119.

a)ke/wn.head: ἀκέων
a)ke/wn.html: ἀκέων -ουσα [a ppl. form conn. with ἀκήν.] 1 In silence, without speech: βῆ ἀ. Il. 1.34. Cf. Il. 1.512, 565, 569, Il. 10.85: Od. 9.427, Od. 10.52, Od. 11.142, Od. 14.110, Od. 17.465 = 491 = Od. 20.184, Od. 20.385. Indeclinable: ἀκέων δαίνυσθε Od. 21.89. Undistracted by speech of others: δαίνυσθαι ἀκέοντε Od. 14.195. Cf. Od. 2.311. 2 Silent (indeclinable): Ἀθηναίη ἀκέων ἦν Il. 4.22 = Il. 8.459.

a)rh/ios.head: ἀρήϊος
a)rh/ios.html: ἀρήϊος [Ἄρης.] 1 Inspired by Ares, warlike, martial Il. 2.698, Il. 3.339, Il. 4.114, Il. 11.501, Il. 12.102, etc.: Od. 3.109, 167, Od. 23.220. 2 Used in war, warlike: τεύχεα Il. 6.340. Cf. Il. 10.407, Il. 14.381: Od. 16.284, Od. 19.4, Od. 23.368, Od. 24.219.

a)mfipota/omai.head: ἀμφιποτάομαι
a)mfipota/omai.html: ἀμφιποτάομαι [ἀμφι- 3.] To fly round and round Il. 2.315.

au)tou=.head: αὐτοῦ
au)tou=.html: αὐτοῦ [αὐτός.] 1 In the same place, where one is or finds oneself: αὐ. ἔμειναν Il. 15.656. Cf. Il. 9.634, Il. 18.488, etc.: ἔσχετʼ αὐ. νηῦς Od. 12.204. Cf. Od. 5.274, Od. 11.152, etc. 2 On that spot, there: τὸν δεʼ λίπʼ αὐ. Il. 1.428. Cf. Il. 4.292, Il. 5.886, Il. 6.192, Il. 8.207, etc.: αὐ. ἰχθυάᾳ Od. 12.95. Cf. Od. 3.397, Od. 4.639, Od. 5.68, Od. 9.194, etc. 3 Here: αὐ. ἐνὶ Τροίῃ Il. 2.237. Cf. Il. 2.332, Il. 5.262, Il. 13.751, Il. 18.330, etc.: αὐ. τῷδʼ ἐνὶ δήμῳ Od. 2.317. Cf. Od. 3.427, Od. 5.362, Od. 10.266, Od. 11.332, etc. 4 On the spot, at once: αὐ. οἱ θάνατον μητίσομαι Il. 15.349. Cf. Il. 16.649, Il. 17.416, Il. 21.114, etc.: αὐ. κε πότμον ἐπίσποι Od. 2.250. Cf. Od. 4.703, Od. 9.303, Od. 18.212, etc.

a)peilh/.head: ἀπειλή
a)peilh/.html: ἀπειλή -ῆς, ἡ. In pl. 1 Boasts, vaunts Il. 9.244, Il. 14.479. With fut. infin.: πολεμίξειν Il. 20.83. 2 Threats, menaces Il. 13.219, Il. 16.200: Od. 13.126.

a)kessameno/s.head: Ἀκεσσαμενός
a)kessameno/s.html: Ἀκεσσαμενός Father of Periboea-1 Il. 21.142.

a)ge/lh.head: ἀγέλη
a)ge/lh.html: ἀγέλη -ης, ἡ. Locative ἀγέληφι Il. 2.480, Il. 16.487. A herd. Of oxen: βοῦς ἀγέληφι (in the herd) Il. 2.480. Cf. Il. 11.678, 696, Il. 15.323, Il. 16.487, Il. 17.62, Il. 18.528, 573: Od. 12.129, 299, Od. 14.100. Of horses Il. 19.281.

a)pexqai/rw.head: ἀπεχθαίρω
a)pexqai/rw.html: ἀπεχθαίρω [ἀπ-, ἀπο- 7.] Aor. subj. ἀπεχθήρω Il. 3.415. 1 To hate, detest Il. 3.415. 2 To make hateful Od. 4.105.

a)khdh/s.head: ἀκηδής
a)khdh/s.html: ἀκηδής -ές [ἀ-1 + κῆδος.] 1 Paying no funeral rites Il. 21.123. 2 Not honoured with such rites Il. 24.554: Od. 24.187. 3 Careless, neglectful Od. 17.319. 4 Neglected Od. 6.26, Od. 19.18, Od. 20.130. 5 Vexed by no cares Il. 24.526.

a)rhto/s.head: ἀρητός
a)rhto/s.html: ἀρητός [ἀράομαι.] App., prayed against; hence, accursed: γόον Il. 17.37 = Il. 24.741 (v.l. ἄρρητον).

ai)/sulos.head: αἴσυλος
ai)/sulos.html: αἴσυλος [prob. contr. fr. ἀ(ϝ)ίσυλος, ἀήσυλος.] Absol. in neut. pl. αἴσυλα, what is unjust, unseemly, or evil: αἰ. ῥέζων Il. 5.403. Cf. Il. 20.202 = 433, Il. 21.214: Od. 2.232 = Od. 5.10.

a)/mfios.head: Ἄμφιος-1
a)/mfios.html:
Ἄμφιος-1 (λινοθώρηξ). See Ἄδρηστος-2.
Ἄμφιος-2 Trojan. Son of Selagus. Killed by Aias-1 Il. 5.612.

a)gakleh/s.head: ἀγακλεής
a)gakleh/s.html: ἀγακλεής -ές [ἀγα- + κλέος.] Genit. ἀγακλῆος (for ἀγακλεέος) Il. 16.738, Il. 23.529. Very famous, glorious, splendid, worthy Il. 16.738, Il. 17.716, Il. 21.379 Il. 23.529.

a)mfi/drufos.head: ἀμφίδρυφος
a)mfi/drufos.html: ἀμφίδρυφος -ον [as ἀμφιδρυφής.] Both torn in mourning: παρειαί Il. 11.393.

a)ne/rxomai.head: ἀνέρχομαι
a)ne/rxomai.html: ἀνέρχομαι [ἀν-, ἀνα- 1, ἀνα- 3.] 3 sing. aor. ἀνήλυθε Od. 6.167. Pple. ἀνελθών Od. 10.97, 148, 194, Od. 19.190. 1 To go up Od. 10.97 = 148, 194. To go up (to a city): ἄστυδε Od. 19.190. –Of a plant, to shoot up Od. 6.163, 167. 2 To come back, return Il. 4.392, Il. 6.187: Od. 1.317.

a)/koitis.head: ἄκοιτις
a)/koitis.html: ἄκοιτις ἡ [as ἀκοίτης.] Acc. pl. ἀκοίτις Od. 10.7. A wife, one's wife Il. 3.138, 447, Il. 6.350, 374, Il. 9.397, 399, 450, Il. 14.268, 353, Il. 18.87, Il. 24.537: Od. 1.39, Od. 3.268, Od. 7.66, Od. 10.7, Od. 11.266, 452, Od. 13.42, Od. 18.144, Od. 21.316, 325, Od. 24.193, 459.

a)krito/fullos.head: ἀκριτόφυλλος
a)krito/fullos.html: ἀκριτόφυλλος [ἄκριτος + φύλλον.] With confused or massed foliage: ὄρος Il. 2.868 (i.e. the separate trees are indistinguishable).

a)/rgufos.head: ἄργυφος
a)/rgufos.html: ἄργυφος [ἀργός.] White: ὄϊν Il. 24.621: μῆλα Od. 10.85.

a)/qaptos.head: ἄθαπτος
a)/qaptos.html: ἄθαπτος [ἀ- + θάπτω.] Not honoured with funeral rites: νέκυς Il. 22.386: σῶμα Od. 11.54, Ἐλπήνορα 72.

a)ge/laos.head: Ἀγέλαος-1
a)ge/laos.html:
Ἀγέλαος-1 Trojan. Patronymic Φραδμονίδης . Killed by Diomedes Il. 8.257.
Ἀγέλαος-2 Greek. Killed by Hector Il. 11.302.
Ἀγέλαος-3 Ἀγέλεως, Od. 22.131, 247 (διοτρεφής). Patronymic Δαμαστορίδης-2 A suitor. Counsels the suitors to abstain from violence Od. 13.321, 339; in the fight advises communication with the people outside Od. 22.131, 136; Od. 22.212 , 241, 247. Killed by Odysseus Od. 22.293, 327.

a)/ristos.head: ἄριστος
a)/ristos.html: ἄριστος -η, -ον [superl. fr. ἀρ-, ἀρετή. Cf. ἀρείων.] Crasis with ὁ gives ὤριστος Il. 11.288, Il. 13.154, 433, Il. 16.521, Il. 17.689, Il. 19.413, Il. 23.536, Il. 24.384: Od. 17.416. 1 The most warlike or soldierly Il. 2.577, 817, Il. 6.188, Il. 8.229: Od. 4.530, Od. 11.500. Absol. Od. 24.507. 2 The best, the best fitted to take the lead in war or peace, pre-eminent: ἀ. Ἀχαιῶν Il. 1.91. Cf. Il. 2.768, Il. 5.541, Il. 7.50, Il. 11.328 (in their local community), Il. 18.230, Il. 24.255, etc.: Od. 2.51, Od. 3.108, Od. 4.629 = Od. 21.187, Od. 6.257, Od. 15.521, Od. 16.251, Od. 22.29, 244, Od. 23.121, Od. 24.38, 108. Absol. (in pl., pre-eminent or leading men, chiefs): ἄριστον Ἀχαιῶν Il. 1.244, πάντας ἀρίστους Il. 3.19. Cf. Il. 3.250, Il. 4.260, Il. 5.103, Il. 13.836, etc.: Od. 1.211, 245 = Od. 16.122 = Od. 19.130, Od. 4.272, 278, Od. 8.78, 91, 108, 127, 512, Od. 11.524, Od. 17.416, Od. 24.429. 3 The strongest or most powerful: κάρτεΐ τε σθένεΐ τε ἀ. Il. 15.108. Cf. Il. 12.447, Il. 23.891: Od. 3.370. 4 The highest in rank, dignity or power. Absol.: θεῶν ὤριστος Il. 13.154. Cf. Il. 14.213, Il. 18.364, Il. 19.258, 413, Il. 20.122, Il. 23.43: Od. 13.142, Od. 19.303. 5 In reference to mental powers, excelling all Il. 19.95. Excelling in person or accomplishments: κούρας Il. 9.638. In reference to one's person, best, excelling: εἶδος ἀρίστη (in . . .) Il. 2.715. Cf. Il. 3.39 = Il. 13.769, Il. 3.124, Il. 6.252, Il. 13.365, 378, Il. 17.142: Od. 7.57, Od. 8.116, Od. 11.469 = Od. 24.17. 6 Likely to prove the most suitable husband, the best match Od. 11.179, Od. 16.76, Od. 18.289, Od. 20.335, etc. 7 The most suitable for some purpose: φῶτας Od. 4.778, χῶρος Od. 5.442, Od. 7.281. Cf. Od. 4.409, Od. 8.36, Od. 9.195, Od. 15.25. Absol. Od. 4.666. 8 The most skilful, versed or efficient: τέκτονες Il. 6.314, βουλῇ (in . . . .) Il. 9.54. Cf. Il. 9.575, Il. 13.313, Il. 22.254, Il. 23.357, 536, 659 = 802, Il. 23.669: νηυσίν (in the management of . . .) Od. 8.247. Cf. Od. 4.211, Od. 8.250, 383, Od. 13.297, Od. 15.253, Od. 16.419. Absol. Il. 1.69, Il. 6.76, Il. 7.221, Il. 23.483, Il. 24.261. With complementary infin.: μάχεσθαί τε φρονέειν τε Il. 6.78. Cf. Od. 7.327, Od. 8.123. 9 Of things or abstractions, the best of their kind, the most excellent, useful or helpful: βουλή Il. 2.5 = Il. 10.17 = Il. 14.161, Il. 7.325 = Il. 9.94. Cf. Il. 2.274, Il. 9.74, Il. 12.243, 344 = 357, Il. 14.371, Il. 15.616, Il. 17.634, 712: νηῦς Od. 1.280, Od. 2.294, Od. 16.348. Cf. Od. 7.327, Od. 8.424, Od. 9.318 = 424 = Od. 11.230, Od. 23.124, Od. 24.52. 10 Of animals, the best, the finest, swiftest, etc. Il. 2.763, Il. 10.306, Il. 17.62: Od. 10.522 = Od. 11.30, Od. 14.106, Od. 18.371, Od. 20.163, Od. 24.215. Absol. Il. 5.266: Od. 9.432, Od. 12.343, 353, 398, Od. 14.19, 108, 414. 11 In neut. ἄριστον as adv., best, the best: δοκέει μοι εἶναι ἀ. Od. 5.360. So in neut. pl. ἄριστα: ὥς μοι δοκεῖ εἶναι ἀ. Il. 9.103 = 314 = Il. 13.735, Il. 12.215: Od. 23.130. Cf. Od. 13.154. 12 In neut. pl., the best results or consequences: ὅπως ἀ. γένηται Il. 3.110. Cf. Od. 3.129, Od. 9.420, Od. 13.365, Od. 23.117. The most seemly or decent things Il. 6.56.

a)napau/w.head: ἀναπαύω
a)napau/w.html: ἀναπαύω [ἀνα- 6.] To cause to cease: ἔργων ἀνθρώπους ἀνέπαυσεν (from . . .) Il. 17.550.

a)gw/n.head: ἀγών
a)gw/n.html: ἀγών -ῶνος, ὁ. 1 An assembly. a θεῖον ἀγῶνα (the assemblage of the gods supposed to meet together to receive their worshippers) Il. 7.298, Il. 18.376. b An assembly brought together to view contests Il. 23.258, Il. 24.1. c App., the body of competitors: παντὸς ἀγῶνος ὑπέρβαλεν Il. 23.847. 2 A place for contests: τάδʼ ἄεθλα κεῖτʼ ἐν ἀγῶνι Il. 23.273. Cf. Il. 23.451, 495, 507, 617, 696, etc. : εὔρυναν ἀγῶνα Od. 8.260. Cf. Od. 8.200, 238, 259, 380, Od. 24.86. 3 In reference to the Greek ships drawn up on the beach: νεῶν (νηῶν) ἐν ἀγῶνι (in the gathering-place of the ships, i.e. the camp) Il. 15.428 = Il. 16.500, Il. 16.239, Il. 19.42. So μετʼ ἀγῶνα νεῶν Il. 20.33.

a)perwe/w.head: ἀπερωέω
a)perwe/w.html: ἀπερωέω [ἀπ-, ἀπο- 1 + ἐρωέω1.] To hold back from, fail to take one's part in. With genit.: πολέμου Il. 16.723.

a)nade/rkomai.head: †ἀναδέρκομαι
a)nade/rkomai.html: †ἀναδέρκομαι [ἀνα- 1.] 3 sing. aor. ἀνέδρακε. To look up Il. 14.436.

a)gge/llw.head: ἀγγέλλω
a)gge/llw.html: ἀγγέλλω [ἄγγελος.] 3 pl. fut. ἀγγελέουσι Il. 9.617. Pple. ἀγγελέων, -οντος Il. 17.701: Od. 4.24, 528, 679. Fem. ἀγγελέουσα, -ης Il. 8.398, Il. 11.185, Il. 19.120, Il. 24.77, etc.: Od. 18.186, Od. 22.434, 496. 3 sing. aor. ἤγγειλε Il. 22.439: Od. 23.22. 3 pl. subj. ἀγγείλωσι Od. 16.350. Opt. ἀγγείλαιμι Od. 14.120. 3 sing. ἀγγείλειε Od. 6.50, Od. 15.458. Imp. ἄγγειλον Il. 24.145. Pple. ἀγγείλας Il. 10.448: Od. 16.150. Infin. ἀγγεῖλαι Il. 15.159. (ἀπ-, ἐξ-, ἐπ-.) 1 To bear a message or order, make an announcement or communication Il. 8.398, 409, Il. 9.617, Il. 11.185, Il. 19.120, Il. 24.77 = 159: Od. 16.150. With dat.: ποιμένι λαῶν Od. 4.24, 528. Cf. Od. 4.679, Od. 6.50, Od. 15.458, Od. 18.186 = Od. 22.434 = 496. With dat. and complementary infin.: Πριάμῳ λύσασθαι Il. 24.145: κείνοις οἶκόνδε νέεσθαι Od. 16.350. Without dat.: λέξασθαι Il. 8.517. Sim. with dat. and ὅττι Il. 22.439. 2 To announce, communicate Il. 10.448, Il. 15.159, Il. 17.701: Od. 23.22. To give news of Od. 14.120, 123. To herald Od. 13.94.

a)ska/lafos.head: Ἀσκάλαφος
a)ska/lafos.html: Ἀσκάλαφος Son of Ares and Astyoche. A leader of the men of Orchomenus-1, etc. Il. 2.512, Il. 9.82, Il. 13.478. Killed by Deiphobus Il. 13.518, 526, 527, Il. 15.112.

a(/llomai.head: †ἅλλομαι
a(/llomai.html: †ἅλλομαι [σαλ-. Cf. L. salio.] 2 sing. aor. ἆλσο Il. 16.754. 3 sing. ἆλτο Il. 1.532, Il. 3.29, Il. 4.125, Il. 5.111, Il. 13.611, Il. 20.62, Il. 24.469, etc.: Od. 21.388, Od. 22.2, 80. 3 sing. subj. ἅληται Il. 21.536. ἅλεται Il. 11.192, 207. (ἀνεφ-, ἐκκατεφ-, ἐξ-, ἐσ-, ἐφ-, καθ-, κατεφ-, μεθ-, ὑπερ-.) To leap, spring, bound: εἰς ἅλα Il. 1.532, χαμᾶζε Il. 3.29 = Il. 5.494 = Il. 6.103 = Il. 12.81 = Il. 13.749, Il. 4.419 = Il. 16.426, Il. 5.111, Il. 11.211, Il. 16.733, 755, Il. 24.469. Cf. Il. 11.192, 207, Il. 12.390, 611, Il. 16.754, Il. 18.616, Il. 20.62, 353, Il. 21.174, 536, Il. 24.572: θύραζε Od. 21.388. Cf. Od. 22.2, 80. Of an inanimate object: ἆλτʼ ὀϊστός Il. 4.125.

a)mei/nwn.head: ἀμείνων
a)mei/nwn.html: ἀμείνων -ονος. Neut. ἄμεινον. Acc. sing. masc. and fem. ἀμείνω Il. 3.11, Il. 4.400, Il. 9.423. Neut. pl. ἀμείνω Od. 7.310, Od. 15.71. Used as comp. of ἀγαθός or ἐσθλός. 1 More warlike, soldierly, or skilful in fight Il. 2.239, Il. 4.405, Il. 5.173, 411, Il. 6.479, Il. 7.111, 114, Il. 15.641, Il. 16.709, Il. 21.107, Il. 22.158, 333: Od. 18.334. So βίην ἀ. Il. 1.404, Il. 15.139.– βιῃ ἀ. Il. 11.787. 2 Better, more worthy, serviceable or skilful: ἀγορῇ Il. 4.400. Cf. Il. 6.350, Il. 18.106, Il. 23.315, 479, 605 (your betters): Od. 2.180, Od. 7.51, Od. 22.156. In reference to personal appearance Od. 24.374. Of horses Il. 10.556. 3 Of things or abstractions, better of their kind, better, more excellent, helpful or in place: ὀμίχλην νυκτὸς ἀμείνω Il. 3.11. Cf. Il. 1.116, Il. 7.358 = Il. 12.232, Il. 9.104, 256, 423, Il. 12.412, Il. 14.107, Il. 15.509: ἀμείνω αἴσιμα πάντα Od. 7.310, Od. 15.71. Cf. Od. 1.376 = Od. 2.141, Od. 5.364, Od. 14.466, Od. 22.374. Impers. with infin.: πείθεσθαι ἄμεινόν [ἐστιν] Il. 1.274. Cf. Il. 11.469: Od. 22.104. Sim.: ὧς γὰρ ἄμεινον Il. 1.217. 4 Good rather than ill: οὔ οἱ τό γʼ ἄμεινον Il. 24.52.

ai)oli/dhs.head: Αἰολίδης
ai)oli/dhs.html: Αἰολίδης Patronymic from Αἴολος (no doubt different from the Aeolus below; but the Aeolus legends can hardly be disentangled). Of Sisyphus Il. 6.154 . Of Cretheus Od. 11.237.

a)/timos.head: ἄτιμος
a)/timos.html: ἄτιμος [ἀ-1 + τιμή.] 1 Held in no respect, regard or esteem Il. 1.171. In comp.: ἀτιμότερόν με θήσεις Il. 16.90. In superl.: ἀτιμοτάτη θεός Il. 1.516. 2 In neut. ἄτιμον as adv., without making recompense Od. 16.431.

a)i/sqw.head: ἀΐσθω
a)i/sqw.html: ἀΐσθω [cf. ἄημι, ἀΐω2.] To breathe or gasp out: θυμόν Il. 16.468, Il. 20.403.

a)rh/nh.head: Ἀρήνη
a)rh/nh.html: Ἀρήνη (ᾱ) (ἐρατεινή). A town of Pylus Il. 2.591 , Il. 11.723.

a)te/lestos.head: ἀτέλεστος
a)te/lestos.html: ἀτέλεστος -ον [ἀ-1 + τελεσ-, τελέω.] 1 Not accomplished or performed: τὰ ἔσσεται οὐκ ἀτέλεστα Il. 4.168. Cf. Od. 2.273, Od. 8.571, Od. 18.345. 2 To no end, resulting in nothing: πόνον Il. 4.26, 57. 3 In neut. ἀτέλεστον as adv., endlessly, continually Od. 16.111.

au)tome/dwn.head: Αὐτομέδων
au)tome/dwn.html: Αὐτομέδων (ἄλκιμος, δουρικλυτός ). Son of Diores-2. θεράπων of Achilles Il. 9.209, Il. 16.864; acts as chariot-driver to Patroclus Il. 16.145, 148, 219, 472, 684; after Patroclus 's death drives alone Il. 17.429, 452, 459; takes up Alcimedon Il. 17.468, 469, 474; stands up to Hector and Aeneas Il. 17.483, 498; kills Aretus-1 Il. 17.516, 536; escapes Hector Il. 17.525; retires Il. 17.540; acts as chariot-driver to Achilles Il. 19.392, 397; Il. 23.563, Il. 24.474, 574, 625.

ai)zho/s.head: αἰζηός
ai)zho/s.html: αἰζηός In full bodily strength, lusty, vigorous Il. 16.716, Il. 23.432. Absol. in pl., such men, young men: διοτρεφέων αἰζηῶν Il. 2.660. Cf. Il. 3.26, Il. 4.280, Il. 5.92, Il. 8.298, Il. 10.259, Il. 11.414, Il. 14.4, Il. 15.66, 315, Il. 17.282, Il. 18.581, Il. 20.167, Il. 21.146, 301 : Od. 12.440.

a)popi/ptw.head: ἀποπίπτω
a)popi/ptw.html: ἀποπίπτω [ἀπο- 1.] 3 sing. aor. subj. ἀποπέσῃσι Od. 24.7. To fall or drop off: ἔερσαι Il. 14.351. To fall or drop off from. With genit.: ὁρμαθοῦ Od. 24.7.

a)paei/rw.head: ἀπαείρω
a)paei/rw.html: ἀπαείρω [ἀπ-, ἀπο- 1.] In pass., to take oneself off from. With genit.: πόλιος Il. 21.563.

a)ria/dnh.head: Ἀριάδνη
a)ria/dnh.html: Ἀριάδνη (καλή, καλλιπλόκαμος ). Daughter of Minos. Her dancing-floor at Cnosus Il. 18.592: carried off by Theseus but slain by Artemis in Dia Od. 11.321.

a)steropai=os.head: Ἀστεροπαῖος
a)steropai=os.html: Ἀστεροπαῖος (ἀρήϊος, περιδέξιος , φαίδιμος). Son of Pelegon and a leader of the Paeonians Il. 12.102 , Il. 17.217, 351, 352. Killed by Achilles Il. 21.140, 163, 170; Il. 23.560, 808.

a)kropo/los.head: ἀκροπόλος
a)kropo/los.html: ἀκροπόλος [ἄκρος. Cf. οἰόπολος.] Topmost, the topmost part of: ὄρεσσιν Il. 5.523: Od. 19.205.

a)stu/pulos.head: Ἀστύπυλος
a)stu/pulos.html: Ἀστύπυλος Trojan. A Paeonian. Killed by Achilles Il. 21.209.

a)ti/mhtos.head: ἀτίμητος
a)ti/mhtos.html: ἀτίμητος [ἀτιμάω.] Despised; or perh., to whose life no blood-money is attached, whom anyone may slay with impunity: μετανάστην Il. 9.648 = Il. 16.59.

a)nagignw/skw.head: †ἀναγιγνώσκω
a)nagignw/skw.html: †ἀναγιγνώσκω [ἀνα- 4, ἀνα- 6.] Aor. ἀνέγνων Od. 4.250. 3 sing. ἀνέγνω Il. 13.734: Od. 1.216, Od. 21.205. 3 sing. opt. ἀναγνοίη Od. 11.144. Genit. sing. masc. pple. ἀναγνόντος Od. 24.346. Dat. sing. fem. ἀναγνούσῃ Od. 19.250, Od. 23.206. 1 To know again, recognize Od. 4.250, Od. 11.144, Od. 19.250 = Od. 23.206, Od. 24.346. 2 To know well, know certainly: [νόον ἐσθλόν] Il. 13.734 (i.e. best knows its value; cf. Od. 6.185). Cf. Od. 1.216, Od. 21.205.

a)splhdw/n.head: Ἀσπληδών
a)splhdw/n.html: Ἀσπληδών A Boeotian town near Orchomenus-1 Il. 2.511 .

a)/nqrwpos.head: ἄνθρωπος
a)/nqrwpos.html: ἄνθρωπος -ου, ὁ 1 a A human being, a man (seldom in sing. and never of a particular man): ἐσσομένοισι μετʼ ἀνθρώποισιν Il. 3.287, μυὼν ἀνθρώπου Il. 16.315. Cf. Il. 6.14, Il. 9.134, Il. 10.213, Il. 13.733, etc.: πολλῶν ἀνθρώπων ἄστεα Od. 1.3, ὃς ἀνθρώπους ἐκέκαστο (all men) Od. 19.395. Cf. Od. 19.395. Cf. Od. 1.183, Od. 3.48, Od. 6.259, Od. 7.23, etc. For μεροπες ἄνθρωποι see μέροπες. b Mankind, man: οὐδὲν ἀκιδνότερον ἀνθρώπου Od. 18.130. c Quasi-pronominal = one, anyone: ὅ κε στυγέῃσιν ἰδὼν ἀ. ἔχοντά [σε] Od. 13.400. d With a qualifying sb.: ἀ. ὁδίτης Il. 16.263. Cf. Il. 24.202: Od. 7.32, Od. 13.123. 2 Specifically, a man as distinguished from a god: οὔτε θεῶν οὔτʼ ἀνθρώπων Il. 1.548. Cf. Il. 2.669, Il. 5.442, Il. 6.180, Il. 8.27, etc.: νέμεσις ἐξ ἀνθρώπων ἔσσεται Od. 2.136. Cf. Od. 13.110, Od. 14.179, Od. 20.112, Od. 22.346, etc. With words indicative of mortality: θνητός Il. 1.339, Il. 14.199, etc.: Od. 1.219, Od. 5.32, etc.– καταθνητός Il. 6.123: Od. 3.114, Od. 9.502, etc.

a)mh/xanos.head: ἀμήχανος
a)mh/xanos.html: ἀμήχανος -ον [ἀ-1 + μηχανή = μῆχος.] 1 Without resources, helpless Od. 19.363. 2 Unmanageable, difficult to deal with: ἀ. παραρρητοῖσι πιθέσθαι (in that you will not listen to persuasion) Il. 13.726. Of Here Il. 15.14. Of Achilles Il. 16.29. Of Agamemnon Il. 19.273. Playfully of Nestor Il. 10.167. Against which no contrivance avails Il. 8.130 = Il. 11.310. Impracticable, not to be attempted Il. 14.262. Difficult to deal with or expound: ὄνειροι Od. 19.560.

ai)no/s.head: αἰνός
ai)no/s.html: αἰνός -ή, -όν. 1 Dread, dire, terrible, grim Il. 3.20, Il. 4.15, Il. 5.886, Il. 17.565, Il. 18.465, etc. : Od. 10.219, Od. 11.516, Od. 12.257, Od. 19.568, Od. 22.229, Od. 24.475. In comp. : οὐκ αἰνότερον ἄλλο γυναικός Od. 11.427. In superl. : στείνει ἐν αἰνοτάτῳ Il. 8.476. Cf. Il. 14.389: Od. 4.441, Od. 8.519, Od. 12.275. Absol. in neut. pl.: αἰνὰ παθοῦσα Il. 22.431. In neut. pl. as adv., miserably, calamitously: τεκοῦσα Il. 1.414. Cf. Od. 16.255. 2 Of persons. In superl., most dread: αἰνότατε κρονίδη Il. 1.552 = Il. 4.25 = Il. 8.462 = Il. 14.330 = Il. 16.440 = Il. 18.361. Beyond endurance, unbearable Il. 8.423. 3 Of feelings, etc., extreme, sore, overwhelming: ἄχος Il. 4.169. Cf. Il. 7.215, Il. 8.449, Il. 10.312, Il. 22.94, etc. : κάματος Od. 5.457. Cf. Od. 15.342, Od. 16.87, Od. 18.274. In neut. pl. αἰνά as adv., grievously, bitterly: ὀλοφυρόμεναι Od. 22.447. In neut. superl. αἰνότατον as adv., very grievously or sorely: περιδείδια Il. 13.52.

a)nipto/pous.head: ἀνιπτόπους
a)nipto/pous.html: ἀνιπτόπους -ποδος [ἀ-1 + νιπ-, νίζω + πούς.] With unwashen feet: ὑποφῆται Il. 16.235.

a)naqhle/w.head: ἀναθηλέω
a)naqhle/w.html: ἀναθηλέω [ἀνά- 4.] To sprout afresh Il. 1.236.

a)/frwn.head: ἄφρων
a)/frwn.html: ἄφρων -ονος [ἀ-1 + φρήν.] Senseless, foolish Il. 4.104, Il. 5.875, Il. 11.389, Il. 16.842, Il. 24.157 = 186: Od. 6.187, Od. 8.209, Od. 17.586, Od. 20.227, Od. 21.102, 105, Od. 23.12. Absol. Il. 3.220, Il. 5.761.

a)/rktos.head: ἄρκτος
a)/rktos.html:
ἄρκτος -ου, ἡ. 1 A bear Od. 11.611. 2 The constellation the Great Bear ( = ἄμαξα 2) Il. 18.487: = Od. 5.273.
Ἄρκτος See ἄρκτος 2 in Lexicon.

a)glao/s.head: ἀγλαός
a)glao/s.html: ἀγλαός An epithet of commendation of somewhat indefinite meaning. 1 Of things or abstractions, splendid, fine, goodly, bright or the like: ἄποινα Il. 1.23, ὕδωρ Il. 2.307. Cf. Il. 1.213, Il. 2.506, Il. 7.203, Il. 19.385, Il. 23.262, etc.: ἱστόν Od. 2.109, ἔργα Od. 13.289. Cf. Od. 3.429, Od. 4.589, Od. 6.291, etc. 2 Of persons, goodly, fine or the like Il. 2.736, 871, Il. 11.385 (see κέρας 4), etc.: Od. 3.190, Od. 11.249, etc.

a)/lutos.head: ἄλυτος
a)/lutos.html: ἄλυτος -ον [ἀ-1 + λύω.] Not to be loosed: πέδας Il. 13.37, πεῖραρ 360: δεσμούς Od. 8.275.

a)peire/sios.head: ἀπειρέσιος
a)peire/sios.html: ἀπειρέσιος -η, -ον [ἀ-1 + πεῖραρ.] 1 Boundless, endless: γαῖαν Il. 20.58: ὀϊζύν Od. 11.621. 2 Numberless, countless Od. 9.118, Od. 19.174.

a)mfipe/nomai.head: ἀμφιπένομαι
a)mfipe/nomai.html: ἀμφιπένομαι [ἀμφι- 4.] To busy oneself about, attend to Il. 13.656, Il. 19.278. To attend upon Od. 15.467. To treat surgically Il. 4.220, Il. 16.28: Od. 19.455. In sinister sense: Ἀστεροπαῖον ἐγχέλυες ἀμφεπένοντο (made a meal of him) Il. 21.203. Cf. Il. 23.184.

a)tima/zw.head: ἀτιμάζω
a)tima/zw.html: ἀτιμάζω [ἀτιμάω.] 3 sing. pa. iterative ἀτιμάζεσκε Il. 9.450. 1 = ἀτιμάω Il. 1.11: Od. 6.283, Od. 8.309, Od. 11.496, Od. 13.141, Od. 14.164, 506, Od. 16.317 = Od. 19.498, Od. 18.144, Od. 20.167, Od. 21.332, 427, Od. 22.418, Od. 23.116, Od. 24.459. 2 To dishonour by conjugal unfaithfulness: ἄκοιτιν Il. 9.450.

ai)qalo/eis.head: αἰθαλόεις
ai)qalo/eis.html: αἰθαλόεις -όεσσα, -όεν. 1 Blackened by smoke (failing to escape by the smoke-hole) Il. 2.415: Od. 22.239. 2 Of ashes, blackened by fire, dark Il. 18.23 = Od. 24.316.

a)poskeda/nnumi.head: †ἀποσκεδάννυμι
a)poskeda/nnumi.html: †ἀποσκεδάννυμι [ἀπο- 7.] 3 sing. aor. ἀπεσκέδασε. To cause to disperse, dismiss Il. 19.309: Od. 11.385.

a)konti/zw.head: ἀκοντίζω
a)konti/zw.html: ἀκοντίζω [ἄκων.] 3 sing. aor. ἀκόντισε Il. 4.496, Il. 5.533, Il. 8.118, Il. 13.183, Il. 17.304, etc. 3 pl. ἠκόντισαν Il. 16.336. ἀκόντισαν Il. 22.255, 265, 272, 282. Imp. pl. ἀκοντίσατε Od. 22.252. Genit. sing. masc. pple. ἀκοντίσσαντος Il. 4.498, Il. 15.575. Infin. ἀκοντίσσαι Il. 13.559, 585, Il. 16.359. ἀκοντίσαι Od. 22.263. (ἀν-.) 1 To throw the spear: ἀνδρὸς ἀκοντίσσαντος Il. 4.498 = Il. 15.575. Cf. Il. 16.336, 359: οἱ ἓξ ἀκοντίσατε Od. 22.252. Cf. Od. 22.255, 263. With genit. of the person aimed at: Ἕκτορος ἀκόντισεν Il. 8.118. Cf. Il. 13.502, 559, Il. 17.608. With dat. of the weapon: δουρί Il. 5.533. Cf. Il. 4.496, Il. 5.611 = Il. 17.347, Il. 11.577, Il. 13.403, 585, Il. 15.573, Il. 16.284, Il. 17.574: Od. 8.229. With genit and dat. Il. 4.490, Il. 13.183, 516, Il. 14.402, 461, Il. 15.429, Il. 17.304, 525. 2 To throw (a spear): αἰχμάς Il. 12.44, Il. 14.422: δοῦρα Od. 22.265, 272, 282.

a)lkmh/nh.head: Ἀλκμήνη
a)lkmh/nh.html: Ἀλκμήνη Wife of Amphitryon and mother of Heracles by Zeus Il. 14.323; H 's birth delayed by contrivance of Hera, whereby Heracles became subject to Eurystheus Il. 19.99 , 119: Amphitryon brought into comparison with Penelope Od. 2.120; in the Shades Od. 11.266.

a)gaph/nwr.head: ἀγαπήνωρ
a)gaph/nwr.html:
ἀγαπήνωρ -ορος [ἀγαπάω + ἀνήρ.] Showing kindliness to fellow-men, courteous. Epithet of heroes Il. 8.114, Il. 13.756, Il. 15.392, Il. 23.113 = 124: Od. 7.170.
Ἀγαπήνωρ (κρείων). Son of Ancaeus-1 and leader of the Arcadians Il. 2.609.

a)ndroma/xh.head: Ἀνδρομάχη
a)ndroma/xh.html: Ἀνδρομάχη (λευκώλενος, πολύδωρος ). Daughter of Eetion-1, wife of Hector and mother of Astyanax. Absent when Hector visited his house Il. 6.371, 377 , her meeting and conversation with him 395, 405; her care of his horses Il. 8.187; Il. 17.208; sees his corpse being dragged to the ships Il. 22.460, her lament for him and Astyanax 477; her lament over his ransomed corpse Il. 24.723.

a)fh/twr.head: ἀφήτωρ
a)fh/twr.html: ἀφήτωρ -ορος [ἀφ-, ἀπο- 1 + ἡ-, ἵημι1. The sender forth.] The Archer. Name of Apollo Il. 9.404.

a)napa/llw.head: ἀναπάλλω
a)napa/llw.html: ἀναπάλλω [ἀνα- 1.] Contr. aor. pple. ἀμπεπαλών Il. 3.355, Il. 5.280, Il. 7.244, Il. 11.349, Il. 17.516, Il. 20.438, Il. 22.273, 289: Od. 24.519, 522. 3 sing. aor. pass. ἀνέπαλτο Il. 8.85, Il. 23.694. 1 To poise and sway (a spear before throwing) Il. 3.355 = Il. 5.280 = Il. 7.244 = Il. 11.349 = Il. 17.516 = Il. 22.273 = 289, Il. 20.438: Od. 24.519 = 522. 2 In pass., to leap or spring up: ἀναπάλλεται ἰχθύς Il. 23.692. Cf. Il. 8.85, Il. 23.694.

a)krisiw/nh.head: Ἀκρισιώνη
a)krisiw/nh.html: Ἀκρισιώνη Patronymic of Danae, daughter of Acrisius Il. 14.319.

a)rke/w.head: ἀρκέω
a)rke/w.html: ἀρκέω 3 sing. fut. ἀρκέσει Il. 21.131: Od. 16.261. 3 sing. aor. ἤρκεσε Il. 6.16, Il. 13.371, 397, Il. 15.529, 534, Il. 20.289: Od. 4.292. (ἐπ-.) 1 To ward off, keep off Il. 15.534. With dat. of person protected: ὄλεθρόν οἱ Il. 6.16. Cf. Il. 20.289: Od. 4.292. Sim.: ἀπὸ χροός οἱ ὄλεθρον Il. 13.440. 2 With dat., to defend, protect: θώρηξ οἱ Il. 15.529. Cf. Il. 21.131. Without case Il. 13.371, 397. 3 To suffice: ἤ κεν νῶϊν Ἀθήνη ἀρκέσει Od. 16.261.

a)da/krutos.head: ἀδάκρυτος
a)da/krutos.html: ἀδάκρυτος [ἀ-1 + δακρύω.] Not shedding tears, tearless Il. 1.415 : Od. 4.186, Od. 24.61.

a)/pios.head: ἄπιος
a)/pios.html: ἄπιος -η [app. fr. ἀπό.] Thus, distant, far off: ἐξ ἀπίης γαίης Il. 1.270, Il. 3.49: Od. 7.25, Od. 16.18.

a)nta/w.head: ἀντάω
a)nta/w.html: ἀντάω [ἄντα.] From ἀντέω 3 pl. impf. ἤντεον Il. 7.423. (συν-.) 1 To meet, encounter. With dat.: οἱ Il. 6.399. Cf. Il. 7.423. To meet a person so as to have knowledge of him Il. 4.375: = Od. 4.201. 2 With genit., to encounter, come upon: ἔνδον ἐόντων Od. 16.254. To light or come upon: δαίτης Od. 3.44, ὀπωπῆς 97 = Od. 4.327, Od. 17.44. To get one's will in the matter of: μάχης Il. 7.158. 3 With genit., to encounter in fight: τοῦδʼ ἀνέρος Il. 16.423.

a)naprh/qw.head: †ἀναπρήθω
a)naprh/qw.html: †ἀναπρήθω [ἀνα- 1.] Aor. pple. ἀναπρήσας. To cause (tears) to well up Il. 9.433: Od. 2.81.

a)xaiiko/s.head: Ἀχαιϊκός
a)xaiiko/s.html: Ἀχαιϊκός Achaean. (1) λαὸς Ἀχαιϊκός Ἀχαιός 2.b (γ) Il. 9.521, Il. 13.349, Il. 15.218. Applied to Argos-1 (1) Il. 9.141, 283, Il. 19.115: Od. 3.251.

ai)nare/ths.head: αἰναρέτης
ai)nare/ths.html: αἰναρέτης [αἰνός + ἀρετή.] Voc. αἰναρέτη (u.l. αἰναρέτα). Cursed in one's valour Il. 16.31.

a)pale/cw.head: †ἀπαλέξω
a)pale/cw.html: †ἀπαλέξω [ἀπ-, ἀπο- 2.] Fut. infin. ἀπαλεξήσειν Od. 17.364. Aor. opt. ἀπαλεξήσαιμι Il. 24.371. 1 To ward or keep off from. With genit.: ἄλλον σεὺ Il. 24.371. 2 To keep (a person) protected from. With genit.: κακότητός τινα Od. 17.364.

a(nda/nw.head: †ἁνδάνω
a(nda/nw.html: †ἁνδάνω ((σ)ϝανδάνω) [(σ)ϝαδ-. Cf. ἡδύς, L. suavis.] 3 sing. ἁνδάνει Od. 2.114. 3 sing. impf. ἑήνδανε (ἐϝάνδανε) Il. 24.25: Od. 3.143. ἥνδανε (ϝάνδανε) Il. 1.24, 378, Il. 15.674, Il. 18.510: Od. 5.153, Od. 8.506, Od. 10.373, Od. 14.337, 525, Od. 16.398, Od. 17.173. ἅνδανε Od. 3.150. 3 sing. aor. εὔαδε (ἔϝαδε) Il. 14.340, Il. 17.647: Od. 16.28. ἅδε (ϝάδε) Il. 12.80, Il. 13.748: Od. 24.465. 3 sing. opt. ἅδοι Od. 6.245, Od. 20.327. Infin. ἁδεῖν Il. 3.173. Acc. sing. masc. pf. pple. ἑαδότα (ϝεϝαδότα) Il. 9.173: Od. 18.422. (ἀφ-, ἐπι-.) 1 To please, be pleasing or acceptable, find favour or acceptance Od. 5.153, Od. 17.173. With dat.: Ἕκτορι Il. 12.80 = Il. 13.748. Cf. Il. 3.173, Il. 14.340, Il. 18.510: Od. 2.114, Od. 3.150, Od. 8.506, Od. 14.337, 525, Od. 16.398, Od. 20.327, Od. 24.465. 2 Impers. With dat.: ἐπεί τοι εὔαδεν οὕτως Il. 17.647. Cf. Il. 1.24 = 378, Il. 24.25: Od. 3.143, Od. 10.373. With dat. and infin.: Αἴαντι ἑστάμεν Il. 15.674. Cf. Od. 6.245. So ὥς τοι εὔαδε, . . . ἐσορᾶν . . . Od. 16.28. 3 In pf. pple., pleasing, agreeable Il. 9.173: = Od. 18.422.

ai)de/omai.head: αἰδέομαι
ai)de/omai.html: αἰδέομαι [αἰδώς.] Imp. αἰδεῖο Il. 24.503: Od. 9.269. Fut. αἰδέσσομαι Od. 14.388. 3 sing. αἰδέσεται Il. 22.124, Il. 24.208. 3 sing. aor. αἰδέσατο Od. 21.28. 3 sing. subj. αἰδέσεται Il. 9.508. αἰδέσσεται Il. 22.419. Imp. αἴδεσσαι Il. 9.640. 3 pl. aor. αἴδεσθεν Il. 7.93. Imp. pl. αἰδέσθητε Od. 2.65. Pple. αἰδεσθείς Il. 4.402, Il. 17.95. From αἰδ- 3 sing. aor. αἴδετο Il. 21.468: Od. 6.66, 329, Od. 8.86. Imp. αἴδεο Il. 21.74, Il. 22.82: Od. 22.312, 344. Pple. αἰδόμενος, -η Il. 1.331, Il. 5.531, Il. 10.237, Il. 15.563: Od. 3.96, Od. 4.326, Od. 16.75, Od. 19.527. 1 To hold in reverence or honour, pay due respect to, stand in awe of, regard, fear: ἱερῆα Il. 1.23 = 377, βασιλῆα Il. 1.331. Cf. Il. 4.402, Il. 9.508, 640, Il. 21.74, Il. 22.82, 124, 419, Il. 24.208, 503: πατροκασίγνητον Od. 6.329. Cf. Od. 9.269, Od. 14.388, Od. 16.75 = Od. 19.527, Od. 17.188, Od. 21.28, Od. 22.312 = 344. Absol. Il. 10.237. 2 To be restrained by reverence, dread or respect from doing something. With infin.: συλεύειν Ἀχιλῆα Il. 24.435. Cf. Il. 21.468: Od. 14.146, Od. 20.343. 3 To be moved by regard for the feelings of, spare Od. 3.96 = Od. 4.326. 4 To be moved by respect for the opinion of, fear what . . . may think or say: ἀλλήλους Il. 5.530 = Il. 15.562. Cf. Il. 6.442 = Il. 22.105: Od. 2.65, Od. 8.86. Absol. Il. 5.531, Il. 15.563, Il. 17.95. 5 To be ashamed, think shame, not to like, to do something. With infin.: ἀνήνασθαι Il. 7.93. Cf. Il. 24.90: Od. 6.66, 221. Absol. Od. 18.184. To be shamefaced Od. 17.578.

a)ei/.head: ἀεί
a)ei/.html: ἀεί [cf. αἰεί, αἰέν] = αἰεί Il. 12.211, Il. 23.648: Od. 15.379.

a)ni/hmi.head: †ἀνίημι
a)ni/hmi.html: †ἀνίημι [ἀν-, ἀνα- 1, ἀνα- 3 + ἵημι1.] 3 sing. ἀνίησι Od. 4.568, Od. 12.105. 2 sing. opt. ἀνιείης Od. 2.185. Fem. pple. ἀνιεῖσα Il. 5.422. 3 sing. fut. ἀνήσει Il. 2.276. 3 sing. aor. ἀνέηκε Il. 5.882. 2 sing. ἀνῆκας Il. 21.396. 3 sing. ἀνῆκε Il. 2.71, Il. 5.405, Il. 6.256, Il. 7.25, etc.: Od. 7.289, Od. 8.73, Od. 14.465, Od. 17.425, Od. 18.199, Od. 19.551, Od. 24.440. 3 pl. aor. ἄνεσαν Il. 21.537. 3 sing. subj. ἀνήῃ Il. 2.34. 3 sing. opt. ἀνείη Il. 22.346. Pl. pple. ἀνέντες Il. 5.761. From ἀνιέω 2 sing. ἀνιεῖς Il. 5.880. 3 sing. impf. ἀνίει Il. 15.24. ἀνί̄ει Od. 8.359. Fem. pres. pple. mid. ἀνιεμένη Il. 22.80. Acc. masc. pl. ἀνιεμένους Od. 2.300. 1 To send up, cause to ascend: καπνόν Il. 21.523. To cause to flow up: [ὕδωρ] Od. 12.105. 2 To stir up, set on, urge, incite, impel: σοὶ ἔπι τοῦτον Il. 5.405. Cf. Il. 5.761, Il. 7.25, Il. 10.389, Il. 16.691, Il. 17.705, Il. 21.395, 545: Od. 2.185. With infin.: νεικείειν βασιλῆας Il. 2.276. Cf. Il. 5.422, 882, Il. 6.256, Il. 7.152, Il. 12.307, Il. 14.362, Il. 21.396, Il. 22.252, 346: ἀειδέμεναι Od. 8.73. Cf. Od. 14.465, Od. 17.425. Absol. Il. 5.880, Il. 20.118. To cause (a wind) to blow Od. 4.568. 3 To loose (a bond) Od. 8.359.– To loose the fastenings of: πύλας Il. 21.537. To relax hold upon, leave in peace: θυμὸν ὀδύνη Il. 15.24.– Of sleep, to leave, depart from Il. 2.34, 71: Od. 7.289, Od. 18.199, Od. 19.551, Od. 24.440. 4 In mid., to loose, allow to fall away (a part of one's dress): κόλπον Il. 22.80. App. by development of this sense, to take off the skin of, flay: αἶγας Od. 2.300.

a)/gnumi.head: †ἄγνυμι
a)/gnumi.html: †ἄγνυμι (ϝάγνυμι). 3 dual pres. ἄγνυτον Il. 12.148. Fut. ἄξω Il. 8.403. Infin. ἄξειν Il. 8.417. 3 sing. aor. ἔαξε Il. 7.270, Il. 11.175, Il. 17.63: Od. 5.316, 385, Od. 19.539. ἦξε Il. 23.392. 3 pl. ἔαξαν Od. 3.298. 2 sing. subj. ἄξῃς Il. 23.341. 3 sing. ἄξῃ Il. 5.161. Imp. ἆξον Il. 6.306. Nom. dual masc. pple. ἄξαντε Il. 6.40, Il. 16.371. Infin. ἆξαι Il. 21.178, Il. 23.467. Pass. Genit. pl. fem. pres. pple. ἀγνυμενάων Il. 16.769: Od. 10.123. 3 sing. aor. ἐάγη Il. 13.162, Il. 17.607: Od. 10.560, Od. 11.65. ἄγη Il. 3.367, Il. 16.801. 3 pl. ἄγεν Il. 4.214. 3 sing. pf. subj. in pass. sense ἐάγῃ Il. 11.559. (κατ-, περι-, συν-.) 1 To break, shiver, smash, shatter: ἄγη ξίφος Il. 3.367, ἆξον ἔγχος Διομήδεος Il. 6.306, etc.: πρὸ κύματʼ ἔαξεν Od. 5.385 (broke their force, beat them down), αὐχὴν ἐάγη Od. 10.560, etc. 2 To wreck (a ship) Od. 3.298.

a)lei/ths.head: ἀλείτης
a)lei/ths.html: ἀλείτης -ου, ὁ [ἀλετεῖν, aor. infin. ἀλιταίνω.] An offender: τείσεσθαι ἀλείτην Il. 3.28. Cf. Od. 20.121.

ai)=a.head: αἶα
ai)=a.html: αἶα -ης, ἡ [ = γαῖα.] 1 The earth: ὕδωρ ἐπικίδναται αἶαν Il. 2.850. Cf. Il. 3.243, Od. 8.1, Il. 9.506, Il. 23.742, Il. 24.695: κατέχει αἶα Od. 11.301. Cf. Od. 24.509.– 2 a A particular land or country: Θρῃκῶν αἶαν Il. 13.4: Ἀχαΐδος αἴης Od. 13.249. b One's native land: ὁππότʼ ἂν ἧς ἱμείρεται αἴης Od. 1.41. So πατρὶς αἶα. Always in genit. πατρίδος αἴης Il. 2.162 = 178, Il. 4.172, Il. 11.817, Il. 15.740, Il. 16.539: Od. 1.75, 203, Od. 4.262, 521, Od. 10.236, 472, Od. 18.145, Od. 19.301, Od. 23.353, Od. 24.290. 3 The surface of the earth, the earth, the ground: ὅσον τʼ ὄργυιʼ ὑπὲρ αἴης Il. 23.327.

a)/nthn.head: ἄντην
a)/nthn.html: ἄντην [adv. fr. acc. of *ἄντη, conn. with ἀντίος.] 1 Face to face: ἐσέδρακον ἀ. Il. 24.223. Cf. Il. 15.247, Il. 24.464: Od. 5.77, Od. 8.213. When set face to face, when brought into comparison: θεῷ ἐναλίγκιος ἀ. Od. 2.5 = Od. 4.310. Cf. Od. 22.240, Od. 24.371. 2 To one's face: ὁμοιωθήμεναι ἀ. Il. 1.187. Cf. Il. 10.158: Od. 3.120, Od. 8.158. 3 Facing the foe, man to man: ἀ. ἵστασθε Il. 11.590. Cf. Il. 12.152, Il. 18.307, Il. 22.109. 4 Straight in front of one: ἀ. εἰσιδέειν Il. 19.15. 5 Before the eyes of a company: ἀ. οὐκ ἂν λοέσσομαι Od. 6.221. 6 Into one's view or presence Il. 8.399.

a)lloi=os.head: ἀλλοῖος
a)lloi=os.html: ἀλλοῖος [ἄλλος.] Of another sort or kind: ἔργῳ Il. 4.258: ἀ. φάνης Od. 16.181, ἄνδρα Od. 19.265.

ai)/simos.head: αἴσιμος
ai)/simos.html: αἴσιμος -η, -ον [αἶσα.] 1 In (due) measure: ἀμείνω αἴσιμα πάντα Od. 7.310, Od. 15.71, τίσειν αἴσιμα πάντα (all that is fitting) Od. 8.348, ἔργα (inspired by justice) Od. 14.84, ταῦτʼ αἴσιμα εἶπας (just, right) Od. 22.46, φρένας αἰσίμη (well balanced in . . .) Od. 23.14. 2 Absol. in neut. pl. αἴσιμα, what is just or right: αἰ. παρειπών Il. 6.62, Il. 7.121. So (see εἴδω III.12) ὅτʼ ἄγγελος αἰ. εἰδῇ (can say the right thing) Il. 15.207: αἰ. εἰδώς (having justice in his heart, just) Od. 2.231 = Od. 5.9, αἰ. ᾔδη Od. 14.433. 3 In neut. pl. as adv., in due measure Od. 21.294. 4 Decreed by fate, fatal: αἴσιμον ἦμαρ. See ἦμαρ 4.a. In neut. sing. αἴσιμον in impers. construction, (it is) fated or destined: μὴ ἡμῖν αἰ. εἴη φθίσθαι Il. 9.245. Cf. Il. 15.274, Il. 21.291, 495: Od. 15.239.

a)gorh=qen.head: ἀγορῆθεν
a)gorh=qen.html: ἀγορῆθεν [ἀγορή + -θεν 1.] From the place of assembly Il. 2.264. From the place of judgment Od. 12.439.

a)ridei/ketos.head: ἀριδείκετος
a)ridei/ketos.html: ἀριδείκετος [ἀρι- + δείκνυμι.] Distinguished, renowned Od. 11.540. Conspicuous, exalted: ἀνδρῶν (among . . .) Il. 11.248. Cf. Il. 14.320: Od. 8.382 = 401 = Od. 9.2 = Od. 11.355 = 378 = Od. 13.38.

a)/grios.head: ἄγριος
a)/grios.html:
ἄγριος -η, -ον and -ος, -ον [ἀγρός.] 1 Of animals, wild, untamed Il. 3.24, Il. 4.106, Il. 8.338, Il. 9.539, Il. 15.271: Od. 9.119, Od. 14.50. Applied to flies Il. 19.30. Absol. in neut. pl. ἄγρια, wild creaturesIl. 5.52. 2 Of men, fierce, savage, raging Il. 6.97 = 278, Il. 8.96, Il. 21.314. Of Scylla Od. 12.119. 3 Not conforming to the traditional order of society, uncivilized, barbarous, savage Od. 1.199, Od. 2.19, Od. 6.120 = Od. 9.175 = Od. 13.201, Od. 7.206, Od. 8.575, Od. 9.215, 494. 4 In gen., fierce, raging, ungoverned: χόλος Il. 4.23, πτόλεμος Il. 17.737. Cf. Il. 8.460, Il. 9.629, Il. 17.398, Il. 19.88, Il. 22.313: Od. 8.304. 5 Absol. in neut. pl. ἄγρια, fierceness: ἀ. οἶδεν (has fierceness in his heart) (see εἴδω III.12) Il. 24.41.
Ἄγριος Son of Portheus Il. 14.117.

ai)dw/s.head: αἰδώς
ai)dw/s.html: αἰδώς -οῦς, ἡ. 1 Reverence, respect, regard: αἰδοῖ εἴκων Il. 10.238. Cf. Il. 24.111: Od. 8.480, Od. 14.505. 2 Sensitiveness to the opinion of others, fear of what others may think or say, shame: ἐν φρεσὶ θέσθʼ αἰδῶ Il. 13.122. Cf. Il. 15.129, 561 = 661, Il. 15.657, Il. 24.44: Od. 20.171. As exclam. ( = ἐν φρεσὶ θέσθʼ αἰδῶ): αἰ., Ἀργεῖοι Il. 5.787 = Il. 8.228. Cf. Il. 13.95, Il. 15.502, Il. 16.422. 3 Something to be ashamed of Il. 17.336: Od. 3.24. The private parts: τά τʼ αἰδῶ ἀμφικαλύπτει Il. 2.262. Cf. Il. 22.75. 4 Modesty Od. 8.172. Sense of propriety, delicacy Od. 8.324. Shamefacedness, bashfulness Od. 3.14, Od. 17.347, 352.

a)/llws.head: ἄλλως
a)/llws.html: ἄλλως [ἄλλος.] 1 Otherwise, differently, so as to bring about a different result Il. 14.53. In other circumstances Od. 15.513. Reversing a previous decision: μετεβούλευσαν Od. 5.286. 2 In some other form: εἰ ἀ. δοίης δωτίνην Od. 9.267. For some other reason Od. 17.577. In novel fashion: ἑψιάασθαι Od. 8.429. 3 καὶ ἀ., as it is, at the best of times, without that: ἀγήνωρ ἐστὶ καὶ ἀ. Il. 9.699. Cf. Il. 20.99: Od. 21.87. 4 Otherwise (connoting improvement): πάρος οὐκ ἔσσεται ἀ. Il. 5.218. In other and better wise, better, more effectually: σαωσέμεν Il. 19.401. Cf. Il. 11.391: οὔ κεν ἀ. θεὸς τεύξειεν Od. 8.176. Cf. Od. 20.211, Od. 24.107. 5 Otherwise than with due regard to truth, idly, at random: ἀ. ψεύδονται Od. 14.124. 6 With other result than that hoped for, in vain, fruitlessly: ἀ. ἠρήσατο Il. 23.144.

a)/bas.head: Ἄβας
a)/bas.html: Ἄβας Trojan. Son of Eurydamas-1. With his brother Polyidus-1 killed by Diomedes Il. 5.148.

a)pexqa/nomai.head: ἀπεχθάνομαι
a)pexqa/nomai.html: ἀπεχθάνομαι [ἀπ-, ἀπο- 7.] 3 sing. aor. ἀπήχθετο Il. 3.454, Il. 6.140, 200, Il. 9.300, Il. 24.27. 2 sing. subj. ἀπέχθηαι Il. 9.614. 3 sing. -ηται Od. 10.74. 3 pl. -ωνται Il. 4.53. Pple. ἀπεχθόμενος, -ου Od. 10.75, Od. 16.114, Od. 18.165. Infin. ἀπεχθέσθαι Il. 21.83. 1 To become hateful, incur hatred or enmity Od. 2.202, Od. 18.165. To become hateful to, incur the hatred, disfavour, dislike or enmity of. With dat.: πᾶσιν Il. 3.454. Cf. Il. 4.53, Il. 6.140, 200, Il. 9.300, 614, Il. 21.83, Il. 24.27: Od. 10.74, 75. 2 To come into a state of enmity: δῆμος ἀπεχθόμενος Od. 16.114.

a)lkuo/nh.head: Ἀλκυόνη
a)lkuo/nh.html: Ἀλκυόνη A name for Cleopatra. The reason given Il. 9.562.

a)pocu/w.head: ἀποξύω
a)pocu/w.html: ἀποξύω [ἀπο- 1.] To scrape off. Fig.: γῆρας ἀποξύσας Il. 9.446.

a)pama/w.head: ἀπαμάω
a)pama/w.html: ἀπαμάω [ἀπ-, ἀπο- 3 + ἀμάω1.] To cut, cut through, sever: λαιμόν Il. 18.34 (for v.l. see ἀποτμήγω).

ai)nei/as.head: Αἰνείας
